Title: PicFinder
Description: Every day we discover new generative AIs of texts, images, music… Every day I will share here one of my discoveries. The first one tonight: Picfinder

Title: Mubert
Description: Some music generated via a text query? Here’s @mubertapp, 25 free generations per month.

Title: Playground
Description: An image-generating AI boosted by editing tools and a gallery open to remixing, that’s @playground_ai

Title: Fliki
Description: A text transformed into a video with voice and subtitling thanks to AI? @fliki_ai

Title: YouChat
Description: A conversational AI that cites its sources in a search engine? Youchat is integrated into http://You.com

Title: Mixo
Description: 1 prompt, 20 seconds, 1 web page written and illustrated, with original title and logo, editable and hostable. This is the challenge taken up by @MixoTeam

Title: Scribble Diffusion
Description: A freehand drawing specified by a prompt and Scribble Diffusion offers us an image. Open source.

Title: Riffusion
Description: Do you want a playlist of music that doesn’t exist yet, created according to your desires? Riffusion is ready to welcome our prompts.

Title: Character AI
Description: A discussion with Plato, Tolkien, Billie Eilish, Mario, learning a language by conversing or exchanging with your own freshly created character? Try it Character.ai now! https://beta.character.ai

Title: Ayoa
Description: With Ayoa, AI becomes a generator of ideas shaped into a mind map that can be illustrated with images… generated by AI!

Title: Humata
Description: A pdf document summarized and that can be questioned? Humata analyses, synthesizes, answers and can even continue a text. Pdf up to 20 pages in free version

Title: Paint by Text
Description: Paint by text, the editing of images from a text query.

Title: Vizcom
Description: By combining drawing and prompt, Vizcom creates 3D rendered images that can be changed with each change in the drawing or instruction.

Title: Endless Visual Novel
Description: Endlessvn offers a new video game experience: unique characters, a world, a scenario, a sound universe created from simple descriptions and implemented in a few minutes by several AIs

Title: Yippity
Description: A text of up to 10000 characters or a URL and Yippity generates an editable questionnaire (accepts texts in French but translates them: works in English, Spanish or Italian).

Title: WebChatGPT
Description: An access to the web for Chat GPT so that it can draw on recent sources and cite them? The Chrome or Firefox extension “ChatGPT advanced” allows it.

Title: Lucidpic
Description: To create configurable portraits of people who do not exist, free of rights, to illustrate documents: Lucidpic.

Title: Cody
Description: Cody proposes to become our personal assistant: from a database of text documents or presentations that we create, Cody answers our questions – by citing his sources – drawing on this personal database.

Title: Whimsical
Description: With Whimsical, create mind maps from a central topic-prompt, then branch by branch the AI generates ideas.

Title: ImgCreator
Description: Imgcreator: image generation, layout and editing tools, and adding details to the image.

Title: Runway ML
Description: 30 image-oriented tools (still or animated), from creation to editing, all in one place: enjoy your visit to @runwayml !

Title: Nolej
Description: Nolej creates training modules from texts, videos or URLs with courses, quizzes, flashcards. Ex completed in 3 minutes and without intervention: https://h5p-live.nolej.app/documents/b1884490-bae9-43c0-9b4d-7b544f53a535/previews/ibook/index.html via @coutleea and @benovigo

Title: Modulo AI assistant
Description: For this new #uneIAparjour here is the Modulo assistant from @Tart2000 (a more than recommended tool!): a prompt and the AI offers us a breakdown of the subject and the activities. Beta version to be tested with 10 tries

Title: Rytr
Description: A writing tool for this new #uneIAparjour : . 30 languages, several tones, use cases to guide, tools for layout, expansion and reformulation for a text that takes shape step by step.

Title: Boomy
Description: Looking for a unique musical production? Boomy offers to take care of it: choice of style, type of composition, instruments and in a few tens of seconds the sound is ready, modifiable and shareable.

Title: Ludo
Description: Ludo offers to assist in the creation of a video game: from ideation, through the game mechanics, the characters, the rules of the game, the generation of images, etc. to its complete description.

Title: Imagine
Description: “Imagine” of @MagicStudio: generative AI of images with prompt editing, eraser and background removal possible.

Title: Nat.dev
Description: Now a paid tool, this article is archived.

Title: Perplexity
Description: Perplexity, between search engine and generative AI of text, possible summary and querying of results.

Title: Elicit
Description: A search engine dedicated to scientific literature in open access (175 M writings) with the help of Chat GPT: @elicitorg. Natural language search, prompts proposals, abstracts, direct questioning, exports…

Title: Opera
Description: Chatsonic and ChatGPT integrated and connected to the web in a browser, “AI Prompts” contextualized according to the pages and which react to highlighted text: this is what the latest version of Opera offers https://opera.com/fr

Title: Leonardo
Description: Generative AI of images from more than 20 AI models, prompt help, compositing tool and the ability to train your own shareable AI afterwards.

Title: GPTGO
Description: What if Google and Chat GPT were in the same interface and answered the same query? Here is GPTGO, free and without an account (with advertising).

Title: Playlistai
Description: Playlistai (iOS) offers Spotify or AppleMusic playlists from a prompt, an artist, a genre, a poster and even a video! Test from the poster of the @eurockeennes, not perfect but possibility of choice.

Title: Chattypdf
Description: Question a pdf? Chattypdf! Prompt in French accepted, answer in English.

Title: Type
Description: Type: A generative AI of text with layout tool.

Title: Catbird
Description: 15 generative AI models of images that produce from a single prompt, in a single tool: this is Catbird!

Title: Gen1 de Runway
Description: With @runwayml’s “Gen-1: Video to video” tool (beta version), transform a video from a prompt or predefined styles in tens of seconds.

Title: Story Wizard
Description: Choice of a main character, quick description and @StorywizardAIcreates an illustrated story with editable text and images. A “raw” test here: http://storywizard.ai/s/fea67bb38b A free story by account.

Title: StudioGPT – Reimagine
Description: An image generated in a new style? One prompt, one loaded image and StudioGPT operates (5 free generations).www.latentlabs.art/dream

Title: Scenario
Description: 45 generative AI models of images (including stable diffusion) in the same tool, possibility of switching from one to the other with the same prompt, augmenting it, correcting it, writing it in negative, laying out or training your AI: https://scenario.com

Title: Steve
Description: A script or a web page and http://steve.ai generates a video or an animation with music and voice-over! Two tests: https://app.steve.ai/video/HOEPM2H9IQ9VRM4P… and https://app.steve.ai/video/9YRFF6OPZFVY5Y7X…. Still perfectible (link between image and text for example) but already very accomplished.

Title: Bedtime Story
Description: A story created by an AI that can be configured and edited: https://bedtimestory.ai offers to generate it from a prompt, add illustrations and share it in a library of created stories.

Title: Chatbase
Description: Thanks to Chatbase (http://chatbase.co) create your own chatbot with your files, texts and websites. Supports French. 1 chatbot – based on GPT3, customizable, public or private, with iframe – and 30 requests per month in free version.

Title: UseChatGPT
Description: ChatGPT always available in your browser: that’s what the http://UseChatGPT.ai extension for Chrome offers. Writing help, corrector, summary of highlighted text, dictionary, translator, etc. Via @Siecledigital

Title: Soundraw
Description: http://Soundraw.io : an AI that generates music with a duration of up to 5 minutes from a multitude of combinable choices (themes, styles, instruments, tempo…). Free generation and sharing but downloads by subscription.

Title: Night Cafe
Description: A new tool offering several image-generating A models including Dall-e or the next version of Stable Diffusion, SDBX, with prompts writing aids: https://nightcafe.studio

Title: AI Race
Description: A lesson with a quiz in a few minutes? After Nolej, another AI offers it: http://courseai.coAn example generated in 2 minutes from 6 words: https://courseai.co/share/zAd40kJUBfWa5J9ZH90h… Content on the other hand not (yet?) modifiable. Scorm export possible.

Title: Brancher
Description: Create an online application using one or more AIs without any notion of programming? An idea and https://brancher.ai connect ChatGPT and dallE to shape it. Test with this creator of illustrated haikus: https://app.brancher.ai/166a66e2-beed-48e4-8601-12f85ce64b0d… (login required)

Title: Verb Art
Description: http://Verb.art: An AI that generates images from voice recognition. iOS app and Android.

Title: Designer
Description: Microsoft is preparing its graphic design tool, Designer https://designer.microsoft.com (waitlist access): generating ideas from a prompt, generating images and layout proposals related to the creation.

Title: Cohesive
Description: Cohesive.so: text generative AI tool that offers pre-defined writing templates with collaborative text editor and generated documents. Generates in English, built-in translation tool. 10000 free words per month.

Title: My AskAI
Description: A tool to create your own AI-based chatbot: https://myaskai.com from a database of documents or defined URLs. Test with the MEN pages of the school and college programs in capture. In English but French accepted.

Title: AI Pen
Description: plume-ai.com, an AI-inflated online word processor: generates from a prompt or the previous sentence, rephrases, suggests outlines and essays. 3000 free words per month.

Title: BingGPT
Description: Bing’s chatbot – only it – and therefore GPT4 directly in your computer without going through Edge or the Bing site? @DICE2O BingGPT share: https://github.com/dice2o/BingGPT, application open-source to install. Microsoft account required and unlimited access.

Title: Instant Art
Description: Instant art (https://instantart.io): 25 generative AI models of images based on stable diffusion available for free, access to the images already generated and their prompt, a dozen possible dimensions.

Title: StableLM
Description: After ChatGpt, Claude or Dragonfly (available in@poe_platform), want to test a new language model? @StabilityAI (= Stable diffusion) provides StableLM in open-source, to be tested here: https://huggingface.co/spaces/stabilityai/stablelm-tuned-alpha-chat

Title: AutoGPT
Description: Would you like to discover AutoGPT (https://github.com/Significant-Gravitas/Auto-GPT…) which makes ChatGPT more autonomous without having the skills for its long installation? Two tools on display allow it: AgentGPT (https://agentgpt.reworkd.ai) and Godmode (https://godmode.space)

Title: Opus Clip
Description: Opus Clip (https://opus.pro/clip): a YouTube video (English only supported for the moment) cut in about ten minutes thanks to the AI into 10 coherent and impactful clips, resized and surtitled with possible modification.

Title: Mage
Description: http://Mage.space is an image generation tool based on Stable Diffusion. The prompt can be increased by a reference image. Many settings available, gallery with original prompts for inspiration

Title: Creative Fabrica
Description: Two AI tools dedicated to images on the same site: http://creativefabrica.com :– sparkArt: generating images from a prompt https://www.creativefabrica.com/spark/tools/art-generator/– imagemix: generating images from an existing image: https://www.creativefabrica.com/spark/tools/imagemix/

Title: Kaiber
Description: Animating a still image in a few minutes with only one image, one prompt and one chosen style… challenge taken up by https://kaiber.ai! In this test: “this bird flying” steampunk style.

Title: Open Assistant
Description: Open-assistant, a new text-generating AI model, in development and open-source, that can be helped to develop in French via tasks to be performed: https://open-assistant.io

Title: MiniGPT4
Description: When a visual model meets a language model… MiniGPT4 illustrates the image dialogue features of GPT4: a starting image becomes a source of exchange with the AI. The research project: https://minigpt-4.github.io and its demo: https://huggingface.co/spaces/Vision-CAIR/minigpt4

Title: Forefront Chat
Description: Forefront Chat (https://chat.forefront.ai): ChatGPT 3.5 and 4 free in an alpha version that allows you to create images, use “personas”, classify your exchanges and share them. Presentation in this tweet of@ForefrontAI: https://twitter.com/ForefrontAI/status/1649429139907137540

Title: Blocklade Labs
Description: A prompt to create 360-degree images in multiple styles in seconds? Meet Blockade labs: https://blockadelabs.com

Title: ChartGPT
Description: Transform data in text form into a graph in a few seconds? That’s what ChartGPT offers: https://chartgpt.dev (via @franckbodin). Several formatting possible and downloading in png format.

Title: Looseleaf / pdf.ai
Description: Looseleaf (https://looseleaf.ai) is a free tool that allows you to query pdf documents. Test carried out with “The War of the Buttons” (https://ebooksgratuits.com/pdf/pergaud_guerre_de_boutons.pdf…), a way to explore to query literary works in the public domain?

Title: MentorGPT
Description: MentorGPT (https://beta.nando.ai/Chat/mentorgpt.php) from @nando_ai: a ChatGPT with possible long answers, access to a list of “personalities” to exchange, copy of messages offered. Free beta version.

Title: ChatYoutube
Description: ChatYoutube (chatyoutube.com) of @justinliang1020 : enter the URL of a video and dialogue on its content (summary, important points, questions, conclusions…). In English but in French on the first request (can interact in a different language from the original).

Title: Aomni
Description: What if ChatGPT 4 and autoGPT were in the same tool to become a web search assistant, classify, summarize, share, etc.? That’s what http://aomni.com offers! Test on AI in education here: https://aomni.com/search/0e4d0e44-1195-46ed-b33d-9e8c484ffbf6…

Title: NovelFlow
Description: AI to support the writing of complex stories is what NovelFlow offers (https://novelflow.ai – on waiting list). Characters, environment, stories: in addition to the step-by-step writing guide, AI can be called upon at each stage.

Title: BlueWillow
Description: BlueWillow (https://bluewillow.ai) brings together several generative image AIs in a single tool and mobilizes them according to the request expressed. In beta, since Discord with /imagine, allows enlargement and variations. High quality renderings.

Title: My AI
Description: For this #uneIAparjour a chatbot based on ChatGPT, for a large and rather young and yet less “visible” audience: MyAI from @Snapchat, the “virtual friend” directly in his conversations. Fluid but sometimes vague answers and progress to be made on the school side…

Title: TutorAI
Description: A topic to explore, want to acquire new knowledge through AI? Starting with a topic presented in a few words, TutorAI (http://tutorai.me) breaks it down into modules and then into lessons accompanied by examples and quizzes.

Title: Sofabrain
Description: A specialized generative AI of images for this #uneIAparjour: SofaBrain (https://sofabrain.com), interior and exterior design! An image, the type of place, the expected style and several editable renderings produced. Inspired by school projects?

Title: Typpo
Description: Typpo (https://typpo.app) from @ScienceInc generates animated videos from dictated text. 18 designs available, some with voice modification. Free app and videos without logos or watermarks. Test under iOS.

Title: D-ID
Description: D-ID, (http://d-id.com) to create and have avatars say texts: an image from the gallery, created by the AI or its images, a script written or with the AI, a voice present or created from a file. 15 free videos.

Title: Plazmapunk
Description: A piece of music (for the http://publicdomain4u.com/new-old-music-…), a starting image (photo of the record), a prompt (musicians in front of a wooden house), a style (realistic) = a video created by Plazmapunk (http://plazmapunk.com). Alpha version, free.

Title: Loudly
Description: Loudly (https://loudly.com): AI music generation, free music bank and playlists, recommendations from a prompt and adjustment of music to video via the app. Unlimited generations and 3 free downloads.

Title: BeatBot
Description: BeatBot https://beatbot.fm: creation of short music from a prompt with voice possible. Prompt in French possible but texts in English. Editable texts.Screenshot 1: https://beatbot.fm/song/cc4f794d8629403c980105f3654bf1af… Screenshot 2: https://beatbot.fm/song/c8075fb8c9e44a38af57f02928abb621…

Title: ByeBlankPage
Description: ByeBlankPage (https://byeblankpage.ai): assistant for writing. After choosing the theme, the type of text and the reader, the AI proposes, reacts to prompts or modifies a passage. 1000 free words, to discover another tool as accomplished in the meantime?

Title: Stablecog
Description: A new image generative AI tool: Stablecog (https://stablecog.com). Several AIs including Stable diffusion available, several formats and fine options possible. Test with the now classic prompt of the record cover

Title: SongR
Description: SongR (beta, https://songr.ai): A style of music, lyrics generated by a prompt or written in the editor and a song is generated. Voice in English. Test with lyrics generated by Bing chat.

Title: Dreamlike
Description: Dreamlike (https://dreamlike.art) a new tool that brings together several generative image AI models with many options including adding initial images, negative prompt, image editing and enhancement.

Title: Exemplary
Description: Exemplary (https://exemplary.ai/fr): transcription, translation, subtitling of videos or audio and generation of text content and/or video clips from a menu or personalized prompts. Test since https://youtu.be/xRC9-kZAnBw

Title: Conversly
Description: generative AI to practice 5 languages (Spanish, French, German, Russian, Portuguese – English interface): https://conversly.ai. iOS and Android app, free, 4 conversation modes, possible dictation, grammar and spelling.

Title: Teach anything
Description: Teach anything (https://teach-anything.com): A question asked with a chosen language and answer level and an explanation is generated.

Title: GitMind
Description: GitMind (http://gitmind.com/fr/): a iOS and Android mind map app with an integrated chatbot that embeds a text-generating AI. Complete tool, sharing and collaboration possible, 10 free maps.

Title: Monica
Description: Monica (https://monica.im) a Chrome and Edge extension that embeds generative text (including GPT4) and image AIs in your browser. 40 free requests per day.

Title: Askbooks
Description: Askbooks (https://askbooks.ai) a chatbot based on a text generative AI to query books, + 2000 available in English. 20 free questions, French accepted. (Laertes’ appearances in Hamlet? Spoiler in pictures

Title: Zoo
Description: Zoo (https://zoo.replicate.dev): 7 generative AI models of images (3 stable diffusion, dall-e, kandisky, deepfloyd and material-diffusion) in the same free, account-free and open-source tool.

Title: Firefly
Description: When @Adobe launches its generative AI tools, it gives Firefly: https://firefly.adobe.com. First more than positive feedback after the tests carried out on “text to image” and “generative fill”!

Title: Maze Guru
Description: Maze Guru (https://maze.guru): web image generative AI tool, Discord or iOS and Android app. Gallery, prompt help, multiple styles. Free credits when opening (renewed every 24 hours? – 360 for me, one image = 1 to 3 credits).

Title: Marmof
Description: Marmof (https://marmof.com): a generative AI tool with nearly 50 text generation models and an image generation tool. 5000 free generated words per month.

Title: Artflow
Description: Artflow (http://artflow.ai): generative AI of images, images that can then be used to generate short videos with voice and subtitles. Prompts and texts in English to be preferred. 100 images and 30 free videos per month.

Title: Nutshell
Description: Nutshell (https://nutshellapp.com) summarizes and suggests the key points of a YouTube video. French supported, 10 video summaries up to 24 minutes per month for the free account. Test performed on this video: https://youtu.be/Qt9Yhx8vlVk

Title: OpenArt
Description: OpenArt (https://openart.ai/create): tool with 20 generative AI models of images. Possible variations and remixes, editing tools. 1000 free credits (1 image: 2 to 3 credits).

Title: Courseau
Description: Courseau (http://courseau.co): creation of courses from podcast, video, pdf or simple URL. Summary, summary, key points and quizzes. Accepts documents in French, generation in English. Test from https://edunumrech.hypotheses.org/files/2023/05/MEN_DNE_brochure_IA_WEB.pdf here https://app.courseau.co/projects/bc9c5215-63f7-448d-b483-cb2400361a86/preview

Title: The infinite drum machine
Description: The infinite drum machine (https://experiments.withgoogle.com/ai/drum-machine/…): when AI classifies and maps everyday sounds autonomously to generate configurable beats. Open source. Video by its authors employed by Google: https://youtu.be/9x-_My5yjQY

Title: Fini
Description: A chatbot with a personalized knowledge base under ChatGPT from a list of URLs: Fini (http://usefini.com). Access via waiting list. In the free account, the chatbot remains “private”. Tested from school programs.

Title: Todobot
Description: Todobot (http://todobot.ai) improves to-do lists thanks to AI. Inputs are analyzed by AI which proposes reformulations or ways to improve comprehension. Subtasks and follow-up possible. Free and French supported.

Title: Albus
Description: Albus (http://albus.org): a table generated to explore a subject via ChatGPT. Elements that can be arranged and modified. 3 entries: explore, study, teach. Free beta. French ok, in English. Test: https://beta.albus.org/preview/AEF7347B…

Title: Aitubo
Description: Aitubo (http://aitubo.ai): tool bringing together several image-generating AI models and editing tool. 150 free credits when opened, then 50 per day.

Title: BookHero
Description: A prompt, a character, a character trait and a place: BookHero (http://bookhero.ai) takes care of writing a story. iOS and Android, 3 stories and 3 readings from the gallery per month (specify “write in French” in the prompt).

Title: Kreado
Description: Kreado (https://kreadoai.com): from text generation to the production of a video with avatar and synthetic voice. 140 languages, 70 avatars, 10 voices. Free up to 800 characters. Test to download here: https://aigc-cdn.kreadoai.com/digitalhuman/results/2023/6/dede912a095611eea8946e99500b0616.mp4

Title: Learnt
Description: Learnt (http://learnt.ai): 40 AI tools for educators, from icebreaker generation to lesson plans to fun activities. Accepts French but generates in English. 5000 free tokens (1 word = 1 token)

Title: Decktopus
Description: Decktopus (http://decktopus.com): presentation generation tool, many templates, text and image generation, editing. 100 free generations. Supports French, English generation. Test here: http://decktop.us/jBEBg-VhV

Title: MusicGen
Description: MusicGen from Facebook is in demo on Huggingface (https://huggingface.co/spaces/facebook/MusicGen): a prompt with a piece of music as possible inspiration and MusicGen generates a music.

Title: Leap
Description: Leap (https://tryleap.ai) free AI tool for image generics. 6 different models for image generation and remix (a base image loaded with a prompt), prompt possible negative, and training of its own model.

Title: Meyer
Description: Meyer (http://meyer.id) generates stories with images, voices, and subtitles. Accepts and generates in French if specified, voice on English model. Tests:– EN: https://meyer.id/?videoId=2029– FR: https://meyer.id/?videoId=2030

Title: Hypotenuse
Description: Hypotenuse (https://hypotenuse.ai), generative AI tools to help with writing: 20 models for text (blog, networks, summary, rewriting…) and one for images. 7 days free. Test for a blog post: https://share.hypotenuse.ai/article/470c6c46-28e0-495c-9e8a-3199cda7ef87

Title: Patience
Description: Patience (http://patience.ai): A tool that includes 100 generative AI models of images. Negative prompt and base image possible. 200 free credits or completely free if waiting in line.

Title: Studyflow
Description: Studyflow (https://aceflow.org): a single page, two columns and two buttons to be questioned without limits on the subject of your choice. Free and without account. Accepts French but questions and validation in English.

Title: Muzaic Studio
Description: On this June 21st, #uneIAparjour generative music! Muzaic Studio (https://muzaic.studio/) sets your videos to music: a loaded video, choice of styles, settings and music is created. Test with this video http://pixabay.com/fr/videos/vill… and sound in 3rd image. 1 hour free per month.

Title: Breeze
Description: Breeze (http://breeze.ai) erases the background of a photo and replaces it with the one described in a prompt. Two modes: “themes” generated by AI models and “customize” for finer generation. Tests with this image: https://commons.m.wikimedia.org/wiki/Category:Rock_music#/media/File%3AChristian-haffkrug.jpg

Title: Gamma
Description: Gamma (http://gamma.app) generates presentations, documents or web pages with a prompt and a theme. Collaboration and editing possible. 400 free credits (40 per generation). Tests: https://gamma.app/docs/Les-IA-generatives-en-education-usages-atouts-et-limites-kpguosdz6lgzkkc… and https://gamma.app/docs/Les-IA-generatives-en-education-ze2z4qr4le4zdxs…

Title: Bright Eye
Description: Bright Eye (https://apps.apple.com/us/app/bright-eye/id1593932475): A free iOS text and image generator app that offers AI-based mini apps.

Title: TeacherToolsGPT
Description: TeacherToolsGPT (https://teachertoolsgpt.com): generative AI tools to support the teacher. Generation of letters, sequences, sessions, classroom management aids, quizzes, etc. In English but accepts French.

Title: Eluna
Description: Eluna (https://eluna.ai): several generative AIs in the same tool, online or on iOS: generation, change or mix of images, removal of the background etc. 15 free credits (few… but allows the test).Image Wikimedia https://commons.m.wikimedia.org/wiki/Category:Rock_music#/media/File%3AChristian-haffkrug.jpg

Title: Curipod
Description: While waiting for the AI and Education Day proposed by Réseau Canopé demain (https://reseau-canope.fr/intelligence-artificielle.html), a tool dedicated to teachers for this #uneIAparjour : Curipod (https://curipod.com), generation of activities and presentations that can be modified and shared.

Title: QuickCast
Description: To follow the day #IAeduc #IAecole of @reseau_canope, a text-generating AI tool presented today by @Jul_Dum and @j0annamarques: QuickCast (http://quickcast.lol), free and without the need for account (GPT4 and Bard announced, down for this test)

Title: Stockimg QRcode
Description: Personalized QR codes with an image generated by a prompt? Stockimg (image generation – paid) offers it in its new tool: https://stockimg.ai/qrcode/. 5 free generations without account. Prefer English and be inspired by examples.

Title: Imaginary Soundscape
Description: Imaginary Soundscape (https://imaginarysoundscape.net): an image and the AI offers music to accompany it. Free and without account. 3 tests (Wikimedia and personal image):⁃ https://imaginarysoundscape.net/view/eUZmWGlwSkxLckpKTw/Mzc4MDUxXzIzNDE5ODRfMA/v2.0…⁃ https://imaginarysoundscape.net/view/eTRGZ09vczBNUEpKTw/ZGU1MDBiNjQ/v2.0…” https://imaginarysoundscape.net/view/MDRGVWlYOGU3dUlJbg/NDhiY2YzOWQ/v2.0…

Title: Sttatbot
Description: Sttabot (https://app.sttabot.io) allows you to transform a prompt into a personalized chatbot. Test around cycle 3 programs available here: https://app.sttabot.io/bot/programmes/ Infinite number of bots in the free version, paid customization.

Title: Longshot
Description: Longshot (https://longshot.ai): about twenty tools preformatted from a generative AI of text, including “FactGPT” which promises to offer current content and verified sources. 100 free credits (=5 generations). Test on an AI training.

Title: Twee
Description: Twee (http://twee.com): 30 text generative AI tools to support teachers. Tools linked together and can act on the previous generation. Image to text supported. Free beta, in English (prompts in French ok).

Title: Piggy
Description: Piggy (https://piggy.to): free iOS and Android app for generating text content, quizzes and summaries with editing tool, numerous templates, layout tool. Export social networks, image and video.

Title: Pollination
Description: Pollinations (https://pollinations.ai -> https://replicate.com/pollinations): generative AI of images free and without account. An image gallery, a location for a prompt and an image is generated (one per prompt). Tests with the often used prompt of the album cover.

Title: Aizzy
Description: Aizzy (http://aizzy.ai): one generative AI of text and one of images in the same tool with several chatbots, querying pdfs, videos or sites and generating images. Free with limited number (not specified not visible during the test).

Title: Wordtune
Description: Wordtune (http://wordtune.com), text generative AI tool with pre-formatted generations (continue, explain, define, give examples…) and reformulation. No generation limit in the test in the free version (3 reformulations/day)

Title: Clipdrop
Description: Clipdrop (https://clipdrop.co) brings together several tools dedicated to images that use AI. Three in particular generate images: Stable diffusion XL, Reimagine XL and Uncrop (in order of capture).

Title: StoryD
Description: StoryD (http://storyd.ai) accompanies the creation of a presentation: from a given topic, an editable script is proposed with reformulation and text by AI, images, graphs, lists etc. Free 30 days. Test: https://app.storyd.ai/story/b40adab3-8e28-41ee-97cd-f5371044808b/slides…

Title: Ipic
Description: Ipic (https://ipic.ai): a free and account-free image generative AI (given the tests, based on Stable diffusion?). Up to 5 variations, several image sizes. Public gallery.

Title: Re-Art
Description: Re-art (https://reart.devvinay.in) by @vinay_dev_: AI tool that generates images, free and without account (based on Stable diffusion?).

Title: Veed.io
Description: A video editing tool with generative #AI tools accessible from a browser? http://veed.io adds the voice-over, produces the subtitles, translates them etc. 10 min of free video, (generation of titles, summaries + others in paid version).

Title: Color anything
Description: A generative AI of images for summer or back-to-school, for young or old: https://color-anything.com which, from a prompt, offers a coloring page to print or download. Prompt in English preferred. Free and without account.

Title: Draw Things
Description: Draw Things (https://drawthings.ai): StabbleDiffusion and 45 generative AI models of offline #images, app iOS. Text / image to image, editing tools, fine-tuning. Free and without account. Prompt in English. + : steps followed live / – : very long

Title: Framer
Description: Framer (https://framer.com): creation of a responsive and hosted site (landpage) from a simple prompt. The generated elements are then editable. Result of a test without editing: https://ia-generatives-en-education.framer.ai

Title: Coursebox
Description: Coursebox (http://coursebox.ai) generates courses with quizzes, fully editable. 3 free courses, progress tracking, comments possible. Test to discover here: https://my.coursebox.ai/#/courses/7706/about… (registration required)

Title: Stable Doodle
Description: Stable Doodle (https://clipdrop.co/stable-doodle and presentation by @StabilityAI: https://stability.ai/blog/clipdrop-launches-stable-doodle…) generates images from a line art, a prompt and a style. Free, first generation without account.

Title: Genmo
Description: Genmo (https://genmo.ai) is a tool with several generative AI models of images accessible with possible editing via a chatbot: image, video, 3D and 360, gif. Alpha version, 100 free credits per day (10 generations), live generation

Title: Ora
Description: Ora (http://ora.ai) allows the creation of a chatbot based on specialized ChatGPT, from a simple description (specify its exclusive theme). Free with account. Test on generative AI: https://ora.ai/excess-gray-ucsz/iaedubot-… (account required).

Title: Scispace
Description: Scispace (typeset.io) is a search engine specialising in scientific texts (250 million, 50 million of which are open access). It relies on AI to generate explanations, summaries and connections.

Title: Pathfinder
Description: Pathfinder (https://www.summit.im/pathfinder) offers a detailed strategy for achieving its goals after describing the goal, success criteria, status, and context. In English but accepts French.

Title: Reemix
Description: Reemix (Reemix.co) generates short videos with music from a prompt. Generation possible without account, the connection allows the download, sharing with profile and “remix” of two videos. A test here: https://reemix.co/v/sPirFKSibPsza

Title: AI Dungeon
Description: A text-based role-playing game entirely generated by AI? This is the successful bet of http://aidungeon.com (web, IOS and Android): one story per prompt, the one created by the AI or the shared ones, hours of possible gameplay! In EN, answer in FR accepted.

Title: Diffit
Description: Edit on 13/11/2024:Diffit (https://app.diffit.me/) offers to transform the generated course into activities for pupils/students.

Title: Learnbot
Description: Learnbot (https://apps.apple.com/my/app/learnbot-pro-annual/id6448216859…): iOS app with text generative AI (ChatGPT?) dedicated to teaching. Direct prompts or suggestions. 50000 free “tokens” per month (10000 used for tests).

Title: LLAMA
Description: Want to test Llama2, @MetaAI’s open-source model? 3 tools discovered:– @a16z demo: https://llama2.ai (with account)– demo of Huggingface https://huggingface.co/spaces/ysharma/Explore_llamav2_with_TGI… (without account)– http://llama.perplexity.ai (without account – seems + fast)

Title: Minerva
Description: Minerva (https://academicid.net/minerva-ai) searches through 200M scientific publications and allows them to be queried. 15000 free credits per month.

Title: Dezgo
Description: Dezgo (https://dezgo.com), several tools dedicated to image generation including text to image with 15 templates, image to image, inpainting to change elements, with many settings (text to video in beta on Discord). Account not mandatory.

Title: MagicSchool
Description: MagicSchool (https://www.magicschool.ai/) has 45 preformatted text generator tools and a chatbot for teachers (list in the images). Free with account. French ok but answers in English (some in FR)

Title: Illustroke
Description: A simple prompt in English, choice of style, colors and background and Illustroke (https://illustroke.com) generates an svg or png illustration. Variations and simple editing possible. One token free, others offered on network subscription.

Title: Zeroscope
Description: Zeroscope Text-to-video (to be found on Huggingface: https://huggingface.co/spaces/fffiloni/zeroscope…): a prompt for a short 16:9 format video. No account.

Title: OpenChat
Description: OpenChat (https://openchat.so): a chatbot Chat GPT that is based on the web or pdf documents provided. 10 web or pdf pages per data source in free version. To test with the cycle 3 web and pdf programs: https://cloud.openchat.so/chat/6n8CjLv8RRhjHV9ZmoKE…

Title: Pixai
Description: Pixai (https://pixai.art), anime-oriented image generation tool that offers several more classic models. Multiple settings, enlargement, variation, editing, gallery. 10000 free credits/day (remove the high priority box consumes -)

Title: Sendsteps
Description: Sendsteps (http://sendsteps.com) generates presentations with notes from a prompt. Quizzes, questions and interactive word clouds possible. 2 presentations of 10 pages and in English in the free version. Test: http://web.sendsteps.com/claim?shareKey

Title: Hello History
Description: Hello History (https://hellohistory.ai) invites us to dialogue with a hundred historical personalities: literature, pop culture, philosophy, arts, psychology, science… Available on iOS and Android, 20 free messages then subscription.

Title: Promind
Description: Promind (http://promind.ai) is a text generation tool based on ChatGPT (3.5 and 4) and predefined templates. 199 free “tokens” per day, useful number for each production varies according to demand. A test here: https://codimd.apps.education.fr/FqIQ7Vs3QfSt0dtsjVw0BA?view

Title: AiPage
Description: AiPage (http://AiPage.dev): a prompt and a home page in HTML is generated. Direct modifications possible, export HTML. Opensource and without account. Generated HTML code for the test: https://codimd.apps.education.fr/0M2q828tRfuLw9Tm6j6sjQ

Title: Conker
Description: Conker (http://conker.ai): a quiz generation tool with multiple-choice questions, fill-in-the-blank texts, rankings, etc. Editing, French, export, sharing and tracking of answers, voice synthesis. 5 free quizzes. Test: https://app.conker.ai/forms/cexjnc/view

Title: Skolar
Description: Skolar (https://skolar.ai): a search engine for scientific articles supported by a text generative AI. Chatbot, text classification, summarizes and creates citations… Integrated basic word processing. 5 free searches per month.

Title: Cami
Description: Cami (https://heycami.ai): a chatbot with #exte models (GPT4) and images (stable broadcasting) in Whatsapp, with audio transcription. Free, 5 images/day and 10 generations of text, more than surpassed in this test: https://codimd.apps.education.fr/ZJYmjC8SSEmCxfZsNgkpxw?view

Title: Skillify
Description: Skillify (https://skillify-ai.com): personalized learning programs with generated courses, chatbot, text on the chosen topic, book summary and quiz generation. Free credits every day. Test with 4 courses: https://codimd.apps.education.fr/ABgGFjQ5RqaXUYpq25ftsw?view

Title: Talknotes
Description: Talknotes (https://talknotes.io): a voice note with a defined style (2nd capture) and a text is generated after transcription in the form of a note. Add/delete possible, free with some premium functions (+ limit on the number of notes?)

Title: Hayo
Description: Hayo (https://hayo.com/download), a mobile and computer application with text and image generators (several templates for each), free or preformatted prompts, document analysis, voice synthesis… 50 free text credits and 50 free image credits per day.

Title: Tensor
Description: Tensor (https://tensor.art) brings together about forty generative image AI models with editing tools (remix, enlargement, image to image, details). Gallery for inspiration. 100 free credits per day (1 image: 1 to 3 credits during the test).

Title: Vaizz
Description: Vaizz (http://vaizz.ai): tool for generating stories, voice and video, the 3 of which can be linked. 60 free credits per month (the tracking of credits not found during the tests). Source Wikipedia for voice test.

Title: Semantic Scholar
Description: Semantic Scholar (http://semanticscholar.org) uses AI in its search engine for scientific articles (200M database) and makes links between articles. Accepts FR, filters, personal backup. Free, open code and data, publications.

Title: Lesson Planner
Description: Lesson Planner (https://lessonplanner.ph): a sequence of lessons generated from a template (those proposed: https://researchgate.net/publication/349975159_An_Experimental_Study_Regarding_Impact_of_7E’s_Instructional_Model_Based_Instructions_upon_Student’s_Attitude_towards_Physical_Education_Subject_at_Higher_Secondary_School_Level…), a subject, a level and objectives. 10 free generations, FR ok generation in EN. Review: https://codimd.apps.education.fr/jK_4F_UKRlqjN6KxZmjrNg…

Title: Artemis
Description: A hero, a place and a quest: Artemis (https://artemisapp.ai) generates an illustrated story from Chat GPT 4 and Leonardo ai. In EN, app iOS, 3 free stories. 2 tests with the same base: https://app.artemisapp.ai/story/QmdFWhVRhAh4GAqe4lus… and https://app.artemisapp.ai/story/CwWcihfaNgLMJ5j1vWO3…

Title: IconAI
Description: IconAI (iconai.co) generates icons from a prompt, one of 18 available styles and one dominant color. 10 free images, remix possible from an existing image.

Title: Human generator
Description: After a choice of options to define body, clothing, background with possible prompt that specifies, Human generator (https://generated.photos/human-generator) generates the image of a human, 1 figurine or fictional character. Free and without account, free use outside of commercial.

Title: Goblin Tools
Description: Goblin Tools (https://goblin.tools), and its “Magic to do”, uses AI to generate lists from a prompt. Free, no account (except for sync), editing and export possible. 5 other generation tools available.

Title: Landingsite
Description: Landingsite (http://landingsite.ai) creates a web page from a title, a description and a template. Commerce-oriented but editable with free image bank. Free and hosted for one page. Test: https://les-ia-gnratives-en-ducation.getlandingsite.com

Title: Imagica
Description: Imagica (http://imagica.ai – beta waiting list): no-code tool for creating apps that generates content from defined commands. Tested with the creation of 1 peda session generation app with course, video and quiz: http://s.imagica.ai/e/NjlFAWdgvCb

Title: Transvibe
Description: Transvibe (https://transvribe.com) allows the querying of a YouTube video via a chatbot. Transcript export possible. Free and without account.

Title: Bloombot
Description: Bloombot (https://chat.bloombot.ai): a chatbot dedicated to personalized learning through questioning and dialogue, with each answer bringing a new question. Visible pre-answer path for the user. Free and without account.

Title: Ideogram
Description: Ideogram (https://ideogram.ai): image generation tool capable of including the requested text in the prompt. Gallery offered and remix possible. Free.

Title: Artsio
Description: Artsio (https://artsio.xyz/create): image generation tool with 5 templates, fine adjustments, remix, image to image, enlargement and sharing gallery. 20 free images per day.

Title: Flair
Description: Flair (http://flair.ai) stages objects from defined parameters by erasing the background to generate new ones. Editing tools available and adding elements. 30 free images. Image for testing: https://unsplash.com/fr/photos/AmOm6BDUcMM…

Title: Hix
Description: Hix (http://hix.ai) brings together 120 Chatgpt-based text generation tools specialized for blogging, social networks, writing long texts, summaries, translation. 3000 free words/month. An example with the text editor: https://hix.ai/d/clly5d5pi0073ocmpzhk4brvh…

Title: PrepSup
Description: PrepSup (https://prepsup.com) supports the learning of a concept through the generation of flashcards and the conversation with a dedicated chatbot. Feeding possible from imported pdfs or by written Q&A

Title: Audiopen
Description: Audiopen (https://audiopen.ai): transcribed and formatted audio notes. Translates, summarizes, transforms text into images for sharing… 10 notes of 3 min in free version. Test with audio FR to text EN, source: https://ai4t.eu/book/ia-pour-les-enseignants–un-manuel-ouvert-1/reflection?path=why-learn-about-artificial-intelligence

Title: Segmind
Description: Segmind (https://segmind.com) brings together about fifty generative AI models of open-source images including Stable diffusion or Kandinsky. Includes QR Code generation and an image to image mode. Free (and unlimited?), API possible

Title: Lex
Description: A word processor with a ChatGPT-based assistant? Lex (http://Lex.page): commands accessible by a single shortcut, editing tools, integrated chatbot and shareable documents. Free. Test here: https://lex.page/read/532c6af1-9b1c-480c-8108-550fe5fb6e12… via @yannhoury

Title: 5 minutes lesson plan
Description: “5 minutes lesson plan” (http://5minutelessonplan.co.uk) generates sessions of 30 to 90 minutes from a simple form. Accepts French but generates in English. PDF export and dashboard. Free for 15 days.

Title: Doc Analyser
Description: Doc Analyser (https://docanalyzer.ai) allows you to query pdf documents via a chatbot. Cites your sources in documents. 3 files can be imported for free per day. Test from cycle 3 programs.

Title: Puzzicle
Description: Puzzicle (https://buildalesson.org) generates quizzes from YouTube (Wikipedia in beta). Free, 6 types of questions, editing, integrated quizzes, answer tracking, h5p export. FR accepted but not for generation. Test: https://develop.buildalesson.org/play/gosscdgpvx

Title: ChatNBX
Description: ChatNBX (https://chat.nbox.ai): a chatbot with several language models available (GPT 4 down during the test). Query pdf up to 2MB. Public sharing and copying of answers. Free with (ChatGPT) or without account (Llama and others)

Title: Vidnoz
Description: Vidnoz (https://vidnoz.com) animates and makes avatars speak from the text provided. Possibility to import your own image or generate the avatar. Text of 300 words and 3 min of generation in free version. (Wikipedia for the text of the test)

Title: Logicballs
Description: Logicballs (https://logicballs.com): a Swiss Army knife that offers more than 150 text-generating apps. Titles, ideas, full text, tone, summary, grammar, stories, lyrics… Free with account, apparently without limitation

Title: Video Highlight
Description: Video Highlight (https://videohighlight.com) allows transcription, summary and questions to a chatbot from a YouTube video. Archiving, easy copying of texts, sharing possible. Perfectible in French but already useful. Free.

Title: My Lesson Pal
Description: My Lesson Pal (https://mylessonpal.com): a tool for generating educational sessions with 6 types of generation. Test of the 6: https://codimd.apps.education.fr/h6-Pa2qITF6U-DI0khZ3Rw…. Accepts FR, generation in EN (sometimes in FR). Free and without account.

Title: Suno
Description: Suno (https://suno.ai – beta on discord): a text pasted or generated by ChatGPT, a style of music and 2 tracks are created (extendable). 50 languages supported including French. Free. Tests since https://gallica.bnf.fr/ark:/12148/bpt6k70861t/f149.item.zoom

Title: Botpress
Description: A chatbot based on ChatGPT created for its own uses? Botpress (https://botpress.com) creates it with site or document feeding. Fully configurable, tracking data and integration on sites or messengers. 1000 free requests/month.

Title: Stable Audio
Description: Audio Stable (Tabledio.com): a prompt and the 1st audio generation tool of @StabilityAI creates an instrumental piece of music. Not always melodious, seems + accurate in EN than in FR. 20 tracks of 45 s. in mp3 / month in free version.

Title: Magma Tutor
Description: Magma Tutor (magmatutor.com by MAGMA Learning, Switzerland) accompanies learning from a subject, text, pdf or video with multiple-choice questions and fill-in-the-blank texts. Searchable answers, progress tracking. Free account with simple generation.

Title: Learn.xyz
Description: Learn.xyz, an app iOS / Google Play, offers a bank of topics developed by AI in 5 short pages + 1 quiz. A subject does not exist, the AI creates it. Incentive to 1 topic per day with the longest possible sequence. Rather in EN. Free.

Title: Ask2end
Description: Ask2end (ask2end.com): a question asked on a given topic, Ask2End answers it and then produces a new question/answer until the questions it is able to generate are exhausted. Based on ChatGPT. Free without account and open-source.

Title: Noowai
Description: Noowai (https://noowai.com) a chatbot based on an OpenAI text generative AI (see 2nd screenshot). Free and without account (an ad may appear at the top of the page at startup).

Title: Eduaide
Description: Eduaide (https://eduaide.ai): a multiple tool for the teacher’s assistant. More than 100 types of defined generations, lesson plan, class activities, correction of copies, emails, chatbot, quiz generator… Beta, free and unlimited.

Title: Chatmind
Description: Chatmind (chatmind.tech/fr) is a tool for generating mind maps from chatGPT. 5 to 6 free generations per day. Maps not editable in the trial version but xmind export offered.

Title: CapCut “text to image”
Description: CapCut (https://capcut.com), a video editor widely used for social network content, has added the “text to image” function (“edit” menu) to its tools. Free and unlimited with configuration and prompt bank.

Title: FlashcardX
Description: FlashcardX (https://ai.flashcardx.com) creates flash cards from copied and pasted text. Free, open-source and account not mandatory. Source for the test: AI monitoring bulletin@reseau_canope : https://reseau-canope.fr/fileadmin/user_upload/Projets/agence_des_usages/6855_BulletinVeille_1ia.pdf…

Title: Qreative
Description: Qreative (https://www.qreative.ai/): QR code creation with image generation from a prompt. Several templates, styles and formats. ChatGPT helps with the formulation of prompts. Free, beta version on waiting list.

Title: Zeebra
Description: Zeebra (http://zeebra.ai) translates and dubs imported or YouTube videos in 27 languages. Via Discord. Unlimited alpha version. Test with CC BY @FlowersINRIA video: http://youtu.be/K8gOvC8gvB4 in JP and EN: http://zeebra.ai/dub/9d58e4bf-a

Title: Magicast
Description: Magicast (https://magicast.ai) generates the audio presentation of a given topic in the manner of a podcast episode. FR accepted but generates in EN. Free. Test: https://magicast.ai/share?castid=-NfHyAeanUpVNuGSosmm… (Generation in FR not mastered, e.g. https://magicast.ai/share?castid=-NfHzPxbp6f3ADjp65qR…)

Title: Andisearch
Description: Andisearch (https://andisearch.com) is a free and account-free search engine with a generative AI of text: targeted results, summarizes, explains, advanced natural language search, reader… Open external pages without trackers.

Title: AcademicGPT
Description: AcademicGPT (https://academicgpt.net) helps to write “academic” texts from a pdf. Several tools offered (1st capture). A chatbot allows you to refine the answers given. Generates in EN but translated on demand. Free.

Title: Babs
Description: Babs (https://babs.ai): a chatbot for Telegram that allows you to query documents, summarize them and answer quizzes generated from these docs. EN but accepts FR. Free. Test with prog. cycle 3 and https://education.gouv.fr/strategie-du-numerique-pour-l-education-2023-2027-344263

Title: Chromox
Description: Chromox (https://chromox.alkaidvision.com) transforms a prompt into a short video. Public and live generations. Possibility to feed the prompt with image or video, remix of prompts from all generations. Sharing, gallery. Free in beta version.

Title: Dall-e 3
Description: Dall-e 3 (https://openai.com/dall-e-3) is now available in Bing Chat – Copilot (and since https://www.bing.com/images/create): the text requested in the prompt can now be generated in the produced image. Free. Via @AlainGoudey.

Title: Stretch
Description: Stretch (https://stretch.education) offers to explore a subject visually via an “infinite” bubble mind map. Several levels of complexity available for exploration adapted to the level of knowledge. Free and without account.

Title: EducatorLab
Description: EducatorLab (https://educatorlab.org) generates session plans and pedagogical activities from a short form. Export in doc and pdf. 5 free generations and some uncredited beta generations.

Title: Notedly
Description: Notedly (https://notedly.ai) summarizes and gives the key points of a copy/pasted text, a loaded document, a site or YouTube video. Possible dialogue with a chatbot on these documents. PDF export proposed. 10000 words generated per month free.

Title: GptBeaver
Description: A chatbot customized in minutes from a prompt and accessible via a simple URL? Meet GptBeaver (https://gptbeaver.com)! Free. Tested here: https://gptbeaver.com/chat/formateurIA…

Title: Flush AI
Description: Flush AI (http://flushai.cloud) generates images from 6 models or models imported from http://civitai.com. Fine-tuning possible. Beta version, 100 free builds per month.

Title: TeacherAIde
Description: TeacherAIde (https://teachersaide.io) generates session plans/schedules, experiments, evaluations and emails. FR accepted but in EN. Free.Ex:

Title: Shortbread
Description: Shortbread (http://shortbread.ai) generates comic / manga or webtoon boards from a prompt. Choice of page template, editable images, access to editable prompts, texts and speech bubbles. 50 free generations (board or image).

Title: Llava
Description: Llava (https://llava.hliu.cc) or when a generative AI describes the images. Free, unlimited and open-source. Dialogue possible thanks to the chatbot. Project page: https://llava-vl.github.io . Images for the test: https://pixabay.com/fr/photos/nageur-baignade-route-rue-1678307/… and #triptober

Title: CourseGen
Description: CourseGen (https://coursegen.ai) generates online courses (text only) from a simple prompt. 2 courses generated for free. Test to be found here: https://coursegen.ai/course/048866bc-0411-462a-b94f-defab47c4e8b…

Title: Waveformer
Description: Waveformer (https://waveformer.replicate.dev) generates a piece of music for up to 30 sec from a prompt, based on MusicGen. Export audio or video, url for sharing.

Title: Zapt
Description: Zapt (http://zapt.ai): creation of web applications based on ChatGPT from templates or from a prompt. Standalone apps accessible via URL and catalog. Free (and unlimited?). Test here: https://app.zapt.ai/deployed-app/4778e9b8-94f1-4a7b-a574-e83f64108aaa…

Title: Zizoto
Description: Zizoto (https://zizoto.com) generates images with Stable Diffusion SDXL from a iOS or Android app. Remix images, gallery, share with visible prompts and follow other users. Free (with paid image printing)

Title: Aiva
Description: Aiva (http://aiva.ai) generates music up to 3 minutes in the free version (3 phones/month). Advanced editor, unlimited generations, radios, Windows/Mac/Linux app. Tests: https://creators.aiva.ai/publicPlayer?c=652ba0446fda29a03abcaed0 and https://creators.aiva.ai/publicPlayer?c=652c4342bef58b3564dc33a

Title: Copula
Description: Copula (http://copula.ai) allows exchange with pdf, .doc, txt, HTML and web pages. Docs up to 2000p. announced. Free and without account. Tests from https://edunumrech.hypotheses.org/9934 / https://reseau-canope.fr/agence-des-usages/intelligence-artificielle.html… / cycle 3 programs.Can sometimes go beyond the scope of the document, make it clear that the request concerns the loaded document.

Title: SimpleGPT
Description: SimpleGPT (https://asakura42.github.io/SimpleGPT): chatGPT and AgentGPT (“auto mode”) in the same tool, free, without account and open-source. A first ChatGPT and (long) generation capture of AgentGPT tested on the same prompt: https://codimd.apps.education.fr/7EJGKCMLRjGt-tFV7aqwjw

Title: Moonvalley
Description: Moonvalley (https://moonvalley.ai): a prompt, a style, a duration and a video is generated. In beta version on discord, free and unlimited. The generation can be long, activate notifications or go through the search “mentions:yournickname”.

Title: Storybooks
Description: Storybooks (http://storybooks.app) generates stories from a prompt. In the free version, 3 image styles, 3 activities, age, language + adaptation for children with special needs. Test: https://www.storybooks.app/story/JhEeCQcECu and https://www.storybooks.app/story/QEhnqILMyx

Title: Lensgo
Description: Lensgo (https://lensgo.ai) generates images and videos (often psychedelic in the tests ;). Several styles and sizes possible, movement for videos, possibility to create and train your own models. Free beta (unlimited?).

Title: Teachmate
Description: Teachmate (https://teachmateai.com) offers tools dedicated to teachers, 11 of which are freely accessible (in yellow). Accepts FR but generates in EN. Tests:

Title: ShortVideoGen
Description: ShortVideoGen (https://shortgen.video) generates short videos with music (max 12s) from a prompt. Choice of the number of frames/sec. 5 free generations. Tests at 3, 12, 24 frames to be found here. On the other hand, we can see the source of the data!

Title: Pitchgrade
Description: Pitchgrade (https://pitchgrade.com) generates the outline of a presentation in text version from a prompt and the target audience. 180 languages and 300 presentation templates available. Export to txt format.

Title: Pi
Description: Pi (http://pi.ai / @heypi_ai) the “empathetic” chatbot, ranging from general knowledge to more personal answers, is now connected (with hallucinations ;). Free, online, on iOS and in dm on messengers, with audio.

Title: Morph Studio
Description: Morph Studio (https://morphstudio.xyz) creates short videos from a prompt via Discord. Adding details and multiple generations from the same prompt possible. Creating memes and cartoon images with 2 other bots. Free with account Discord.

Title: Xmind Copilot
Description: Xmind Copilot (https://xmind.ai): Xmind in AI version. Create cards with a prompt, an existing card, a Markdown document, write articles from the card. 5000 free tokens (= a card). A few words badly generated in FR.

Title: Courses
Description: Courses (https://courses.ai) offers a free version of the text version to be sent by email, from the title to the writing of the lessons and the registration page. In EN, most often accepts and generates in FR.

Title: Imagine.art
Description: Imagine (https://imagine.art) generates images from 30 templates and 80 styles. Image to image, prompt help, remix, deletion / regeneration on a part of an image… 4 free every 4 hours or access via pub, webapp / discord / iOS / android

Title: Idefics
Description: Idefics (https://huggingface.co/spaces/HuggingFaceM4/idefics_playground…), a visual language model, answers questions asked on images. Accepts FR, answer in EN. Free, open-source. Test sources: https://remonterletemps.ign.fr/ and https://fr.wikipedia.org/

Title: The Visualizer
Description: The Visualizer (https://www.thevisualizer.ai/) transforms a subject into an “infinite” map, each point can be expanded in turn or rearranged. Export to image via right button. Free, account-free and unlimited with GPT 3.5 in its simple text version.

Title: Feedback
Description: Feedback (http://feedback.gotlearning.com) offers feedback on texts or copies uploaded (1500 words). Pre-prompts in EN, answers in FR if prompt written. Free, 100 queries/day. Test with corrected baccalaureate philosophy @philomag: https://www.philomag.com/articles/corriges-du-bac-philo-filiere-generale-vouloir-la-paix-est-ce-vouloir-la-justice

Title: Education Genius
Description: Education Genius (https://educationgenius.io) brings together 45 tools to support teachers from idea generation to evaluation. Interface (almost in FR and generation in FR. 20000 free words per month (via “beta user” package in membership).

Title: Game generator
Description: Game generator (https://game-generator.com) creates graphic elements for video game environments (prompt other types of video games).

Title: Distillery
Description: Distillery (https://followfox.ai): image generation tool with 100 templates available (https://distillery-dev.github.io/site/Parameters/lora/lora/#loras-for-sd-15-models…). Image augmentation and enhancement, 10 free requests per day on Discord.

Title: Pantheon
Description: Pantheon (https://pantheon-ai.com) is a #chatbot that allows you to dialogue via “projects” made up of our own loaded sources and “personas”, existing or created. Free with a paid version. Source for testing: https://canotech.fr/a/35578/les-intelligences-artificielles-generatives…

Title: Easy-Peasy
Description: Easy-Peasy (https://easy-peasy.ai) brings together chatbot with possible personas, writing tools, analysis in documents and websites, audio transcription and image creation. 3000 words, 5 images, 1 transcription per month in free version.

Title: HistoryGPT
Description: HistoryGPT (https://historygpt.art) writes history “books” based on a topic that is broken down into chapters. Dialogue is possible with each chapter generated via a chatbot. 5 free generations, 6 languages including French.

Title: Magicwrite
Description: Magicwrite (https://magicwrite.netlify.app) is a free, non-account generative text application. Generation is sometimes limited in length and without any interaction with the proposed text.

Title: TextCortex
Description: TextCortex (http://textcortex.com) is a customizable chatbot: Sophios and GPT4 LLMs, defined models, customizable database, prompt help, speech synthesis. 20 free generations per day. source for the test: https://collimateur.uqam.ca/a-la-une/la-taxonomie-de-bloom-revisitee-a-lere-de-lia/

Title: Debaters
Description: If IAusages and IAlimites debate in an app, what is left? Debaters (https://debaters.ai) engages in a dialogue between 2 personas defined by prompt and character trait. FR if prompt FR. 1 free debate. Review: https://debaters.ai/blogs/les-ia-generatives-en-education-de-nombreux-usages-vs-les-ia-generatives-en-education-surtout-des-limites-1699556128…

Title: Books by Ai
Description: Books by Ai (https://booksbyai.app) generates ChatGPT-based books from a prompt. Free with paid download. Shareable but not editable. 9 generation languages. Search for other public books. Test: https://booksbyai.app/uKzv0MTLPm0GgBLR/…

Title: AI presentation maker
Description: AI presentation maker (https://wepik.com/ai-presentations…) generates presentations for free with choice of tone, language and number of slides. Multiple editing, image or pdf export. Creation of texts and images by AI included. Test: https://wepik.com/share/9a9709a5-1934-4384-918d-671767d31fd5#rs=link

Title: Cassette
Description: Cassette (https://cassetteai.com) generates 3 pieces of music or sound effects of 3 min /month in its free version (non-commercial use and public sharing). Help with prompt and editing. Tests: https://cassetteai.com/audioplayer?cassetteId=b6f8430a-f402-46b2-9216-2bf4f0e74450… / https://cassetteai.com/audioplayer?cassetteId=67ac4b32-7167-4f8c-8684-ac04b846d206…

Title: Mobirise
Description: Mobirise (https://ai.mobirise.com) generates a web page from a prompt. Commerce orientation, zip export by email for dedicated “mobirise” app edition. Free alpha version. Test from the usual “AI training” prompt: https://lab-mobirise-ai.ui-api.com/pages/WNMlwo2Qz8bLq1u6ApF-U….

Title: Illusion Diffusion HQ
Description: Illusion Diffusion HQ (https://huggingface.co/spaces/AP123/IllusionDiffusion) allows you to create optical illusions from a proposed or imported illusion and a prompt. Many settings possible, trial and error required. Free and open-source.

Title: Vizualizer by Build Legends
Description: Vizualizer from Build Legends (https://app.buildlegends.com) generates stories of several chapters from a text with gaps, with illustrative images. In English with possible reading and sharing by link. Free and without account. Test here: https://app.buildlegends.com/reader/agFBlhf0y7LXVUzqSnk4?utm_source=visualizer&utm_medium=share

Title: Virbo
Description: Virbo (https://virbo.wondershare.com) generates the scenario and then its subtitled video with avatar from a prompt. Advanced editing, translation, choice of backgrounds and avatars. iOS app and android, 2 min of free video. Test below (raw and to work on).

Title: Ankara
Description: Ankara (https://ankarawebsite.vercel.app) generates the narration of a video from a prompt and then its audio version. Several tones available. FR to be specified but random. Free, without account. Tests with https://pexels.com/fr-fr/video/paysage-nature-eau-nuages-5444740/… + https://www.pexels.com/fr-fr/video/homme-personne-travailler-technologie-5741026/

Title: Piktochart
Description: Piktochart includes the generative AI to create infographics from a prompt (https://piktochart.com/generative-ai). Images taken from banks and texts generated quite basic even with detailed prompt but everything is editable. 4 generations /day.

Title: Seeker
Description: Seeker (https://seekerchat.ai) analyzes the uploaded documents – pdf, doc, json, TXT, epub, ppt – and allows an “advanced” conversation with sources and relationships between the concepts developed. Base ChatGPT. 500 pages of 300 characters free

Title: Trellis
Description: Trellis (https://readtrellis.com) allows dialogue with works in pdf. Tools of an ebook reader, library (EN). Generates the audio of the document (in progress, test to follow), cites its sources with pages. In free beta. Text: https://ebooksgratuits.com/details.php?book=740…

Title: Educates
Description: Educates (https://educates-ai.com) generates a text and audio course from a prompt title. 12 languages, choice of level, quiz, script, everything editable, integrated chatbot. 3 free courses. Test here in 10 chapters:https://educates-ai.com/lecture?courseId=bESXkiSPY5Yx1Ac6AQ9L&lectureIndex=0&color=%230000ff&slide=0…

Title: MyLens
Description: MyLens (https://mylens.ai) generates timelines from a prompt, simple or advanced (with number of dates, comparisons, etc.) Image export (complete and in Instagram images) or url. Free and unlimited. Test via url: https://mylens.ai/lens/chronologie-de-l-intelligence-artificielle-perspectives-europeenne-chinoise-et-americaine-en-20-evenements-cles-bpmqln

Title: Stable Video Streaming
Description: Stable Video Diffusion (https://stability.ai/news/stable-video-diffusion-open-ai-video-model…) generates short videos from an image. On the waiting list but 2 possible test locations: https://huggingface.co/spaces/multimodalart/stable-video-diffusion… and https://replicate.com/stability-ai/stable-video-diffusion?input=form&output=preview&prediction=u5p2xw3bn2obyzjr4byomjfpa4… (Wikimedia image)

Title: Slides Pilot
Description: Slides Pilot (https://www.slidespilot.com) creates text presentations from a prompt or a file. Contents editable before creation. Generation of notes. PDF export only in the test version of 300 credits (up to 5 presentations).

Title: Tutor Ocean
Description: Tutor Ocean (https://www.tutorocean.com/ai)generates revision sequences (maths and science, EN), with accompanying chatbot (all subjects, FR accepted), quizzes, feedbacks, tests and possible link with online tutors. Sequences and 10 free messages /day.

Title: Vello
Description: Vello (https://vello.ai) integrates ChatGPT 3.5 and 4, Claude 2, a web search template and a writing template. Everyone can be summoned individually or with others in a prompt. Sharing possible. Free, with or without account and unlimited.

Title: ChartGen AI
Description: ChartGen AI (einblick.ai/chartgenai/): data (xls, csv, json or gsheet) + a prompt = a graph. Action directly on the file and accept requests in natural language. Export png or svg. Free and unlimited. Test since: observatoire-des-territoires.gouv.fr/population-au-…

Title: Gibbly
Description: Gibbly (https://www.gibbly.co/) generates quizzes, courses and presentations. Quizzes offered in challenges accessible without account from the home (309751 test). Multi-level, ppt export with free images, class creation. In free beta.

Title: SDXL turbo
Description: SDXL turbo (beta version: https://clipdrop.co/stable-diffusion-turbo…) is the latest image generation model from Stable Diffusion @StabilityAI (description:https://stability.ai/news/stability-ai-sdxl-turbo). Split-second generated images and editing tool. Free and unlimited

Title: Pikaso
Description: Pikaso de @freepik (https://freepik.com/pikaso) generates real-time images from drawings / shapes and pictograms and/or prompt. Shapes can be moved and the image enhanced. Beta version on waiting list or invite. Export images + composition. (invitation code – limited – in this post: https://x.com/LinusEkenstam/status/1730241429174108440?s=20)

Title: Garden of AI
Description: Garden of AI (https://www.gardenofai.xyz) is a “universal” AI generator based on a prompt: text, images, applications, games, etc. 2 examples created:

Title: Dunno
Description: Dunno (https://dunno.gg) is a quiz creation tool, without or with AI. Question editing, answer time, possible scores. Shareable quiz with competition mode. 3 free generations.Quiz generated from the Wikipedia article “generative artificial intelligence” (https://fr.wikipedia.org/wiki/Intelligence_artificielle_g%C3%A9n%C3%A9rative… ……) : https://app.dunno.gg/quiz/a51a6b5b-5d00-41f3-a4c2-37ff0a9aacf1

Title: Quizalize
Description: Quizalize (https://www.quizalize.com/) generates quizzes from a topic, text, video or another quiz. Editable and exportable quizzes. Game form possible. Quiz library.

Title: Trove
Description: Trove (https://gettrove.co) generates questionnaires from a prompt. Editable questions asked in the form of a chat with reminders. 25 questions and 100 answers in free version, CSV export. Generated questionnaire to test: https://gettrove.co/share/respond/NzUxZWFiZDQtMjkwZC00N2E4LThjMTUtZDM3Yjc3NjYzYTBm

Title: Comics Maker
Description: Comics Maker (https://comicsmaker.ai) generates the images of a comic book and allows their layout, panel and speech bubbles. Several styles, views and AI models available. Export pdf or cbz, publish. 100 free credits (= 100 images).

Title: Decohere
Description: Decohere (http://decohere.ai) generates videos with Stable Video from an image or prompt. It includes an editing tool with video generation, prompt help and seed retention. 300 free credits per month.

Title: Knowlee
Description: Knowlee (http://knowlee.ai): a “personal” AI agent based on its own sources. Query the chatbot, text, image, video and audio generation modules and create your own chatbots. Beta with 50000 tokens.

Title: Story Studio
Description: Story Studio from Artflow (https://app.artflow.ai/story-studio) produces stories with editorial assistance and fully generated media. In beta integrated into Artflow (https://x.com/bertrandformet/status/1664338670193614849?s=20…). In EN but translation accepted. Test: https://app.artflow.ai/story-gallery/450fd0267e8442ad885fb437308be778…

Title: Stream slide
Description: Stream slide (https://streamslide.io) converts a YouTube video into a presentation by capturing the different moments of the video in the form of slides. Export to pdf. Free. Review from CC BY video https://youtu.be/K8gOvC8gvB4?si=SXprlgszemrDvWd3… by @FlowersINRIA

Title: FreeAIkit
Description: FreeAIkit (https://freeaikit.com) brings together about fifty text generation tools. Summary, translation, idea search… in EN, ask for generation in FR. Possibility to create your own bots. Free.

Title: Hinotes
Description: Hinotes (https://hinotes.hidock.com) transcribes audio from a microphone or sound file. Summary, todo list or important points depending on the content. 1200 free minutes during the beta version. Test from https://extraclasse.reseau-canope.fr/a-l-ecole-de-l-ia-parlons-pratiques-29…

Title: Fast SDXL
Description: Fast SDXL (https://huggingface.co/spaces/openskyml/fast-sdxl-stable-diffusion-xl…): image generation tool based on Stable Diffusion XL. Generate an image in about 20s with fine parameterization (negative prompt, steps, CFG, etc.) Free, account-free, unlimited, open-source, sharing by url possible.

Title: Pixverse
Description: Pixverse (https://pixverse.ai) generates short videos from an “advanced” prompt with style, negative prompt and format. Free beta version on discord.

Title: Swiftkey
Description: Dall-e 3 and GPT 4 in all its apps on Android or iOs phones and tablets? The Swiftkey keyboard (https://microsoft.com/en-us/swiftkey) now integrates Bing with tone creation, chatbot and copywriting. Available on stores.

Title: Labophase
Description: Thanks to Labophase (https://labophase.com) it is possible to compare the response of the main language models to the same prompt (Mistral 7B and 8x7B, Llama 2, Claude 2, Google Palm and ChatGPT4). Unlimited (?), account not mandatory, in beta version.

Title: Pika
Description: Pika (https://pika.art): video generation tool with advanced settings (prompt from image or video, size, camera movement, cropping, enlargement, duration…). Gallery with prompts. Free and unlimited on waiting list.

Title: Turbo Art
Description: Turbo Art (https://turbo.art) generates #images from a prompt and allows you to interact in real time via simple drawing tools (brush, size, color) to generate new ones. SDXL Turbo. No account, free, unlimited and open-source.

Title: Fluxy
Description: Fluxy (https://fluxyai.com) offers 70 text generation templates (some education, script, videos or presentations, children’s stories, etc.) from “prompts” forms. Specify “write in French” for a generation in FR. 2000 tokens /day.

Title: PartyRock
Description: Amazon’s PartyRock (https://partyrock.aws) builds apps from a prompt. Text, image, editing, sharing, and publishing possible.

Title: Hitwit
Description: Hitwit (https://hitwit.ai) accompanies the discovery in 10-minute sessions based on documents or free subjects. Subject and course defined, an exchange phase allows you to explore anchoring activities before you. Often in EN, FR accepted. Free.

Title: Map This
Description: Map This (https://map-this.com) generates a mind map from a pdf. Pdf up to 5MB and 50 pages. 5 generations per month. Export png or svg. Tests: Unesco guidelines (https://unesdoc.unesco.org/ark:/48223/pf0000386693_eng) and Canopé infographics (https://reseau-canope.fr/agence-des-usages/intelligence-artificielle.html)

Title: Saga RPG
Description: Saga RPG (http://sagarpg.io) offers text-based role-playing games based on a character, a world and a story created or chosen from libraries. Several language models available including GPT4. In EN, accepts FR. Free.

Title: Hi Santa
Description: A call to Santa Claus or his friends before he arrives tomorrow night while working on his English pronunciation? Hi Santa (https://hisanta.ai) is waiting for you! 8 characters and the possibility to create them. Voice recognition and answer integration

Title: Euphonme
Description: Euphonme (https://euphonme.com) generates a music track from a prompt. Gallery of the most listened to songs and sharing possible. Beta with 10 songs per month. Review: https://euphonme.com/music/clqk4y1wk00028axjs0cz7v4m

Title: EduGPT
Description: EduGPT (https://edugpt.com) provides more than 100 predefined chatbot templates: tool support, avatars of teachers or historical figures, quiz generators or images. Each conversation is exportable. Beta with 18000 credits

Title: Free AI Essay Write
Description: Free AI Essay Writer from AcademicHelp (https://academichelp.net/free-essay-generator) generates writing on a given topic, with real sources, from a form. 3 free pages per day. EN but FR accepted if specified. Test: https://codimd.apps.education.fr/yK-9xi6OQ8-PMr0NjiF9Ug?view

Title: Krea
Description: Krea (https://krea.ai) generates images with geometric shapes or drawing and prompt in real time. Enhancement and enlargement tools, integration of text or logo in the image. Possibility to create your own database. Open beta. Free.

Title: Eduease
Description: Eduease (https://learn.eduease.ai/) generates a quiz from a subject or a pdf file, multiple choice or true/false in 4 difficulties. Editable questions, possible additions and exports, sending and tracking of answers (account to answer). Free and unlimited.

Title: Julius
Description: Julius (https://julius.ai) queries data files (import / gsheet) via a chatbot conversation. Generates the right Python code to respond and produces visualizations. Test: https://meteo.data.gouv.fr/datasets/6569b51ae64326786e4e8e1a (csv 72 MB).

Title: AI Comic Factory
Description: AI Comic Factory (https://huggingface.co/spaces/jbilcke-hf/ai-comic-factory) created 2 comic strips from a prompt, a style and a choice of template. French if specified. Editing, with or without bubbles, pdf export. Open source and unlimited. Via @j0annamarques and @nicolasbannier

Title: Leonardo’s Realtime Canva
Description: Realtime Canva by Leonardo (https://app.leonardo.ai/realtime-canvas) generates real-time images from drawings and prompt. Brush tool, shape selection and move, several templates available. Beta with no credits removed from 150/day.

Title: Bedtime Ai
Description: Bedtime Ai (https://bedtime-ai.nokk.io/stories/create) generates an audio story from a very simple prompt. Base: OpenAI API. Accepts French if specified. Sharing by url, free, seems limited to 5 stories? 2 min 40 test here: https://bedtime-ai.nokk.io/stories/2aN4wX4U9JrbrwEdV7Q1KX4MAnH

Title: Prome
Description: Prome (https://promeai.com) offers several image generation and editing tools, 2 for video generation (list in the first 2 images). About a hundred templates available depending on the tools. 10 credits per month (100 images or 2 videos).

Title: Mymap Visualstory
Description: Mymap Visualstory (https://mymap.ai/visualstory), 1 topic = 1 infinite table of text generations: presentation, map, documents or even integrated chatbot. Editing tools and writing aids. Shareable url. Test: https://mymap.ai/share/vuMeQx75H03Xh…Mymap Visualstory is free, without an account and seems unlimited. Export in image format, links to the parts of the table and edit link to share available.

Title: History Timelines
Description: History Timelines (https://historytimelines.co) generates the historical description of a given subject accompanied by key dates. In FR if specified (but seems more complete if EN). Shareable, free and without account. A tool for critical thinking?

Title: Twin Pics
Description: A #uneIAparjour bonus: Twin Pics (https://twinpics.ai), a little daily game that consists of succeeding in generating an image that is as close as possible to the one offered with 3 iterations of 30 characters maximum. To practice prompt?

Title: Open Lang
Description: Open Lang (https://openlang.ai) allows you to learn a language from podcasts or videos YouTube imported. Cuts out the transcription, definitions, grammar points, sentence repetition. 36 languages available. 2h30 free per month.

Title: Brainstory
Description: Brainstory (https://brainstory.ai) accompanies the reflection with questions on a given subject, in writing or orally transcribed: the AI “guides” through its questions and synthesizes the exchange. Sharing for feedback possible. Accepts FR. 10 free topics.“Technical” precision: pay attention to the enter key that validates your answer, you must write to the kilometer.Link to leave feedback on the test performed: https://app.brainstory.ai/feedback?share=37443a6d-b2b2-4498-8412-ad10c7de01d2…

Title: Prezo
