Description: Prezo (http://prezo.ai) generates presentations with a prompt and/or a document. Integrated image generation, adding/editing content, pdf export, sharing via url. Free individual use. Ex with Unesco AI guide: https://vu.fr/BgFF

Title: Nex
Description: Nex (https://nex.art), with its own Primus template, generates images from a prompt, a base image, color choices, and structure. Several combinations possible, prompt negative. 100 images per month in free version.

Title: PresentationGPT
Description: PresentationGPT (https://presentationgpt.com) generates a presentation from a prompt. In FR if specified. 15 slides max and online sharing only in free version. No account and unlimited. Tests: https://presentationgpt.com/?presentationId=RASY_Ev and https://presentationgpt.com/?presentationId=eSiEhTI

Title: Ideamap
Description: Ideamap (https://ideamap.ai) supports the emergence of ideas through text generation, facilitation tools and mind map presentation. Many tools available (including docs and drawings), cooperation. FR random. 5 free maps (rooms).

Title: Pack generator
Description: Pack generator (per @output: https://coproducer.output.com/pack-generator) generates 4 15-second music tracks from a prompt and allows you to download each of the tracks of the instruments used for generation. Free, unlimited and royalty-free tracks.

Title: Jotbot
Description: Jotbot (https://myjotbot.com) offers the writing, generation, understanding of audio or videos YouTube based on a database built by the user. FR if specified. 10 credits/day (10 actions or 3 videos).

Title: GPTS2D
Description: GPTS2D (https://gpts2d.com) creates specialized agents capable of answering several topics on the same space in the form of an “infinite” mind map. Each branch brings new proposals and becomes an independent chatbot.

Title: D&AViz
Description: D&AViz (https://dnaviz.aipeople.arivu-iq.com) analyzes the data provided via a chatbot (csv max 5MB) and produces visualizations. 100 credits (needs: 5/10 for text, 15/20 for visualization). Csv test (9000 lines, 180 col.) excerpt from https://meteo.data.gouv.fr/datasets/6569b4473bedf2e7abad3b72…

Title: Reelcraft
Description: Reelcraft (https://reelcraft.ai) generates animated stories – video, voice, and music – from a prompt or text. Multiple templates, voice EN, editability. Accepts FR, generates in EN unless specified. Free beta.

Title: QR Code AI Art Generator
Description: QR Code AI Art Generator (https://huggingface.co/spaces/huggingface-projects/QR-code-AI-art-generator) offers the generation of “artistic” QR codes from a prompt +/- an image. Advanced settings. Free, unlimited and open-source. (If generating the code without an image, “play” with the options).

Title: Paint AI
Description: Paint AI (https://paintai.groupmind.co.uk): a simple drawing tool… without tools! Tools generated on demand from a prompt and then editable if you need to refine the result. Export png, jpg, webp and bmp. Free, unlimited, open-source and without account.

Title: Image Mixer
Description: Image Mixer (https://cloud.lambdalabs.com/demos/lambda/image-mixer-demo…) generates an image from a series of URLs, texts or images (5 maximum), each source can be more or less important for the generation, configuration possible. Open source and unlimited. Test sources: Pexels.

Title: Chartpixel
Description: Chartpixel (http://chartpixel.com) analyzes data (possible sources: see image 1) and generates visualizations. Can build a database from a search but does not cite its sources. Free beta, 10 MB import. Export png.2 Chartpixel tests to discover: – from http://meteo.data.gouv csv: http://chartpixel.com/project?id=OnShNgLX… – from a “Besançon weather” search request: http://chartpixel.com/project?id=bQUk2IRj…

Title: Video to blog
Description: Video to blog (https://videoToBlog.ai) generates 1 blog post from 1 YouTube video. Simple editing, analysis and multiple export.– AI @reseau_canope Extraclass Test: https://videoToBlog.ai/share/A8g41L7qhare/A8g41L7qari63fwivQZ7… – Test markdown @FlowersINRIA :https://codimd.apps.education.fr/BZp89xGBS-q3WXcjTzgung?view…

Title: Reading coach
Description: Microsoft’s Reading Coach (https://coach.microsoft.com) supports reading, pronunciation and fluency skills. “Preview” in EN: stories generated (animal and place), library or pasted text read then analysis and words to repeat, 8 levels.

Title: Dante
Description: With Dante (http://dante-ai.com) it is possible to create your own chatbot based on a database of documents and URLs. Customizable, sharing and integration possible. 30 messages/month in free version. Test: https://chat.dante-ai.com/embed?kb_id=776996e1-2bcb-47fd-a114-789e3505fe97&token=190bc407-2991-46d7-954b-1de3f47f5b90&modeltype=gpt-3.5-turbo&logo=ZmFsc2U%3D&mode=undefined…

Title: Mendable
Description: Mendable (https://mendable.ai) is a custom chatbot with a user-created database. Accepts url, documents, videos, YouTube. Fine-tuning. Uses Claude, GPT 3.5 and 4. 500 credits/month (3 if GPT 4 request).

Title: InstantID
Description: InstantID (https://huggingface.co/spaces/InstantX/InstantID…) transforms a portrait from a simple prompt and 8 available styles while remaining faithful to the original portrait. Numerous settings. Free, open-source and unlimited. (any resemblance to…

Title: Misc Ninja
Description: Misc Ninja (https://misc.ninja): search engine coupled with 3 language models (“Ninja”, GPT 3.5 or 4) with 3 search modes, classic, news-based or Wikipedia. Without account + adding docs / history if connected.

Title: Worksheet generator
Description: Worksheet generator (https://getworksheet.co) generates quizzes in the form of a pdf sheet for the class (US grade level: grade 1 CP / grade 12 terminale). In FR if specified, test: up to 50 questions generated (bugs later). No account, unlimited.

Title: Based Labs
Description: Based Labs (https://basedlabs.ai) generates images that can then be turned into a video. Based on Stable Diffusion, settings possible. Publishing and 4 other apps available. 50 credits per month. Test: https://basedlabs.ai/media/clrxyqnlh0011sd0yylqnng6l

Title: DomoAI
Description: DomoAI (https://domoai.app) can turn a video into an anime, generate images, and animate images from Discord from prompts. 45 free credits per account. Original video for testing via Pexels: https://pexels.com/fr-fr/video/femmes-jouer-sport-balle-6767274…

Title: IaskAI
Description: IaskAI (https://iask.ai): a search engine connected to a generative AI of text. Text created from the search/prompt and resulting sources. App, voice, modes. Free, no account (some sponsored content).

Title: Shakker
Description: Shakker (http://shakker.ai) is an image generation tool with prompt enhancement, negative prompt, fine adjustments, more templates, reference image, remix, retouching, style change, background removal… Free and unlimited beta.

Title: Pitch
Description: Pitch (http://pitch.com) generates editable presentations from a prompt. In the unlimited free version: themes, full editing, live presentation, and watermark exports. Link sharing and collaborative paid version.

Title: QuickTakes
Description: QuickTakes (http://quicktakes.io): 1h30 of free recording/week of transcribed audio notes, summarized with reading guide and glossary, questions, videos to go + far and chatbot. Test from “Ada & Zangemann” by Matthias Kirschner and Sandra Brandstätter to be found on https://cfeditions.com/ada/

Title: AI image generator
Description: AI image generator (https://aiimagegenerator.is) generates images based on Stable Diffusion and 4 templates. Free and without account, paid options (resolution, watermark, number of images generated per prompt).

Title: Quillbot
Description: Quillbot (https://quillbot.com) is a set of tools to help with writing: rephrasing, grammar, summary (in EN), translation, “standardized” citations and Flow focused on documents. No account except Flow, sometimes character limit. Source Wikipedia IA Gen.

Title: Ask on video
Description: Ask on video (https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/ask-on-video-1-click-capt/bjgcfacigblojjkeobfenmllnoknadkc?pli=1…) Chrome extension that after capturing an image uses ChatGPT (3.5, 4, 4Turbo, 4Vision) to integrate it into its Chatbot. Summary, explanation, quiz creation, reformulation, etc. are then possible.

Title: Assistants HuggingChat
Description: HuggingChat now offers its assistants (https://huggingface.co/chat/assistants): configurable for free with account Hugging Face then shareable and accessible without account. 6 models available including Mistral and Llama. Review: https://huggingface.co/chat/assistant/65c297d2f8b88f5cea4e40fd A library of wizards is also available.

Title: KoalaWriter and KoalaChat
Description: KoalaWriter and KoalaChat (https://koala.sh): generation of long texts with images + videos and chatbot. Export HTML or copy for Writer. ChatGPT 3.5, 5000 words and 25 free messages. Test: https://codimd.apps.education.fr/mBuoZknkScWR9VQUIiLQUw?view

Title: Vercel AI SDK
Description: Vercel AI SDK (https://sdk.vercel.ai) shows in the same window the answers provided by several language models (latest captures) for comparison. Two interfaces, with or without iteration possible. Free. Via A.G. @reseau_canope

Title: Starryai
Description: Starryai (https://starryai.com): an image-generating AI application on iOS or Android. Text, image and sketch to image. 100+ templates available. Retouching and enhancement tools. 5 credits per day (1 to 2 credits per generation)

Title: Gemini
Description: Gemini (https://gemini.google.com/) formerly Bard is a chatbot based on the LLM Gemma. Connected to the web, it is capable of analyzing images and documents present in Google Drive. Google product extensions offered.Edit 08/25, see also the features added since the publication of this article: – Gemini Gems– Gemini Deep Research– Gemini Storybook– Gemini 2.5 Flash Image

Title: Smart Work Buddy
Description: Smart Work Buddy (https://smartworkbuddy.com) brings together 400 mini-modules specialized in text generation, 18 of which are in the education category (plan, quiz, summary…). French to be specified. Export txt. Free, without account and seems unlimited.

Title: Mizou
Description: Mizou (https://mizou.com @mizouai) creates personalized chatbots dedicated to education. Audio responses, URL sharing. In EN, specify FR. Free beta. Tests https://mizou.com/preview-bot?ID=4201… / https://mizou.com/preview-bot?ID=4202… Via @rvanoudheusden and M. Ch.

Title: OpenGPTs
Description: OpenGPTs (https://opengpts-example-vz4y4ooboq-uc.a.run.app Documentation on Github:https://github.com/langchain-ai/opengpts…): customizable chatbots in the manner of OpenAI GPTs. 6 LLMs available, 3 possibilities: simple chatbot, RAG with documents and Assistants with docs and extensions (web search, wikipedia…). Via @BastienMasse

Title: Grapha
Description: Grapha (https://grapha.ai) offers to dialogue with the data provided (csv, xls or Gsheets) and documented. Text or graphic analyses. 2 games and 20 free questions per month. Test from https://meteo.data.gouv.fr city of Besançon 2023/24.

Title: Any summary
Description: Any summary (https://anysummary.app) summarizes document or URL with several possible entries: simple summary or elaborated with prompt, chatbot… 7 languages available. Test from https://unesdoc.unesco.org/ark:/48223/pf0000386693… and https://bienvenue.reseau-canope.fr/ia-en-classeEach month: 3 documents per day, 15 min video and audo, 15 min audio/video, 100 pages in the free version.

Title: AI Chatsy
Description: AI Chatsy (https://aichatsy.com) offers a chatbot based on ChatGPT or GPT4 and a set of pre-configured modules, some of which are for education. In EN, specify FR. Documents down during tests. iOS and Android. 300 free credits.Edit of 16/02/23: the modules dedicated to the image work again. An error remains present for the documents.

Title: Capitol
Description: Capitol (https://capitol.ai): a tool offering writing modules, from image to narration to an anime character with editing and remix. Analysis of docs. Sharing and export possible. In beta with 20000 tokens per day.

Title: Clip Panda
Description: Clip Panda (https://clippanda.com) creates 20/30 second clips with voice (in EN) and music from a prompt. Music and videos come from free source libraries (in the free music YouTube and pexels video tests). 5 free videos.

Title: Stable Cascade
Description: Stable Cascade (https://stability.ai/news/introducing-stable-cascade…) is the new @StabilityAI image generation model, faster and less resource-intensive. In demo on HugginFace: https://huggingface.co/spaces/multimodalart/stable-cascade…. Quite good image quality (remains the pb on the faces).

Title: LMSYS
Description: LMSYS (https://chat.lmsys.org) compares 35 language models, the most widespread and the latest of @MistralAI “Next”. Voting for the one considered the best (battle or side-to-side) or to test only one. An “image to text” module.

Title: Dashtoon
Description: Dashtoon, webtoon reader, offers its generation tool in free beta (https://dashtoon.com/create) after writing the story, choosing the style and characters. Complete edition. FR if specified. Series possible. Review: https://dashtoon.com/show/SHO5J6TRAcosmhZSm0M…

Title: SDXL Lightning
Description: SDXL Lightning (https://fastsdxl.ai), based on Stable Diffusion XL, generates images in real time. “Seed” available. Free, no account, unlimited and open-source.

Title: WisdomPlan
Description: WisdomPlan (https://wisdomplan.ai) generates personalized courses from a topic, with planning and tracking. Each course consists of videos, activities or selected sites. FR accepted but generates in EN. 50 free courses that can be shared. Tests:– AI education test: https://app.wisdomplan.ai/plan/share/IA-educ-65d8fca75d314e46f9351ce6… – Past participle test: https://app.wisdomplan.ai/plan/share/PP-65d901575d314e46f9351dac…

Title: Schemely
Description: Schemely (https://schemely.app) generates session and course plans from a topic, with objectives, activities, several quizzes, video and presentation. Specify FR. Gallery available, 1 free plan / month. Test: https://schemely.app/courses/explore?lesson=les-ia-g%C3%A9n%C3%A9ratives-en-%C3%A9ducation-usages-et-limites-%C3%A9cris-en-fran%C3%A7ais… Via @roac61

Title: Gligen
Description: Gligen (project: https://gligen.github.io and demo: https://huggingface.co/spaces/gligen/demo…): an image generation tool that allows the composition of the future image by positioning the elements of the prompt by defined “zones”. Advanced options. Open source and unlimited.

Title: Oso
Description: Oso (https://web.oso.ai) includes a search engine that produces a summary, chatbot with Mixtral + LLM “uncensored” and news. Test:– chatbot https://codimd.apps.education.fr/p427V28URSytmMF2ssKYzg?view…– chatbot from News https://codimd.apps.education.fr/MEvNfCBCRyytDYEl2WpnEQ?view…Free with pro version

Title: Image to music
Description: Image to music (https://imagetomusic.top) generates music with an image. Without account and open-sourceTests (img wikimedia): – Gull: https://cdn-uploads.huggingface.co/production/uploads/noauth/5Ie6bRDNcgJUbZ1lghfHc.wav… – Starry night: https://cdn-uploads.huggingface.co/production/uploads/noauth/uyzACujyIZH0te0ROrpcQ.wav… – His Eyes Have Fangs: https://cdn-uploads.huggingface.co/production/uploads/noauth/8UFgz0lECYsuTswzt8wxs.wav…

Title: Phind
Description: Phind (https://phind.com/search), LLM for developers, offers a chatbot connected to the internet for everyone. Phind-34 B free, unlimited, possible without account, Phind-70B/GPT4 in pro version. Tests: https://phind.com/search?cache=s9z8myyni96snnvaz6znijjq… – https://phind.com/search?cache=wj1po2y6ukjim8ili8slx79u…

Title: Project FTK
Description: Project FTK (https://projectftk.com) allows you to create custom “teacher assistant” chatbots with a pdf zip, doc or ppt. Configurable, web access, instructions. Free beta. Test (account required): https://projectftk.com/beta/uneiaparjour?repo=ia-education…

Title: Summarize
Description: Summarize (https://summarize.ing) summarizes a YouTube video with questions and answers, important passages, keywords, quotes and mind map. 20 free videos of -1 hour per day. Test from https://youtu.be/E2hPk3adUlI @FlowersINRIA

Title: Hey Pat
Description: Hey Pat (https://heypat.ai) is a chatbot based on OpenAI and Dappier with data that is updated “regularly” (after testing, depends on the type of data, no sources). Available online without account or on WhatsApp/Telegram. Unlimited.

Title: Morpheeus
Description: Morpheeus (http://morpheeus.com) generates stories and offers them to read from a cloned voice after choosing the theme, age and a prompt. iOS and Android, 1 free story. Test with cloned voice: https://app.morpheeus.com/ShareStory/112

Title: Gamma sites
Description: Gamma, a presentation tool (tested here: https://www.uneiaparjour.fr/gamma/), offers a beta version of website generation (https://gamma.app/#sites). 50 templates, text and image generation, export, comments, collaboration and follow-up. 40 credits per generation.Tests: ” https://gamma.app/docs/Introduction-gjpje1o8cu81s21…– https://gamma.app/docs/Introduction-aux-IA-generatives-en-education-umsyl91a5xq3pry

Title: Claude 3
Description: Claude 3 (https://claude.ai): new version by @AnthropicAI with 3 new LLMs including “Sonnet”, an intermediate model, is free. The playback of images and documents (5 max of 10 MB) is now possible. Sources for testing:– manuscript of Eviradnus, The Legend of the Centuries, Victor Hugo, @GallicaBnF : http://expositions.bnf.fr/hugo/grands/191.htm… – AI infographics @reseau_canope : https://www.reseau-canope.fr/agence-des-usages/intelligence-artificielle.html

Title: Le chat
Description: Le chat (https://chat.mistral.ai) provides 3 language models of @MistralAI, large, next, small. Fast, effective but with a lot of hallucinations (img 4). Tests: https://codimd.apps.education.fr/s/mwq0IN5m8 (training) and https://codimd.apps.education.fr/s/gVEx6MgJ5 (HTML).

Title: Sticker baker
Description: Sticker baker (http://stickerbaker.com) generates sticker-style images from a prompt. Possibility to obtain sticker sheets and upload of your own images offered. Search engine for created images. No account and unlimited.

Title: Reading club
Description: Reading club (https://readingclub.ai) generates editable stories, text and images. Free version limited in number of generations per day (limit reached for the test). Online sharing. Test: https://readingclub.ai/preview/j571vhtn2he2ddr8sscqkkrc8n6mxj4a…

Title: Colorin
Description: Colorin (http://colorin.ai) generates coloring drawings. Editing and color filling tools with possible compilation in a coloring book. 5 different styles. prompt help, 30 free credits.

Title: Ai Story Generator
Description: Ai Story Generator (https://datanumen.com/ai-story-generator…) generates long texts with illustrations from a prompt (all subjects). Specify FR. Sharing by url. Free and without account. Tests:“https://datanumen.com/ai-story-generator/a-fox-named-rusard/…” https://datanumen.com/ai-story-generator/the-generative-ai-in-education-uses-and-limitations/…

Title: AnimateLCM
Description: AnimateLCM (https://huggingface.co/spaces/wangfuyun/AnimateLCM-SVD…) transforms still images into short animated images. Advanced options. Open source and unlimited. Wikimedia commons images: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/Template:Potd/2024-04#/media/File:Ratargul-02.jpg… / https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Sunset_at_Noronhas%27_beach.jpg… / https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/Template:Potd/2024-04#/media/File:Yellowstone_National_Park_(WY,_USA),_Old_Faithful_Geyser_–_2022_–_2599.jpg…

Title: Navi
Description: Navi (https://eduplay.ai/navi) is a personal assistant chatbot focused on learning with 40 “plugins” including text, document, image, quiz, productivity, advice… Customizable and connected. Free, in beta version, seems unlimited.Document for the pdf test: infographic https://www.reseau-canope.fr/agence-des-usages/intelligence-artificielle.html

Title: Notes GPT
Description: Notes GPT (http://usenotesgpt.com) transcribes audio notes into items in a checklist and offers a summary. Generation via Mistral ai. Specify that the generation must be done in French at the end of the recording. Open source and unlimited.

Title: Visual electric
Description: Visual electric (https://visualelectric.com) image generation tool with many styles, formats and options. Gallery for inspiration, retouching and remix tools, customizable styles. 40 free images per day for personal use.

Title: Pngmaker
Description: Pngmaker (https://pngmaker.ai) generates images in png format (with possible transparency of the image background) from a prompt. Free, without account and seems unlimited.

Title: Tune
Description: Tune (https://tunehq.ai) gives access to several language models via its Chatbot. Models and improvement of prompt, document, internet connection… Free and at first without account. Another app, “studio”, allows you to deploy your own bots.

Title: Make real polls
Description: Make real polls (https://make-real-polls.vercel.app) generates live polls from whiteboard elements with text, image and drawing tools and videoconferencing possible. Shareable board, teacher or student access. No account and unlimited.

Title: Tammy
Description: Tammy (https://tammy.ai) summarizes YouTube videos and generates Q&A. French to choose from the menus. A few errors. Free: 1 “pro” summary, 5 “basic” summaries and 10 Q&A with benchmarks per day. CC @recitqc video source: https://youtu.be/Hb5no9wImmY?si=mOO6t9JvYN3ryJAA

Title: Zerobot
Description: Zerobot (https://zerobot.ai) allows interaction with agents and their creation using chatGPT 3.5 or Groq in free version (GPT 4 in paid version) with unlimited messages and sharing by URL. Voice for request and response (in FR). Test (account required):– “assistant teacher”: https://chat.zerobot.ai/a/a-pdsoEVaBu-assistant… – “Companion Ideas”: https://chat.zerobot.ai/a/a-N1YTEkUBQ-compagnon-id%C3%A9es

Title: Learning studio
Description: Learning studio (http://learningstudioai.com) generates chaptered courses with activities and quizzes. Editable, pdf or scorm export. 3 free courses.Tests:– AI alone: https://learningstudioai.com/go/m70YaqWqN8yx6MAiFaXL…– AI with doc: https://learningstudioai.com/go/67nOGFADEbRa9CnlduFe…

Title: Clipfy
Description: Clipfy (http://clipfly.ai) brings together several tools dedicated to video, including several AIs: generation from a prompt, image animation or enhancement. 50 free credits (about 5 videos generated).

Title: Boords
Description: Boords (http://boords.com) generates editable and customizable storyboards with text and image generation. Exports in paid version, URL sharing, animation. Credits for 1 free storyboard. Test https://app.boords.com/s/mlv3lo

Title: Kards AI
Description: Kards AI (https://kardsai.app): iOS and Android app that generates flashcards from a text, a pdf, a prompt or a csv. “Reward” system, progress tracking, image export. Free with advertising banner at the reception, “pro” functions.

Title: Sonauto
Description: Sonauto (http://sonauto.ai): music tracks from a prompt. Targeted new generation editing. MP3 or karaoke video export. Free and unlimited. Tests: https://sonauto.ai/songs/D3XMq3Ki9pBIe0C5aHyf… and https://sonauto.ai/songs/z1gB330XmslyyZ26kcxs… (prompt via chatGPT)

Title: Talk me
Description: Talk me (https://talkme.ai) offers the learning of 5 languages: speech recognition, existing or new scenarios, translation, grammar, definition and dashboard. Online or app. 5 free activities per day.

Title: Slidesgo
Description: Slidesgo by Freepix (https://slidesgo.com) generates presentations, icebreaker ideas and end-of-session/training questionnaires (connection education choice). Via @YannPoirson.

Title: Brisk Teaching
Description: Brisk Teaching (https://app.briskteaching.com/): Chrome extension integrating education-oriented generation tools: sessions, quizzes, presentations, emails, articles… Direct generations in the Google suite. Advanced functions for workbenches. Tests:

Title: Text to video by Typeframes
Description: Text to video by Typeframes (https://typeframes.com/tools/text-to-video…) converts a text into an animated video with music. Full editing possible (groups of words, music, backgrounds…), online sharing or mp4 export. Other tools available with voice in EN.

Title: Ownai
Description: Ownai (http://ownai.com): creation of personalized chatbots based on Mistral. Customizable URL, 3 free, unlimited interactions and user access without account. Test with help in creating educational sessions: https://creation-seance.ownai.com

Title: Gencraft
Description: Gencraft (https://gencraft.com): image generation with 30 styles and 40 templates (5 free), image to image, prompt help, negative prompts and gallery. iOS and Android. 5×2 free generations/day (video and clean template in paid version).

Title: Bria
Description: Bria (http://labs.bria.ai): image generation with 4 “ethical” models (capture 1). Editing tools for the generated images (modification of expressions, objects, background, size…). Editable garlerie images. 1000 free images per month.

Title: Globe translator
Description: Globe translator (https://translator.globe.engineer) transforms a prompt into a graphical representation (3d in beta), decision tree or table. Numbers during testing seem ok but sources and generations are of course to be checked Without account and unlimited.

Title: Makingprogress
Description: Makingprogress (https://makingprogressai.com) generates reviews from a completed form, a photo or an audio recording. In EN but accepts the FR – even if the text generated is not always in FR, a source of ideas? Free and unlimited.

Title: Illumidesk
Description: Illumidesk (http://illumidesk.com) generates online courses with quizzes, fully editable with numerous tools. Student follow-up, FR accepted, generates in EN or FR. 15 full days then limited version to 10 students. Test: https://bfbfbf.illumidesk.com/courses/les-ia-generatives-en-education-usages-et-limites-2

Title: Shortvideosapp
Description: Shortvideosapp (https://shortvideosapp.com) generates videos in vertical format with still images and voice from a prompt. Choice of style and choice of voice, generation of audio and then choice of proposed images. FR accepted and surtitles in EN. Unlimited?

Title: Lazy
Description: Lazy (http://getlazy.ai) creates applications from a prompt. The tool tests, debugs and corrects errors, offers suggestions, possible iteration. In EN, FR accepted. Free creations, accessible code and web access in private mode.

Title: Gatekeep
Description: Gatekeep (http://gatekeep.ai) generates explainer videos from a prompt. Videos with text, voice and illustrations. Summary and chat. FR accepted, random in generations, ok in chat. , V. beta? unlimited? Excerpts in the video. Via @batier

Title: Mapmind
Description: Mapminp (https://mapmindai.com) generates simple mind maps from a prompt. Global generation (possible to specify the level of detail, not always respected) then editing possible. Import json, export json png. FR accepted, seems unlimited.

Title: Clee
Description: Clee (http://cleeai.com) is a search engine coupled with a text generative AI: response generated with real sources, choice of sources, access to news topics (EN). FR accepted, sharing possible. Account required, free and unlimited.

Title: Morphic
Description: Morphic (http://morphic.sh): open-source search engine coupled with a text generative AI. Response with request for precision, sources, images, generation and associated topics. Iteration possible. Beta without account. Github: https://github.com/miurla/morphic

Title: Pdf to chat
Description: Pdf to chat (http://pdftochat.com) offers the analysis of pdf documents via a chatbot with pdf reader tools. Iteration and internal references to the document. Based on Mixtral, unlimited and open-source, github: https://github.com/Nutlope/pdftochat…via @Korben

Title: Kognitium
Description: Kognitium (https://kognitium.com) is presented as a conversational agent + accurate and that “learns” from exchanges (LLM not mentioned). Progress monitoring and sharing. Access without account possible, free beta. Example: https://kognitium.com/thread/2aa8b132-58da-4890-acd4-cda795b46a8e…

Title: Udio
Description: Udio (https://udio.com) generates music tracks with lyrics. 30 sec. songs. Gallery, playlist, download, share and FR ok. 1200 free songs/ month 1 possible credits per day, 100 per month free.Tests:” https://udio.com/songs/hiYZkuo6yoVWfe3FP4g6cy…” https://udio.com/songs/7dhxDpQbz18FEhURDUUaVr…

Title: Chatcsv
Description: Chatcsv (https://chatcsv.co) analyzes csv files with a large amount of data via a chatbot. Several files can be loaded and compared, visualizations are offered. Free and unlimited. Tests from https://meteo.data.gouv.fr

Title: Class Companion
Description: Class Companion (http://classcompanion.com) generates query-based assessments in the form of quizzes or written answer questions. Creation of classes with tracking (US legislation, not GDPR). FR if specified. Free for teachers.

Title: Question AI
Description: Question AI (https://questionai.com + extensions) is defined as an assistant for homework: a chatbot with analysis of images, screenshots or pdf and a scientific calculator with explanation of calculations. Usable by all, unlimited with account.Question AI tests since:– prompt diagram https://edunumrech.hypotheses.org– Infographic PDF https://reseau-canope.fr/agence-des-usages/intelligence-artificielle.html…– direct capture http://uneiaparjour.fr

Title: Speechmatics
Description: Speechmatics (http://speechmatics.com) transcribes audio into text, from a loaded audio file or in real time. Translates, summarizes, chapters, transforms into subtitles… 9 audio file formats accepted, 40 languages available, 8 hours free per month.Testing since: – 4th cover of “C’était mieux avant” by Mr. Serres ” http://archive.org/details/coarlt…– http://audiocite.net/livres-audio-g…

Title: Owlift
Description: Owlift (https://owlift.com): – answers questions in several languages and levels– offers generation tools for students and teachers (flashcards, quizzes, questions, etc.) 3 free credits/day without account, +10 per week with it.

Title: Picurious
Description: Picurious (http://picurious.ai) analyzes images, offers related questions and a chatbot. Translates, solves problems, identifies. Tests from https://academie-francaise.fr/petite-poucette-les-nouveaux-defis-de-leducation…, https://apmep.fr/Annee-2023 and personal photo. 13 free queries.

Title: Smmry
Description: Smmry (https://smmry.com) summarizes texts, txt or pdf documents and via a URL. Accepts long texts (test with 7 chapters Button Wars), refinement with keywords, several options. Account possible but seems unlimited without. Smmry test sources:– text War of buttons: https://gutenberg.org/files/56646/56646-0.txt…– url: https://bienvenue.reseau-canope.fr/ia-en-classe– PDF: prompt infographic

Title: Q by Vemo
Description: Q by Vemo (https://apps.apple.com/us/app/q-by-vemo-ai/id6497067239…): a streamlined chatbot based on orally expressed queries and textual responses. LLM GPT3 (base fixed in 2022). French ok and iteration possible, without history. Free and unlimited, on iOS.

Title: Visla
Description: Visla (http://visla.us) generates videos from prompt, text, url, image or video. With editing tool.Tests: https://app.visla.us/project/view/1231801848579514368… / https://app.visla.us/project/view/1231804256869171200… / https://app.visla.us/project/view/1231803024557498368… / https://app.visla.us/project/view/1231805351905484800… Web and iOS – 50 min/month

Title: Recall
Description: Recall (https://getrecall.ai) summarizes web pages (+ online pdf) and makes links via keywords. Also offers quizzes for each. FR ok if specified in the settings. Web, app and extension. 10 free editable summaries.

Title: Ai image generator
Description: Ai image generator (https://aiimagegenerator.io) generates images from a negative prompt, style, format, and prompt by “enhancing” the initial prompt. Simple prompts that are more efficient.No history. Beta, no accounts and unlimited.

Title: Once upon a bot
Description: Once upon a bot (https://onceuponabot.com) generates children’s stories with text, images and audio. FR ok if specified. Sharing url and pdf (hs during tests), 3 free/week.Tests:” https://onceuponabot.com/story/acd9b0c2-4490-402d-8f6c-5feab929f52a…– https://onceuponabot.com/story/d4c8b81c-a75b-471a-b8f8-cd97aeee264e…

Title: Artic LLM
Description: Artic LLM (https://snowflake.com/blog/arctic-open-efficient-foundation-language-models-snowflake…): a language model open-source oriented code and business but still versatile. Chatbots without account with settings (short answers, ask to continue): https://arctic.streamlit.app and https://huggingface.co/spaces/Snowflake/snowflake-arctic-st-demo…

Title: Anakin
Description: Anakin (http://anakin.ai): platform bringing together + 1000 apps based on generative AI, including the main language and image models. Possibility to create your own apps. 300 credits at the opening then 30 free/day.

Title: Arti
Description: After choosing a character and/or an action and/or a place, Arti (https://playarti.com) generates an image from the chosen criteria and style. A good entry point for discovering image generation? Without account.

Title: Teach w/ AI
Description: Teach w/ AI (https://teach-with-ai.com) offers a chatbot and 8 teaching-oriented modules: sessions, sequences, assessments, content, activities, differentiation. Chrome extension, backup, Gdocs export, sharing by url. 1 month full access free.

Title: Brickcenter
Description: Bonus #uneIAparjour: Brickcenter (https://brickcenter.net) to create images in famous building bricks (with a “portrait” module down at the time of the test). Gallery, optional account, unlimited.

Title: Inspir
Description: Inspir (https://inspir.app) offers several learning-oriented chatbots, several digital skills-oriented, one for conversing with “personalities” and one more neutral. LLM not specified. FR if requested. Free with account and unlimited.

Title: B discover
Description: B discover (https://bdiscover.kakaobrain.com) generates images and can animate them. Portrait, gallery and remix mode possible. Free 1:1 image generation, for iOS and Android. Unlimited images and 5 free videos.

Title: Ohai
Description: Ohai (https://beta.ohai.bot) allows you to dialogue freely with characters shared or in stories available in the gallery. Even if oriented towards movies, series and manga, any type of characters can be created. FR accepted, unlimited beta.

Title: Midreal
Description: Midreal (https://midreal.ai) generates long stories from a prompt. Each part is illustrated, leads are then suggested or a new request is added to continue the story. FR if specified. 10 credits at the opening and 10 /month.

Title: Instaclass
Description: Instaclass (https://myinstaclass.com) generates courses from a conversation. Chapters with YouTube video, links to articles, image, quizzes and crosswords. FR ok with still some EN. Beta, 1 free course generated, access to existing courses.

Title: Summate
Description: Summate (https://summate.it) summarizes web pages in the browser language. Short and long formats. 10 free summaries without account then 10/month with account.Sources:– https://bienvenue.reseau-canope.fr/ia-en-classe– https://edunumrech.hypotheses.org/10764” https://chaireunescorelia.univ-nantes.fr/2024/04/11/lancement-du-gtnum-genial/…

Title: AiGPT
Description: AiGPT (http://aigptfree.com) is a text and image chatbot on Telegram with several models (GPT 3.5 and 4, llama, mistral, dall-e, SDXL). Features down during the test (pdf and url files, prompt help). In EN, FR ok. Free and unlimited.

Title: Retinello
Description: Retinello (https://retinello.com) creates flashcards and open questionnaires from a topic, a pdf or a text transmitted. Chatbot and follow-up table included. FR ok in direct generation, not for pdf. Free credits seem set in stone?

Title: Automateed
Description: Automateed (https://ai.automateed.com) generates editable digital books (export doc and pdf) from a subject and offers a hundred specialized tools. Fr ok if specified. 2 chapters of a book for free, unlimited use of tools?

Title: AI Story generator
Description: AI Story generator (https://storygenerate.io) generates short texts based on the choice of a language (EN, SP and FR), a tone (formal, informal, friendly), a genre (9 proposed) and an idea. Text or HTML version, to copy or export pdf. Free and unlimited.

Title: Wegic
Description: Wegic (https://wegic.ai) generates web pages from a conversation, editable live or via the chatbot. 120 free credits (one site = 40 credits, 1 modification 10 credits). Site hosted on Wegic. Test: http://les-iageneratives-en-education-usages-et-limites.wegic.app

Title: Magickpen
Description: Magickpen (http://magickpen.com) offers more than 140 copywriting templates, 12 of which are education-oriented. Possibility to assign a role for the generation. 50 languages possible. Based on ChatGPT (3.5 in the free version), 10 free credits/day.

Title: Text 2 multimedia
Description: Text 2 multimedia (https://text2multimedia.com) offers image generation (up to 10 images for a prompt, seems to be based on Stable diffusion) and text-to-audio transcription (90 voices available). Unlimited with account.

Title: AgentGPT
Description: AgentGPT (https://agentgpt.reworkd.ai/fr) creates “autonomous” agents (chatGPT 3.5 + Stable Diffusion), connected to the web. The agent separates the request into progressive tasks. 5 free agents/day, open-source, sharing. Test: https://agentgpt.reworkd.ai/agent?id=clw3xxjrk012tks09wj3f430s…

Title: Tengr
Description: Tengr (https://tengr.ai) generates images from two modes: “Seer”, creative, and “Servitor”, more faithful to the original query. 19 styles, multiple formats, degrees of creativity and detail. Image to image. 100 free images per day.

Title: Relume
Description: Relume (https://relume.io) generates complete and editable website plans from a query. Collaborative and with shareable url. Several possible exports including figma and csv. 1 free project.

Title: Vivago
Description: Vivago (https://vivago.ai) generates images and videos from a request. Image and video settings offered (negative prompt, format, image to image, image to text, color, enlargement, eraser, movement…). Gallery and sharing. Free (and unlimited?).

Title: Twelve Labs
Description: Twelve Labs (http://twelvelabs.io) indexes videos (uploaded or YouTube) and then allows you to classify them, search for specific terms and generate summaries, important moments and chapters. V. beta, 10 hours of videos for free. FR if specified.

Title: Gizmo
Description: Gizmo (https://gizmo.ai) accompanies revisions with flashcards and MCQs created from documents, urls, videos, photos, notes. Follow-up in 3 levels: discovery, learning and mastery. Chatbot, possible teams, unlimited cards and MCQs, app.

Title: Quicksight
Description: Quicksight (https://quicksight.ai) allows you to search for objects, text or audio in downloaded videos. Points to the precise passage. Beta version, 200 min free. Test from https://pexels.com/fr-fr/videos/, https://archive.org/details/movies and example.

Title: Socrates
Description: Socrates (https://asksocrates.app) analyzes pdf and doc documents directly from the Mac / Windows computer (performance depends on the computer). 2 LLM, Llama (1GB) and Bge (200MB) in local, free, unlimited version / GPT in paid cloud version. + 100 free GPT 3.5 and 20 GPT 4 messages per month on the cloud version with 1 chat of 5 documents max. Source of documents: https://bienvenue.reseau-canope.fr/ia-en-classe

Title: DreamStudio
Description: DreamStudio (https://dreamstudio.ai), a @StabilityAI image generation tool with SDXL 1.0, styles, negative prompt and advanced settings. Variation, editing and partial export possible. English prompts recommended. Beta with 125 free images.

Title: Chat with pdf
Description: Chat with pdf (https://pdfflex.com/ai-chat-with-pdf…) allows you to query pdf documents up to 10 MB, without account, for free, unlimited and without storing documents. Does not analyze images of documents. In English, accepts French if specified.Sources: – https://bienvenue.reseau-canope.fr/ia-en-classe – https://edunumrech.hypotheses.org/10764 ” https://gouvernement.fr/actualite/25-recommandations-pour-lia-en-france…

Title: Teachguin
Description: Teachguin (https://teachguin.ai) guides via an assistant the creation of courses from the subject to the video presentation, including the plan, the slides with images and the questions. Private beta -> 07/24, public from 07/24 to 12/24.

Title: Rationale
Description: Rationale (https://rationale.jina.ai) accompanies understanding/decision by generating advantages, disadvantages, swot, comparison and consequences. Relying on personas. 1 credit per generation. Free version: credits are obtained when you use it.

Title: Lesson Up
Description: Lesson Up (https://lessonup.com) generates lesson plans from a query or text. Plans that can be transformed into presentations, editable and shareable for video. Unlimited courses and 10 presentations/month in free version.

Title: Auto Classmate
Description: Auto Classmate (https://autoclassmate.io/tools/) offers several modules for education, 3 of which are free, account-free and unlimited: activity generator, “do you prefer” question and prediction of the result of an activity. Export pdf. FR ok if specified.

Title: Coze
Description: Coze (https://coze.com) allows the creation of custom chatbots from multiple sources and plugins (ChatGPT, Gemini, Dall-e, Leonardo…). Store and multi-platform publishing. Unlimited. Test (access without account): https://coze.com/store/bot/7373395929258442758?bot_id=true…

Title: Designer Quiz
Description: Quiz designer (https://labs.thenational.academy/quiz-designer) generates the answer choices to the questions asked for a quiz. Choice of the number of correct answers, editing and regeneration possible, export ppt, txt, csv or gift. Beta version, 120 generations per day free.

Title: Dicte
Description: Dicte (https://dicte.ai): a tool dedicated to the transcription of oral information (meetings, conferences, etc.) offered by@livdeo » Transcription, reports, analysis of conclusions and follow-up to be given, swot and chatbot. Local recordings on the device.Encrypted recordings before processing. Possible editing of transcripts, relevant chatbot, recognition of the different stakeholders. Free Android and iOS beta, processing available on the website. Test sincehttps://YouTube.com/live/5PTwEZ7U6RE?si=YyyodBSQS9jHYxMWEdit: final version launched, 2 hours free per month

Title: Genie by Luma labs
Description: Genie from Luma labs (https://lumalabs.ai/genie) generates 3D objects from a text query. Gallery with prompts for inspiration. Possible conversion in high resolution and export in 6 formats including stl for 3D printing. Free and unlimited.

Title: GPTs from ChatGPT
Description: A well-known tool ;), https://chatgpt.com, and hundreds of possibilities: “GPTs” now available to all free (limited) accounts in the GPT4o version. Have you already spotted any that seemed interesting to you? First tests:

Title: Keypush
Description: Keypush (https://keypush.ai): A search engine that includes Bing and ChatGPT. Each can be selected at the beginning of the search with “b” or “c”. Without this choice, Keypush chooses the one that seems most suitable for the query. FR ok. Without account.

Title: Consistent character
Description: Consistent character (https://consistent-character.com/playground) allows, with a loaded image and a prompt, to keep the same character in a series of portraits with different frames, clothes or poses. Free and unlimited, export png, jpg. Images: Wikimedia / Pexel.

Title: Petalica
Description: Petalica (https://petalica.com) colorizes black and white drawings with three styles Possibility of selection and choice of colors by zones or delimitation. No account and unlimited. Image sources: Freepik.

Title: Turboscribe
Description: Turboscribe (https://turboscribe.ai) transcribes audio files into text with timing, 11 import formats, 5 export formats. Quick to copy/paste for text analysis. 3 free 30-minute transcriptions per day. Sources http://audiocite.net

Title: Stylar
Description: Stylar (https://stylar.ai) generates images with 170 styles, “text to image”, “image to image”, new generation in a selected area or image enlargement in the same gallery tool. 200 free credits /month.

Title: Guidde
Description: Guidde (https://guidde.com) allows you to make video tutorials from an extension. Clicks are recorded and texts are generated. Music and voice possible. 25 free tutorials. Test with http://uneIAparjour.fr: https://app.guidde.com/share/playbooks/isoh2ENoZ6R1Qgkr5Wcnzu?origin=CH1wZEjKRKY0uBe3SpeA8TRwaMB2

Title: Pimento
Description: Pimento (http://pimento.design) generates images from text or other images. Generation of elements in plotted areas. Gallery of styles available and custom styles, improvement. 600 images and 2 styles in free version (300 images/ style)

Title: Zebracat
Description: Zebracat (http://zebracat.ai) generates videos (images, voice and music) from a prompt or url with scenario generation and editable images. Realistic voices. 25 credits/month (2 short videos). Tests: prompt and https://reseau-canope.fr/intelligence-artificielle.html

Title: NousWise
Description: NousWise (https://nouswise.com): search tool based on our own documents (uploaded or Gdrive). Generates the answer by quoting specific passages. Notes and organization of searches saved. Documents up to 50 MB. Free and unlimited.

Title: AI Chat by DuckDuckGo
Description: AI Chat de @DuckDuckGo (https://duckduckgo.com/?q=DuckDuckGo+AI+Chat&ia=chat&duckai=1) offers 4 LLMs (GPT 3.5 and claude, Llama, mixtral in light versions) with privacy. No history, not connected. Free and without account. Via @benovigo + @a_happy_teacher

Title: People ai
Description: People ai (https://peopleai.app) offers to converse with 96 historical figures, scientists, authors, philosophers, musicians (only 20 women…). The “dinner party” function allows you to start a conversation with 4 people. No account and unlimited.

Title: AI Writer
Description: AI Writer (https://ai-writer.org) generates texts from a query in a clean word processing environment (LLM?). Advanced editing, adding images and YouTube video, AI possible on texts. Local saving, unlimited, without account

Title: Seelab
Description: Seelab (https://seelab.ai @seelab_app) is a tool – French – dedicated to image generation with editing tools and custom templates. Advanced generation, area replacement and removal. Beta with 30 images/day and 1 free custom template.

Title: Dream Machine
Description: Dream Machine from Luma Labs (https://lumalabs.ai/dream-machine) generates videos from a prompt or image. 30 free videos per month (5 sec. videos).Tests:” https://lumalabs.ai/dream-machine/creations/893bf455-7355-429f-ab6e-69f8d6522ea2…– https://lumalabs.ai/dream-machine/creations/2be5e131-013c-4115-bbcf-c2b4debeb754… (Wikipedia image) ” https://storage.cdn-luma.com/lit_lite_inference_text2vid_v1.0/5a1af3ae-2937-4999-b3e9-bc39885d57da/watermarked_video020cc83691c4e4bbe87abbc1a68c68e95.mp4…

Title: Amnesia
Description: Amnesia (https://playamnesia.com) generates interactive stories in which you are the hero, historical or science fiction, with contextualization. Entry by theme or location/time period. Choice of buttons or chat. Generates in FR if specified. No account and unlimited.

Title: LearnWorlds
Description: LearnWorlds (http://learnworlds.com) generates the online course outline and the site that hosts them. Suggested content to be imported. Multiple activities and imports possible, fully editable, learner tracking, mobile app. 30 days of free use.

Title: CgDream
Description: CgDream (https://cgdream.ai) generates images from a query. Numerous settings, + 100 filters, deletion of elements, gallery. 1200 free images / month with queue and premium features.

Title: Gentype
Description: Google Labs Gentype (https://labs.google/gentype) generates the 26 letters of the alphabet from a query. The letters and words formed are exportable. Supports background and view type. Free and unlimited.

Title: Slidespeak
Description: Slidespeak (https://slidespeak.co) combines document analysis (doc, pdf, ppt, xls, 1 single in free version and without account) and generator of presentations from document or query. Export ppt or pdf, custom templates possible.

Title: Cleft
Description: Cleft (https://cleftnotes.com): iOS note-taking application based on an audio request. The transcribed note (to be improved) is increased and formatted by text generation. Sharing by url. Free beta.

Title: Hedra
Description: Hedra (https://hedra.com) animates faces and makes them speak from a portrait and text, with predefined or recorded voices. French accepted. Free and unlimited beta version. Sources: http://thispersondoesnotexist.com and Wikipedia.

Title: SlidesGPT
Description: SlidesGPT (https://slidesgpt.com) generates a presentation from a request for free and without account. Text, images (Unsplash), notes, sharing via URL. 2 templates, paid download. Tests: https://slidesgpt.com/l/edLj / https://slidesgpt.com/l/8KTH Via @TirotG

Title: LTX Studio
Description: LTX Studio (https://ltx.studio) generates a film from idea to realization with storyboard, editing of shots, music and voice. Prompt FR ok but generation in EN. Export storyboard, xml for editing or mp4. Beta on waiting list, 1 hour per month free.

Title: Artifacts of Claude 3.5 Sonnet
Description: Claude 3.5 Sonnet and its “artifacts” (https://anthropic.com/news/claude-3-5-sonnet… – via the “features” menu) generates live documents on the screen (markdown texts, code, SVG…). 3 tests: text, flappy bird and animation for education. 10 to 15 free messages per day.

Title: Flexclip
Description: Flexclip (https://flexclip.com) generates a video with subtitles and music from a request, URL or text. Chrome extension. 12 online projects and watermark export in free version. Source AI day @reseau_canope : https://reseau-canope.fr/intelligence-artificielle.html…

Title: Mentimeter
Description: Mentimeter (https://mentimeter.com) generates presentations and their modules for interaction with the public. Numerous modules, fully editable and trackable with dashboard. 50 unique visitors / month free (calculation after presentation).

Title: Stage
Description: Scene (http://scene.io) supports website design with a “Muse AI” assistant, from reflection to text and site generation. Editable, collaborative, publishing blocks. FR ok if specified. 2 projects and 10 free conversations.

Title: Blank
Description: Blank (https://theblankapp.com) is a game that consists of filling in the missing fields of a prompt identical to all of them each day to generate an image. The application provides definitions and allows randomness. Daily training at the prompt?

Title: FreeAIChatbot
Description: FreeAIChatbot (https://freeaichatbot.org) a multimodal and multi-language language model (Claude, GPT4, Phi, Llama) chatbot with local storage of conversations. With account and unlimited. Source tests: Unesco and AI government report.

Title: Diagramix
Description: Diagramix (https://diagramix.ai) generates data visualizations from a query (8 visualization types available). Unlimited, account-free access with GPT 3.5 and GPT 4 with account, iteration possible with account. Live editable code.

Title: Learning with AI
Description: Learning with AI (https://apprendreaveciapro.ca) offers two chatbots to “check” or “develop skills and knowledge”. Developed by @ContactNorth and based on GPT 4, available in 19 languages and 4 learning levels, account-free and unlimited.

Title: Right Blogger
Description: Right Blogger (https://rightblogger.com) offers text generation tools to accompany the publication. Limited free version (no personal base or tone) with 70 tools available including article generation and summary.

Title: Bagoodex
Description: Bagoodex (https://bagoodex.io) includes search engine, conversational agent and personas. Privacy notice (see privacypolicy). Catalog of personas (including image generation) and the possibility of creating them. No account and unlimited.

Title: Talk to AI
Description: Talk to AI (https://talkto.ai) is a text chatbot that offers to converse with one of the 21 predefined personas: developer, film critic, lawyer, philosopher, etc. Based on the Bert and RobertA models. In EN, specify FR. No account and unlimited.

Title: Slides Bot
Description: Slides Bot (https://slides.bot) generates presentations from a query or a document (pdf, txt, doc, xls, csv). Progress is made via a chatbot. Unsplash text and image slide. Export via slidesGPT. Without account, 5 slides/day.

Title: AI Music Generator
Description: AI Music Generator (https://ai-music-generator.ai) generates music tracks from a query or proposed text and style. Gallery, Sharing and Albums. MP3 Export.Tests: – https://ai-music-generator.ai/fr/song/30b45024-c6e1-4ec5-87b7-fdb49a026aec– https://ai-music-generator.ai/fr/song/4c4e8e37-10aa-4ab6-9fdf-3c62ea9e063010 Free Songs

Title: Wonderweave
Description: Wonderweave (https://wonderweave.app) generates stories from a character – recurring – and a query. Short stories with image and voice EN. FR if specified. No sharing possible. 14 days in full version then free and limited.

Title: Generation Image by Vittascience
Description: Generation Image @Vittascience (https://fr.vittascience.com/ia/image-generate.php) generates images from Segmind from Stable Diffusion. Prompt negative, 9 styles available and level of creativity. 6 stages of generation displayed and then animated. No account.

Title: Generation Text by Vittascience
Description: Generation @Vittascience Text (https://fr.vittascience.com/ia/text.php) generates text from Mixtral, Gemma, ChatGPT and Llama (limited for large LLMs). Setting the creativity level, 18 prepompts and displaying relationships between tokens. No account.

Title: Swift
Description: Swift (https://swift-ai.vercel.app): a voice assistant based on LLama developed by Groq, Cartesia and Vercel. Quick reaction allows conversations (FR if specified, English voice). Conversation memory. Open source: https://github.com/ai-ng/swif

Title: Just the answer
Description: Just the answer (http://justtheanswer.vercel.app) provides short answers to a query while offering possible bounces via links. Connected, gives its sources (arrow at the top left). Accepts the FR. LLM + unknown author. No account and unlimited.

Title: 1 min AI
Description: 1 min AI (https://1min.ai) brings together language and image models in the same interface. Many tools offered, generation from several models with the same prompt. 250000 free credits then 15000 per day, variable costs/model.

Title: Shakker v2
Description: Shakker (https://shakker.ai/aigenerator) groups image generation models (Stable diffusion and internal model) with filters and advanced functions. Enlarging and retouching tools. 300 free credits then 200/month (about 5 per generation).

Title: Promo
Description: Promo (https://promo.com) generates several videos from a url and a description. Edited with video clips, music and text. A chatbot allows you to make changes. Free generations with link, paid download.Examples:– https://promo.com/planner/share/post/ee61519a-b846-4692-a546-86886768ea22/4f19ad8e-11e7-44ae-a734-3a7096260568?utm_source=planner-video-share-page– https://promo.com/planner/share/post/9603cc8b-ee4f-430e-980c-5b56bb989c3e/74ba9d38-752f-40a0-87fc-b39812b14446?utm_source=planner-video-share-page– https://promo.com/planner/share/post/baa30dcf-08d8-41d1-ba73-ef3d45cf6517/df537198-b49d-4e37-8559-cbbe0b152d04?utm_source=planner-video-share-page

Title: AI Story Generator
Description: AI Story Generator (https://ai-storygenerator.net/fr) generates stories in 9 languages and 5 styles (common, bedtime stories, wuxia – “knight-errant” fictions, thriller and humor). Tests with “a fox meets a crow”. No account.

Title: Pdf summarizer
Description: Pdf summarizer (https://mymap.ai/pdf-summarizer): new Mymap tool already seen on #uneIAparjour Summarizes even long pdfs and integrates Mymap tools. Without account with a limit of about ten interactions. Test with “REPIA report” Canopé https://reseau-canope.fr/agence-des-usages/dossiers-thematiques_intelligence-artificielle.html

Title: Tiny Wow
Description: Tiny Wow, the well-known toolbox, offers more than 50 text generation tools (https://tinywow.com/tools/write). In FR but sometimes need to be specified. Note: also image generation tools, which are not very efficient. No account with ads.

Title: Naria
Description: Naria (https://naria.ai) generates children’s books step by step, from the character definition and story to the different pages. Each step is configurable. FR accepted if specified. Free and unlimited sharing (paid printing).

Title: Briefy
Description: Briefy (https://briefy.ai) summarizes web pages via a Chrome or Safari extension iOS. 3 formats are available – text, mind map or table – and a chatbot is available. Sharing possible.

Title: Dorik
Description: Dorik (http://dorik.com) generates a website with a blog from a title and a description. Fine configuration, numerous templates and visit tracking. 5 sites of 5 pages and 20 free and hosted blog posts. Review: https://iageneducation.dorik.io

Title: Consensus
Description: Consensus (https://consensus.app) allows research and synthesis with its “copilot” function of scientific articles. Numerous filters and tools, export and sharing.

Title: Fliz
Description: Fliz (http://fliz.ai) generates image, voice and subtitle videos from a URL or text in the manner of a trailer or product highlight. 3 formats, editable text, multiple voices. 5 free credits/month (1 to 2 videos)

Title: Mixart
Description: Mixart (https://mixart.ai) generates images from 30 different models (several based on Stable Diffusion SDXL). Advanced generation tools: negative prompt, image to image, weight, formats, resolution… 10 free images per month.

Title: VoxCraft
Description: VoxCraft (https://voxcraft.ai) generates 3D models from uploaded images. Online and via a Discord server. Coming soon: text to 3D. Export obj. format 200 free credits per month, 2000 at the opening (100 for a generation, in CC if free).

Title: Xanton
Description: Xanton (https://xantonai.com) offers to converse with 15 historical figures via its chatbot. FR accepted. Suggestion of new bots possible. Creators and LLMs not specified. Free and unlimited beta version.

Title: Auraflow
Description: Auraflow (https://huggingface.co/spaces/multimodalart/AuraFlow…) is a new opensource image generation model with 6.8 billion parameters (documentation: https://huggingface.co/fal/AuraFlow). Advanced features available. Beta version, unlimited.

Title: Sensai
Description: Sensai (https://sensay.io) offers dialogue with personas created and to create your own avatar or others from questionnaires with training. Voice possible. Test with Victor Hugo (source Wikipedia) as an avatar: https://sensay.io/victorhugo

Title: Brev AI
Description: Brev AI (https://brev.ai) generates music tracks from provided queries or lyrics. 2 songs per generation.

Title: Qwen 2
Description: Qwen 2 (project: https://huggingface.co/Qwen and demo on Hugging Face: https://huggingface.co/spaces/Qwen/Qwen2-57b-a14b-instruct-demo…) is a language model open-source developed by @AlibabaGroup.

Title: Giz
Description: Giz (https://giz.ai) brings together language models, images, audio and videos in a single interface with multiple tools: text, images, video, music, video games, etc. Note: generation of sourced news bulletins. Unlimited beta.

Title: Venice
Description: Venice (https://venice.ai) brings together text/code chatbot and image generation with different models including an “uncensored” LLM in beta version. 100 text requests and 20 image generations per day in the free version without account.

Title: Genspark v1
Description: Genspark (https://genspark.ai) is a multiple, connected and sourced search engine, with generated syntheses: classic, images, trips and products. Free beta version, accessible without account, account allows access to a chatbot and bookmarks.

Title: Haiper
Description: Haiper (https://haiper.ai) generates short videos from a text request or from an image. Advanced tools (modification of objects, seed, duration…). Beta version, 300 credits and 10 free generations per day. URL sharing or mp4 export.

Title: Free PDF summarizer
Description: Free PDF summarizer (https://pdfsummarizer.net) allows dialogue with pdf files up to 10 MB via a chatbot. Based on ChatGPT 3.5, can answer on other topics. FR ok, free and without account. Tests with the https://info.gouv.fr/actualite/25-recommandations-pour-lia-en-france report…

Title: Pro Feed
Description: Flux pro (https://replicate.com/black-forest-labs/flux-pro) is a new image generation template with powerful text-in-image generation management. Demo with fine adjustments to test on Replicate. Free account and free – via @cmelian

Title: MemFree
Description: MemFree (https://memfree.me) offers search engine and chatbot + “Ask” combination of the 2. GPT 4o mini in free version, chrome extension for bookmarks. A few searches without account then 10 free searches per day. Open source.

Title: Music Hero
Description: Music Hero (https://musichero.ai) generates music from a prompt and/or lyrics/musical style. Without account, 5×2 generations/day. Sharing and exporting mp3.

Title: Liner
Description: Liner (https://getliner.com): general/academic search engine with synthesis. Agent creation and sharing. Unlimited searches with the “Basic” model.

Title: Homeworkify
Description: Homeworkify (https://homeworkify.im) uses ChatGPT 4 to respond to text and/or pdf and photo document requests (several possible). Without account, 5 requests per 24 hours. Tests with AI government report, personal images and Wikipedia images.

Title: Lumen Peak
Description: Pic Lumen (https://piclumen.com) generates images from three “in-house” and Flux models (see #uneIAparjour of 02/08). Gallery, advanced settings including negative and seed prompt, image to image, remix and background erasure. Export and share url. Unlimited with account.

Title: Olovka
Description: Olovka (http://olovka.ai) generates long texts in academic style with advanced editing possible from the summary to the final writing. Quizzes (in English) can be generated and 1 chatbot is proposed. Export doc or HTML. 10000 free words per month.

Title: Playcast
Description: Playcast (https://playcast.ai) generates summaries of texts, documents, URLs or YouTube videos as podcast episodes available in dedicated apps. Example in Apple podcast. Gallery, FR ok. 5 free documents / episodes.

Title: Intellecs
Description: Intellecs (https://intellecs.ai): advanced note-taking with text generation from a question or querying pdf files up to 50 pages. Writing assistance with reformulation. 20 questions per day and 10 free notes per day.

Title: Lucky
Description: Perchance (https://perchanceai.cc) generates images from 75 different styles without account and from Flux (see post of 02/08) or Stable Diffusion with account – 20 credits per month for free. Simple features: format, negative prompt and gallery.

Title: Bloom
Description: Bloom (https://bloom-seven.vercel.app) generates three-part courses – beginner, intermediate, advanced – based on YouTube videos. Generation in French if specified in the topic definition steps. 2 courses per account.

Title: AI Flash cards
Description: AI Flash cards (https://aiflash.cards) generates flash cards from a request or a text (url and pdf on subscription) with progress tracking. 3 generations without account, 10 with account then 1 /hour in free version. Export .doc and .xls

Title: Documator
Description: Documator (https://documator.cc) summarizes pdf documents up to 10 MB with GPT4o. 3 pages by page summarization and translation modes. 6 languages available. Unlimited and without account. Documents for the test: https://reseau-canope.fr/agence-des-usages/dossiers-thematiques_intelligence-artificielle.html… and https://edunumrech.hypotheses.org

Title: Immersity
Description: Immersity (https://immersity.ai) animates still images in video or 3D image with many settings offered (movement, focus…). Video export with watermark for free, without possibility with 100 credits offered or on subscription. Wikimedia sources.

Title: Color
Description: Color (https://color.lol) generates drawings to color from two modes: “WordMode” for a generation from a text query or from proposed examples and “KidsMode” from a combination of 4 pictograms. 10 free drawings.

Title: AI Video Cut
Description: AI Video Cut (http://aivideocut.com) transforms YouTube videos into clips (trailer or key points). Based on ChatGPT, multiple shapes and formats. Free and unlimited mp4 export. Test with @AsmaMhalla for @brutofficiel: https://youtu.be/qrDk4puMCQk?si=cR_55vVQhJdYKJxE…

Title: MiniPerplx
Description: MiniPerplx (https://mplx.run) is a minimalist search engine combined with GPT4o: summary of the search, sources cited and suggestions for further investigation. No account, unlimited and open-source (GitHub: https://github.com/zaidmukaddam/miniperplx/…)

Title: Juno
Description: Juno (http://heyjuno.co) generates surveys/polls from a topic and objectives in the language of the query. After answering the questions in chatbot format, generating a summary (in EN). 14 days free (no plans announced afterwards).

Title: Tripo 3d
Description: Tripo 3d (http://tripo3d.ai) generates 3D models from a text or image query. Advanced settings for the query and then modifications after generation. 4 images per generation, export in GLB. 600 free credits per month (10 x 4 images).

Title: Cartwhell
Description: Cartwhell (https://getcartwheel.com/home) generates animated 3D characters from a query. Multiple editing possibilities, export to video in free version. Beta with unlimited generations. To illustrate motor skills or PE sessions?

Title: Backpack
Description: Backpack (https://backpackbot.ai) generates music with lyrics from images or videos with a style, with or without a request, from Discord. Generations in English (maybe possible in FR?). Free and unlimited. Sources: Wikimedia and Pexels.

Title: AI Lingo Play
Description: AI Lingo Play (https://ailingoplay.com) offers to exchange via a chatbot in 10 languages around everyday situations. 3 levels offered. Audio and microphone available, translation and detailed explanations. Free beta and without account.

Title: Happy Pages
Description: Happy Pages (https://happypagesai.com) generates coloring pages from a query and an age group (2/5 years old, 6/11 and + 12 years old). Gallery of 5000 images with search engine available. Export in png format. 5 free generations per week.

Title: Amigo Chat
Description: Amigo Chat (https://amigochat.io): a multi-faceted chatbot with hundreds of personas, from text and image generators to historical/fictional characters or summaries. Online, iOS app / Android, WhatsApp, Telegram. No account and unlimited.

Title: Omnisets
Description: Omnisets (https://omnisets.com) generates flash cards from a query, notes, documents or videos. Several consultation modes with quiz, memory, text response and follow-up. In FR if specified. 50 collections of 20 free cards.

Title: Photosolve
Description: Photosolve (https://photosolve.io) offers to solve school exercises from a photo taken and to explain the answer. A generalist chatbot is also present with image recognition. 20 free requests then 3 per day.

Title: Pdf Gen
Description: Pdf Gen (https://pdfgen.com) simply generates document templates in pdf format from a query: lists, forms to fill in, etc. (can generate other short texts). No modification possible, export only. 50 free documents.

Title: Llama coder
Description: Llama coder (https://llamacoder.together.ai) creates apps from a request in the manner of Claude.ai’s Artifacts. Chat improvement. Open source: https://github.com/nutlope/llamacoder…. Publishability. No account and unlimited.

Title: Felo
Description: Felo (https://felo.ai): a search engine coupled with a language model, written answer and cited sources, with the possibility of a mind map. No account and unlimited, with account for backup. Audio, iOS app and Android available.

Title: Co Grader
Description: Co Grader (http://cograder.com) accompanies the evaluation of student work: creation of criteria and grids, reasoned feedback. Editable generations, returns in FR (rest in EN). 30 days free then 100 submissions/month. Corrected bac @philomag

Title: Napkin
Description: Napkin (http://napkin.ai) augments a generated or imported text with visual presentations or infographics. Editing tools. Free pro access during this v. beta then 3 free productions. Test: https://app.napkin.ai/page/CgoiCHByb2Qtb25lEiwKBFBhZ2UaJGJiY2VkNmY4LWZjM2EtNDViMi04YmYzLTA5ZjllYzQ0OTY4MA?s=1…

Title: Merlin
Description: Merlin (https://getmerlin.in) combines several AI tools: #texte and image generation, document or web page analysis, code and creation of chatbots via its site or an extension. Several text and image models. 102 free requests per day.

Title: Illuminovel
Description: Illuminovel (https://illuminovel.com) generates the portraits in images of the characters of a complete literary text in pdf or epub. Without accounts and seems unlimited. Model not specified. Tests with “The War of the Buttons” by Pergaud and “A Life” by Maupassant.

Title: Mumble
Description: Mumble (http://mumbleapp.com): a note-taking application that transcribes audio and organizes with the addition of a To-Do list.

Title: Notdiamond
Description: Notdiamond (http://chat.notdiamond.ai) is a chatbot that groups together 11 language models and chooses the most relevant one based on the query. Documents and images accepted (4MB). Arena mode that compares models. Connected. 100000 requests / month.

Title: Think Any
Description: Think Any (https://thinkany.ai): search engine coupled with a language model with cited sources. 3 light models in the free, account-free and unlimited version: GPT 4o mini, Gemini flash and Claude 3 haiku. Sharing of results by the displayed URL.

Title: Gummi
Description: Gummi includes a tool to help write social media posts from images (text and music proposal) and a multimodal chatbot accepting pdf and images. 100000 free requests (with advertising).Review with cover of “Listen to the Sirens” by Fabrice Melquiot and report@UNESCO_fr https://unesdoc.unesco.org/ark:/48223/pf0000389901… Download links:

Title: Feyn
Description: Feyn (https://feyn.ai) proposes to explore a topic in stages: each generation ends with a quiz (FR ok but can sometimes be in English) that determines the next generation based on the answer. GPT 3.5? No account and unlimited.

Title: Kling
Description: Kling (http://klingai.com) generates images and videos from text requests and/or images. Fine, negative prompt and gallery adjustments available. 5-second videos with camera movements. 100 free credits per month.Edit 01/26: evolution of models and features, see below.

Title: LoudMe
Description: Edit 08/25: now paid.LoudMe generates music (https://loudme.ai/ai-music-generator) or sound effects (https://loudme.ai/sound-effect-generator), with or without lyrics from an already generated prompt or track. Royalty-free tracks. Lyrics in French if specified. 100 credits per month (20 songs and 50 sound effects).

Title: PhiloGPT
Description: PhiloGPT (https://philogpt.vmirebeau.fr): a chatbot, based on ChatGPT 4, which allows you to interact with 26 personas, mainly philosophers. Group discussions possible. Export in doc. Open source, documentation: https://forge.apps.education.fr/vmirebeau/philogpt/… via @franckbodin

Title: Nolan
Description: Nolan (http://nolanai.app) accompanies the writing of a screenplay to the storyboard: editable generation with AI tools, illustrations with generated images. Some limited features and AI assistant for 30 days in the free version.

Title: Firefox AI Chatbot
Description: Firefox AI Chatbot (https://mozilla.org/fr/firefox/) allows a permanent display of 5 chatbots in the browser window (Claude, ChatGPT, Hugging chat, Gemini, Mistral), in connection with the pages viewed. Available in Firefox Labs, via @CedricRidel

Title: Cabina
Description: Cabina (https://cabina.ai) brings together 6 language models and 5 image models in the same chatbot with possible comparison. Documents, connected, with fine-tuning of the models, tones and multiple actions. 100 credits/month +10 per day.

Title: Firefly’s Generative Filling
Description: Flirefly’s generative fill (https://firefly.adobe.com/upload/inpaint) offers 3 functions for generating from an image, with or without prompt: enlarging, inserting or deleting parts of the image. Mona Lisa: Wikipedia. 25 generation credits / month.

Title: MyPlato
Description: MyPlato (https://myplato.ai) supports the understanding of pdf documents and given topics in a prompt via a chatbot, flashcards and quizzes. Based on ChatGPT (3.5?). Specify French, automatic generation in English. With account and unlimited.

Title: Vose
Description: Vose (https://vose.ai) generates images from 3 templates (realism, anime, universal – the first two most accomplished?). Advanced settings (negative prompt, seed, size), pretty good text management, gallery with filters. 100 images per month free.

Title: Overall GPT
Description: Overall GPT (https://overallgpt.com) compares the responses of GPT 4o, Gemini Flash, Claude Sonnet and Llama 450B and summarizes them in a single window. Connected and shared by URL. Analysis of down documents during the test. 2 requests per day without account, 5 with.

Title: Gigabrain
Description: Gigabrain (https://thegigabrain.com) is a search engine coupled with a Reddit-centric generative AI. Summary of results and cited sources are available without account, chatbot and monitoring tool by key topics accessible with account. Sharing by url.

Title: Svg.la
Description: Svg.la generates svg vector images from a text query. Monochrome square images, choice of line size and color. No account and unlimited, commercial use allowed. Images to be downloaded within 30 minutes.

Title: GPGFR
Description: RPGGO (https://rpggo.ai) is a text-based role-playing game generator. Character-based game generation or full game generation with world, characters, action, and chapters. Free generation, 50 game credits then 10 per day free.

Title: Machina
Description: Machina (https://machina.eco – Germany), responsible chatbot: 100% “green” energy, 200% carbon offsetting, ethics (data, bias). 3 language models: Mixtral 8x22B, 8x7B, LLama 3 70B. 2 assistants available. 12 free requests / day.

Title: Doctrina
Description: Doctrina (http://doctrina.ai) offers free quizzes with progress tracking and argumentative texts based on a given topic, a file or the title of a book. Several languages and several tones available, audio possible.

Title: Molmo
Description: Molmo (chatbot: https://molmo.allenai.org): a multimodal language model open-source for image analysis/conversations.Description: https://molmo.allenai.org/blog. Unlimited.Images for testing: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Alps-glaciers.png?uselang=fr… / https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/e/ea/Van_Gogh_-_Starry_Night_-_Google_Art_Project.jpg/520px-Van_Gogh_-_Starry_Night_-_Google_Art_Project.jpg… .

Title: Chat Camera
Description: Chat Camera (https://talkycamera.com/chat-camera) allows analysis and real-time audio or text conversation via the camera (smartphone or tablet) and chatGPT 4o. Source: @cnnum: https://cnnumerique.fr/nos-travaux/pour-un-numerique-au-service-des-savoirs… Free and without account, for iOS and Android.

Title: ToonCrafter
Description: ToonCrafter (https://huggingface.co/spaces/Doubiiu/tooncrafter…) generates a very short video from two images, one at the beginning and one at the end. Fine adjustments available. Open source (GitHub: https://github.com/Doubiiu/ToonCrafter…) and unlimited. Source: Muybridge on Wikipedia

Title: Tiny tools
Description: Tiny tools (https://tiny.aitools.fyi) offers several text generators (image 1) including an “answer” generator, a long text generator, a children’s story generator and one dedicated to poems. French OK, without account and unlimited.

Title: AIPlix
Description: AIPlix (https://aiplix.com) is a iOS and Android browser coupled with a chatbot “Raya” (language model?). Analysis of search results and pages, sorting of tabs, easy passage of pages to the chatbot. Free and without account.

Title: SVG Studio
Description: SVG Studio (https://svgstud.io) offers two tools centered around the SVG format: a generator with advanced functions based on Stable Diffusion and a semantic search engine. Guide and gallery images available. Open source, 40 generations/day.

Title: Compar:IA
Description: Compar:IA (https://comparia.beta.gouv.fr) by http://beta.gouv.fr : a discussion with 2 of 12 “anonymous” LLMs. Choose your preferred answer before discovering the model. Estimation of environmental data by http://ecologits.ai. Via @Jul_Dum

Title: Blend
Description: Blend (https://tryblend.ai): a chatbot embedding LLM and image models (most of which are free) in the same interface. An interesting “graph” mode for comparison. 1000 credits for paid models. Stable video down during the test

Title: RecapioGPT
Description: RecapioGPT (https://recapiogpt.com) offers summaries and analyses from URLs, YouTube video, text or documents. Advanced features (tone, style, language, length and query). 2 summaries without account then 10 per month with free account.

Title: Anything LLM
Description: Anything LLM (https://anythingllm.com) a chatbot with the main language models to be installed locally in your computer with or without API (Windows, Mac, Linux), backup, creation of its rules and possible personal databases.

Title: School AI
Description: School AI (https://schoolai.com) brings together a set of tools dedicated to teachers: sequence generation, quizzes, letters, document querying, specialized chatbots, assistants, etc. US programs, specify FR. Free for teachers

Title: Storytell
Description: Storytell (https://storytell.ai): database-based chatbot for each conversation. Multiple file formats (list: https://docs.storytell.ai/how-to-upload-content…). Uses GPT4o. Free beta. Tests: Unesco AI docs and http://meteo.data.gouv.fr

Title: Ingolette
Description: Lingolette (https://lingolette.com) accompanies language learning via everyday situations in a text and voice chatbot, games, flashcards and comprehension exercises. Instant correction. Premium version with more exercises.

Title: Coursezy
Description: Coursezy (http://coursezy.online) generates online courses up to 5 chapters with YouTube video and quizzes based on a query and a level of difficulty. 3 free generations. Test: https://coursezy.online/course/3520ad99-65c6-4310-a04a-f3e77766a7a4… (access with account)

Title: Fastflux
