Description: Fastflux (https://fastflux.ai) uses the Flux 1.0 model for very fast image generation. By @RunwareAI. Unlimited and without account.

Title: AI video API
Description: AI video API (https://aivideoapi.com) generates short videos (5/6 seconds) from a request and/or image. Uses RunwayML (Pika, Sora, Luma, and Stability announced). 5 free generations.

Title: Hermes 3
Description: Hermes 3 (https://lambda.chat/chatui/) is a language model based on Llama 3.1 announced with greater reasoning skills and more creative. Description and links: https://nousresearch.com/hermes3/. Open source, account-free and unlimited.

Title: Creative Minds
Description: Creative Minds (https://cmind.buzzchat.site) offers several tools including idea generation, learning paths, site code generation, collaborative chatbot, and oral quizzing. Free and unlimited for most features.

Title: Liquid AI
Description: Liquid AI (https://liquid.ai) is an LFM – Liquid Foundation Model – that allows more performance in responses and less resource consumption. 2 sizes. By MIT researchers. In unlimited test here: https://playground.liquid.ai/chat, specify FR.

Title: Cerebella
Description: Cerebella (https://cerebellaapp.com) generates flashcards as well as educational topics with repetition, time-scheduled learning monitoring via notifications and analysis of results. On iOS, with or without account, free beta version.

Title: Chat100ai
Description: Chat100ai (https://chat100.ai/fr): a chatbot that offers chatGPT 4o and Claude 3.5 Sonnet for free and without account (with daily quota?). During the tests, image analysis ok but documents down.

Title: Any model
Description: Any model (https://anymodel.xyz): a chatbot that allows the comparison between the main LLMs and image models. Export pdf. Shared by url. 100 instructions on a selection of models and 5 free images. Test: https://app.anymodel.xyz/api?state=6713ee2d3469fd2e3bb88b7c…

Title: Vizard
Description: Vizard (https://vizard.ai) extracts moments of videos loaded or YouTube. Transcription, summaries, fine editing, several formats, templates and styles, editing tool. 120 min and 10 free exports per month. Test: https://youtu.be/ZZBLPI_pVNQ of @Bpifrance

Title: AI Pixel
Description: AI Pixel (http://pixel-art.ai) generates pixel art images from an instruction, editing and compositing tool via the studio (https://studio.pixel-art.ai). Generations without account with watermark, studio with.

Title: Pixtral
Description: Pixtral (available on Le Le Chat https://chat.mistral.ai): language model of @MistralAI that accepts and analyzes attached images. Several possible images processed in a single instruction. Test sources: Wikipedia, personal and generated images.

Title: Speednote
Description: Speednote (https://speednote.ai) generates notes from a few words, which can be modified in a word processor-like interface. Generation without account and saving with account possible. 15 notes per day for free.

Title: Hotshot
Description: Hotshot (https://hotshot.co) generates short videos from an instruction. Instructions are improved. 3 generations of 3 seconds free per day.

Title: Kajiwoto
Description: Kajiwoto (https://kajiwoto.ai) allows you to create conversational agents based on personas that can interact. Fine definitions and pre-instructions, several language models available. Sharing and collaboration. 1 free room.

Title: Stable Diffusion 3.5
Description: Stable Diffusion 3.5 (https://stability.ai/news/introducing-stable-diffusion-3-5…) is the latest image generation model from @StabilityAI. Available in two versions: wide and wide turbo (very fast generation). Free and unlimited on https://huggingface.co/stabilityai

Title: AI image creator
Description: AI image creator (https://topvsbest.com/aiimagecreator) generates images in a simple interface from an instruction (based on Stable Diffusion?). Free, no account and seems unlimited.

Title: Factbot
Description: Factbot de @snopes (https://snopes.com/factbot/): search engine based on Claude Sonnet that analyzes false information from articles on the US decryption site. FR OK, a dozen searches without account then unlimited free account.

Title: Neural Blender
Description: Neural Blender (https://neuralblender.com) generates images from two models “Mnemosyne” and “Koios” in a simple interface. Unlimited and free use with images generated under CC-BY license.

Title: Claptools
Description: Claptools (https://claptools.com) generates content in social media formats. Copy/paste from the thread X test to follow and YouTube/Linkedin examples below. Uses to be considered outside of these network models. Free with advertising.

Title: Arlinear
Description: Arlinear (http://arlinear.com) generates quizzes from a topic and/or a pdf document. Editing, quoting the pages used in the pdf, training mode, tracking. Export pdf or share link / iframe. 5 quizzes / 25 answers per quiz in free version. Source for the test: https://unesdoc.unesco.org/ark:/48223/pf0000391105…

Title: Recraft v3
Description: Recraft (https://www.recraft.ai/) offers the 3rd version of its image generation template, the mysterious “red_panda” that appeared 3 days ago (https://tomsguide.com/ai/mysterious-new-red-panda-ai-image-generator-appears-out-of-nowhere-is-this-a-new-dall-e…). Online, an interesting Canva mode for layouts. 50 free credits per day.

Title: ChatGPT Search
Description: ChatGPT Search (https://chatgpt.com): search engine now integrated into ChatGPT that can be used directly in the usual interface. Citation of sources in the generation and links from the search engine at the end of the generation. Via @outilstice + @fbocquet

Title: Moschi
Description: Moschi (https://genmo.ai/play) is Genmo’s latest short video generation model, including camera movements. 720p videos. 3 free generations per day.

Title: Bolt
Description: Bolt (https://bolt.new) creates applications and websites from an instruction. The code, accessible, is generated live and the result is directly visible. 150000 tokens/day (5 interactions) and 1M/month in free version. Deployment on http://stackblitz.io servers with direct editing and URL pasting possible.

Title: Ellipsis News
Description: Ellipsis News (https://ellipsisnews.co) generates a daily audio synthesis of a news topic with global sources cited. 5 accessible themes (change possible), one episode on one theme per day free and without account. French supported, on iOS.

Title: Loopple
Description: Loopple (https://loopple.com) generates a website from an instruction and hosts them. Several templates, fine text editing and image bank via Pexels. Responsive site. Review: https://testsiteloople.loopple.com. A free hosted site.

Title: Aha Slides
Description: Aha Slides (https://ahaslides.com) generates a presentation with quiz from an instruction or document deposited in the integrated chatbot. Participant tracking, ppt integration, teams and zoom. Editing tools. Interface offered in French.

Title: AI Summarizer
Description: AI Summarizer (https://summarizer.best) summarizes pasted texts or web pages in several languages and in 3 lengths. 20000 characters accepted. Free and without account. Sources:https://fr.wikipedia.org/wiki/Intelligence_artificielle_g%C3%A9n%C3%A9rative…, https://reseau-canope.fr/agence-des-usages/dossiers-thematiques_intelligence-artificielle.html…, https://beq.ebooksgratuits.com/classiques/Tchekhov-Vania.pdf…

Title: Infography
Description: Infography (http://infography.in) generates infographics from an instruction, a text or a url with a library of templates and possible editing. 5 credits / generations in free version. Example of “raw” generation below.

Title: Felter
Description: Felter (http://felter.ai) generates lessons from an instruction with personal progress tracking and quiz to check understanding. Course shareable with other accounts. Audio available in FR. 15 free credits (1 course).

Title: Echodocs
Description: Echodocs (http://echodocs.ai) generates transcriptions of audio or video files in different templates. Templates suitable for imported text and live recorded audio. Sources: https://youtu.be/1Rsj8mfQEeI and IAGen on Wikipedia.3 free transcriptions per month.

Title: ThatNeedle Gist
Description: ThatNeedle Gist (https://gist.thatneedle.com): Chrome extension that generates the summary of a video #YouTube + keywords. 21 languages and full transcription available. No account and unlimited. Sources https://youtube.com/watch?v=1Rsj8mfQEeI… / https://youtube.com/watch?v=LNxcDavAWzg…

Title: Page On
Description: Page On (http://pageon.ai) generates presentations from an instruction, citing its sources. Document or URL loading, templates, slide editing, scripting, and audio version (FR random). Free version: Share via url.Test: https://app.pageon.ai/share/6269?mode=share&shareToken=eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJkb2N1bWVudFNoYXJlU2lnbiI6IjEiLCJleHAiOjE3MzE1MzI5MTUsInVzZXJJZCI6MzA3NywicHJvamVjdElkIjo2MjY5LCJ0aW1lb3V0IjoxNzMxNTMyOTE1MDAwLCJpc1JlbW92ZVdhdGVybWFyayI6MH0.kmlaU7Hd4A5Gbh_nwv6oAQ2XEM3ugQima6SIgxsuAQ0

Title: Kepl
Description: Kepl (iOS: https://apps.apple.com/gw/app/kepl-cam%C3%A9ra-ai-recherche/id6630371822?l=fr-FR… and Android https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=plus.adaptive.kepl…) is an AI search engine with sources, coupled with a chatbot, and based on the analysis of a photograph. Text source 4th of https://cnnumerique.fr/votre-attention-sil-vous-plait-quels-leviers-face-leconomie-de-lattention… of the @cnnum. 100 free queries.

Title: Zemith
Description: Zemith (https://zemith.com) brings together text chatbot, search engine, note-taking and image generation in a single tool. Models: GPT 4, Claude, Gemini, Stable Diffusion, Imagen and Flux. 20 free queries per day with the “light” models.

Title: Mixus
Description: Mixus (https://mixus.ai) brings together language models and users in a single social network. The private interaction can be open to users or published. ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini. 20 free AI messages/day and unlimited interactions.

Title: Kidgeni
Description: Kidgeni (https://kidgeni.com) generates images from an instruction with several models available, images from a drawing, and children’s stories. 15 free credits.

Title: Compute
Description: Compute (https://compute.hyper.space) implements different agents, based on the main LLMs, to respond to an instruction based on selected sources (Wikipedia, Arxiv, Reddit…). FR if specified. Without account and seems unlimited.

Title: Ai Game Master
Description: Ai Game Master (https://aigamemaster.app): mobile text-based role-playing game based on GPT 4 and stable broadcast. Multiple worlds, turn-based game via chatbot. 20 spin tokens at startup, 5 every 4 hours. Optional account. Review: https://play.aigamemaster.app/#/viewAdventure?id=JJKV2J…

Title: Le The Chat v2
Description: Le The @MistralAI Chat (https://chat.mistral.ai) now benefits from a new version and new features: web search with source citation, canvas to visualize generations and their evolution after iteration, document and image analysis.It can generate images and allows the creation of GPTs-type agents. Tests with Starry Night, Van Gogh on Wikipedia, agent with prompt for math session and usual instructions. Beta version with unlimited accounts.Edit 01/06/2026: Le The Chat is now called “Vibe” (see https://mistral.ai/fr/products/vibe/)

Title: Magic Quill
Description: Magic Quill (https://huggingface.co/spaces/AI4Editing/MagicQuill…) allows you to generate new parts of an image in selected parts. Multiple selection sizes and fine settings. No account and open-source. Source https://uneiaparjour.fr/human-generator/… and personal image.

Title: VectorUbi
Description: VectorUbi (https://vectorubi.com) generates illustrations in svg format from a simple instruction. Color changes possible per area. Export svg or png. Favorites and gallery. 7 free images.

Title: Noiz
Description: Noiz (https://noiz.io) summarizes YouTube videos in multiple formats (lists, Q&A…), lengths and 50 languages. Also offers transcription and timed key moments. Chrome extension available and app coming soon. No account.

Title: Memgrain
Description: Memgrain (http://memgrain.com) accompanies memorization with flashcards, quizzes and fill-in-the-blank texts from documents, urls, texts or notes in + 100 languages. Quizzes and ocr down during the test. Free and unlimited

Title: EdenX
Description: EdenX (http://edenx.ai) generates characters or avatars from cartoons (Pixar, comics, cartoons…) in images and video. Interactions via the instructions given. 4 or 8s videos. 25 creation credits and 500 action credits/month, + if popular person.

Title: Chat100
Description: Chat100 (https://chat100.ai) offers free, account-free access to ChatGPT 4o and Sonnet 3.5 Claude. Documents to analyze and image generation supported on the ChatGPT side, no docs and code for SVG on the Claude side. About 10 instructions per day.

Title: Imagine Anything
Description: Imagine Anything (https://imagineanything.ai) generates images from Flux, Stable diffusion, and Ideogram. Advanced settings and image to image. Gallery available. 10 free images per month

Title: BookRead
Description: BookRead (beta on registration: https://bookread.ai +available iOS: https://apps.apple.com/ca/app/bookread-ai/id6737578649…): an epub reading application with integrated AI chatbot (chatGPT?) that offers explanations, definition, translation and flashcards. Free. Test: war of the buttons

Title: GenFM
Description: GenFM by @elevenlabsio (http://elevenlabs.io/genfm) generates podcasts from documents, text, url, YouTube videos or scanned document. Choice of voices FR automatic, multiple options, library, sharing by url. Unlimited, app iOS available and android coming soon.

Title: Vera
Description: Vera (https://askvera.org) is an audio/phone and text/Whatsapp chatbot that offers to verify the information offered. Based on ChatGPT4 and 350 sources chosen and verified by the NGO http://lareponse.tech . Free beta.

Title: Fabla
Description: Fabla (https://fabla.art) generates children’s stories with or without drawing and 3 written and/or predefined “ingredients”. Parental management profiles/password. iOS and Android, 5 languages, audio, url sharing. 3 free generations.

Title: Thea
Description: Thea (https://thea.study) accompanies the learning of a concept with a complete guide/course, questions and answers, memorization exercises (flashcards, linking and searching via a chatbot) and tests. Free beta until April 2025.

Title: Right click YouTube summary
Description: Right click YouTube summary (http://rightclickyoutubesummary.com) a Chrome extension that generates a video summary YouTube to be called directly with a right button on the video page. 5 free summaries /day. Tests: https://youtube.com/watch?v=s98aUiijyXU… and https://youtube.com/watch?v=yQLmgw3rClM…

Title: Source Table
Description: Source Table (http://sourcetable.com) is a spreadsheet program with built-in AI chatbot (searching in data, creating visualizations, helping with formulas), with visible progress. FR ok in the instructions (EN often in response). Test: https://meteo.data.gouv.fr/datasets/6569b51ae64326786e4e8e1a…

Title: Concept map
Description: Concept map (https://conceptmap.ai) generates mind maps from an instruction. Non-editable map, exportable to png. GPT 3.5 and 4o, Claude 1. Extension proposal via conversation. 3 maps without account, unlimited with account.

Title: Bylo
Description: Bylo (https://bylo.ai): a free and account-free image generation tool with 8 templates including Flux (version?) and negative prompt. Square format, png export of images available for 7 days in the gallery.

Title: Nemotron 70B
Description: Nemotron 70B from @nvidia (https://build.nvidia.com/nvidia/llama-3_1-nemotron-70b-instruct…) is a language model based on Llama 70B, with better results than GPT4o or Claude 3.5 in the LLM rankings. Free and open-source. Review: https://codimd.apps.education.fr/QYd6uhSRSIqutrnwp29dEg…

Title: DeepSeek
Description: DeepSeek (https://chat.deepseek.com): language model reasoning.

Title: Humva
Description: Humva (https://humva.ai) uses avatars to speak a text up to 2000 characters in 10 min. About 200 avatars available, 5 emotions, possible generation of your own avatar with photo and voice. Free and seems unlimited.Text source: introduction doc @UNESCO_fr https://unesdoc.unesco.org/ark:/48223/pf0000389901

Title: Grok
Description: Grok (https://x.com/i/grok): @xai’s AI chatbot now available for X users with 2 language and image models. The LLM cites its url and post sources. Biases identified in the image model. 10 interactions per 2 hours free (tests out of 20).

Title: Pollo
Description: Pollo (https://pollo.ai) generates short videos from an instruction or image. Advanced settings including camera movement. 20 free credits per day (2 videos).

Title: Stream Realtime
Description: Edit 12/25: Stream Realtime is no longer available in the Google ai studio.Stream Realtime from Gemini 2.0 Flash (experimental version available in https://aistudio.google.com) allows live audio interaction with what is displayed on the screen or via the webcam. Specify FR before starting. Source https://uneiaparjour.fr/selection-outils/…

Title: Mindmap AI
Description: Mindmap AI (https://mindmapai.app) generates mind maps from an instruction or a document. Chatbot with documents, extension, focus, summary functions. Multiple export, URL sharing. 100 free credits at the beginning then 15/month.

Title: Masterpiece X
Description: Masterpiece X (http://masterpiecex.com) generates 3D models from an image or an instruction. Export glb, Fbx, usdz. URL and VR sharing for meta quest. Gallery with download. 250 credits at opening (per month?), 50 used/generation.

Title: Zenmic
Description: Zenmic (http://zenmic.com) generates a podcast episode from a topic or pasted text. Editable script. FR if specified, set the number and genre of speakers. MP3 export, share by URL. Seems unlimited. Test: https://zenmic.com/podcast/ipv3Edit O8/25: despite the switch to subscription, free generations are still possible after the trial period but without downloading, sharing by url.

Title: Trickle
Description: Trickle (https://app.trickle.so) generates web projects (applications, web page) from a request. Instructions to a chatbot for improvement. Publish, export files and analyze visits. 5 free requests/day, 30/month.

Title: Rapport
Description: Rapport (http://rapport.cloud) allows you to create chatbots with avatar and voice from a pre-prompt. Main models available (LLM, voice recognition and “text to speech”), 4 French voices. 20 min free per conversation.

Title: Edify 3D
Description: Edify 3D (https://build.nvidia.com/shutterstock/edify-3d…) generates 3D images from an instruction or an image (only from the examples). Export glb and usdz. Nvidia and Shutterstock collaboration. Without account, 50 free instructions (per month?)

Title: Vidu
Description: Vidu (https://vidu.studio) generates short videos from an image, a text instruction, or 2 images combined. Camera movements. 80 free credits/month (approx. 20 videos). Images for testing: recraft.

Title: Shou Xin
Description: Shou Xin (https://huggingface.co/Datou1111/shou_xin…) generates images as pencil drawings in b&w or color – based on Flux. Add “shou_xin” + “pencil sketch” (with or without “color”) in the prompt, without: Classic feed. Open source, free, no account. Via @Korben

Title: Tem.polor
Description: Tem.polor (http://tempolor.com) generates music from an instruction, an image or an audio file. Multiple options. Music bank with search engine available. URL sharing. Download with free tagging.

Title: MyMemo
Description: MyMemo (https://mymemo.ai) summarizes and allows dialogue with documents (notes, links, videos, images, pdf). Classification in collections. Summary day or week in podcast. Online, extension and iOS app. Free: GPT 4o mini + limitations (see screenshot 4).

Title: 3D Trellis
Description: Trellis (https://huggingface.co/spaces/JeffreyXiang/TRELLIS…) generates a #3D model from one or more images. Background automatically erased and fine adjustments available. Export GLB format. Unlimited, without account and open-source.

Title: Tak
Description: Tak (https://tak.phospho.ai) from @phospho_ai ( ) combines search engine and LLM (“homemade” LLM?) to generate its response to a query. Document analysis and custom instructions. URL sharing. 3 queries without account then free generations with it.

Title: Imagine QR
Description: Imagine QR (https://imagineqr.io) generates QR codes from an instruction. Negative prompt. Template bank. 5 free generations per month.

Title: Jugemu
Description: Jugemu (https://jugemu.app) offers to compare the generations produced by several LLMs (19 available). 3 compared in parallel. URL sharing. Test: https://jugemu.app/chat/share/f68090e5-d097-44d3-b963-ee60a0892247…. Limit on the number of interactions in the free version not specified.

Title: Sync Study
Description: Sync Study (http://syncstudy.app) generates quizzes from uploaded documents (pdf, ppt, doc, txt) or pasted text. FR accepted if specified in the title. Correction proposed. Sharing url. A free test of 20 questions per day.

Title: Britannica Chatbot
Description: Britannica Chatbot: when the encyclopedia @Britannica meets ChatGPT (https://britannica.com/chatbot). Sources of the encyclopedia cited. Specify “generates in French” in the instruction. Beta version, without account and unlimited, with advertising of the site.

Title: Nexform
Description: Nexform (http://nexform.io) generates online questionnaires or quizzes from an instruction with possible editing and additions, publication and follow-up of answers (url, QR Code, online follow-up or csv export). Free and seems unlimited with account.

Title: Automina
Description: Automina (https://automina.app) automates complex web browsing from an instruction after a step-by-step breakdown (can be added). Live tracking in a browser. Free beta with 50 credits (1 step = 1 credit)

Title: Sendshort
Description: Sendshort (http://sendshort.ai) generates text, audio and still images videos from an instruction. Editable generated script, choice of voice and style. Post-production editing possible. Test (too “playful”. 4 free generations / week.

Title: Analysis Tool
Description: Analysis Tool from Claude.ai allows the analysis of xls or csv files up to 30 MB. Activation via in “Feature preview” in the menu at the bottom left. Javascript analysis available. Testing since https://meteo.data.gouv.fr (dep. 25 1950/2022).

Title: Kvistly
Description: Kvistly (https://kvistly.com) generates interactive quizzes from an instruction, a document (down during the test) or a text. Betting system, live quiz. Editing, tracking results. In free version, unlimited with 10 participants per quiz.

Title: Sup AI
Description: Sup AI (https://sup.ai) queries ChatGPT, Claude, and Llama from an instruction to come up with an improved version of their response. URL sharing. Unlimited.Tests: – AI education: https://sup.ai/chats/cm5h5fu3k00079c1bfqujqwax… – Training: https://sup.ai/chats/cm5h5ka8900099c1bn3a0r6ck…

Title: MydeviceAI
Description: MydeviceAI by @navedmer (https://apps.apple.com/fr/app/mydeviceai/id6736578281…) is a chatbot for iOS (from iPhone 13 Pro) based on Llama 3.2 and installed locally. Works without an internet connection once installed, the transmitted data remains local. Free and unlimited.

Title: Photon
Description: Photon is the new image and video generation model of @LumaLabsAI (https://lumalabs.ai/photon) available online and via the iOS “Dream machine” app. Editing via chatbot, suggestions, image to image/ to video. About 20 free generations per month.

Title: Dreamina
Description: Dreamina by @capcutapp (https://dreamina.capcut.com) generates images from its 3 generation templates. Setup, work area, enhancement, in-frame generation and text addition. Image to video announced. 120 free credits per day (60 actions).

Title: Chatbot Arena
Description: Chatbot Arena (previously LLMSys already presented) benefits from a new interface with 3 entries (https://chatbot-arena.web.app): blind discovery battle of 2 LLMs of its ranking, side by side comparison chosen and chat only one interviewed. No account, free and unlimited.

Title: Syft
Description: Syft (https://justsyft.com) offers the monitoring of current topics from a query with regular publication of a summary of the results of its curation. Search by period. Sources cited. Free and unlimited? Test with 16 followed subjects.

Title: Omnicontrol
Description: Omnicontrol (https://huggingface.co/spaces/Yuanshi/OminiControl…) generates images from a source image and an instruction. Model-based generation of image analysis and Flux 1. Free, open-source and unlimited.

Title: Phi 4
Description: Phi 4 (https://huggingface.co/microsoft/phi-4) latest version of Microsoft’s LLM / SLM (Small Model) is available in open-source (MIT license). Fairly short answers, announcement with reasoning and mathematical facilities. Test possible on https://huggingface.co/spaces/eswardivi/phi-4…

Title: Diagram generator
Description: Diagram generator (https://diagram-generator.com) generates visualizations from an instruction from 9 available templates: flowchart, Gantt, mindmap, etc. with explanation. Export png, save and share by URL. No account and unlimited.

Title: Co
Description: Co (http://co.dev) offers the generation of applications from iterative instructions in a chatbot. Based on Claude.ai, result directly visible in the interface. Beta version limited to 1 project and 5 changes per day.

Title: SPAR 3D
Description: SPAR 3D (https://huggingface.co/spaces/stabilityai/stable-point-aware-3d…) transforms a 2D image into a 3D image. After removing the background and isolating the object, transforms into glb and ply files. Many settings available. Open source and unlimited. Images: wikimedia commons.

Title: Conte
Description: Conté (https://conte-app.com) generates text and picture stories for children from an instruction. Unlimited with online sharing, paid ordering of the created book. On iOS. Review: https://conte-app.com/shareMe/preview/3ffdb537-33f8-42e6-ada5-e72f846db9c8/74c10d7a-344d-445a-8e24-a2b70349d2b4…

Title: Lucie
Description: Lucie (https://huggingface.co/OpenLLM-France/Lucie-7B): language model , fully open-source, suitable for uses such as education. Developed by the consortium @openllm_france and @linagora. First possible tests with pre-instruction and parameters: https://huggingface.co/spaces/Tonic/Lucie-7B

Title: PocketPal
Description: PocketPal (https://github.com/a-ghorbani/pocketpal-ai) allows you to install a lightweight LLM directly in your iOS or Android phone and use it in a chatbot without a connection. Multiple templates to download, via Huggingface or its files. Open source, unlimited, no account.

Title: Open Canvas
Description: Open Canvas (https://opencanvas.langchain.com) adds interactive generation to a chatbot in the manner of ChatGPT canvases or Claude artifacts. With GPT 4 mini, Claude Haiku, Llama and Gemini Flash. Pre-instruction and quick commands. Open source and unlimited.

Title: Aithor
Description: Aithor (https://aithor.com) generates a plan of scientific articles and a literature review (source: Arxiv) from an instruction. Searchable sources and editable texts. Free generations with limitations (waiting, templates, etc.)

Title: Alle AI
Description: Alle AI (https://alle-ai.com): a text and image chatbot that offers a comparative generation of several models (15 of text, 9 of which are in the free version and 3 of images) from the same instruction. Comparison limited to 2 models in the free version.

Title: Multi Search and Multi AI
Description: Multi Search and Multi AI (https://multisearchai.carrd.co) is a Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Arc, Brave, and Opera extension that allows simultaneous search and querying of AI chatbots with up to 4 different tools on the same screen. 9 chatbots and 30 search tools available.Free and unlimited.

Title: Great Podcast
Description: Super Podcast (https://superpodcast.ai) allows the creation of podcast episodes from an instruction, a document or by recording a dialogue with a generative AI (basic ChatGPT?). Choice of language, duration and tone. Free and unlimited, 2 female voices, private podcast possible, mp3 or webm exports for conversations with AI.

Title: Learn earth
Description: Learn Earth (learn.earth) offers to acquire new knowledge from a given theme via an instruction: theoretical contributions are generated and quizzes are offered with detailed evaluation. Points are available every day in the free version (x10 in premium), increased with the levels passed. Ranking available.

Title: Sat 2
Description: Sam 2 (https://sam2.metademolab.com – “Segment anything”, Meta demo) spots and tracks up to 3 objects/shapes on a video and allows you to modify them or change what’s around it.Videos up to 70MB. Without an account and unlimited.

Title: Chat Pdf GPT
Description: Chat Pdf GPT (https://chatpdfgpt.ai/app) allows dialogue with a pdf file (limit to 100 MB?). ChatGPT database with conversation history. 10 free interactions per day.Test below with UNESCO guidance: https://www.unesco.org/fr/articles/orientations-pour-lintelligence-artificielle-generative-dans-leducation-et-la-recherche

Title: Polychat
Description: Polychat (https://polychat.co) is a chatbot based on ChatGPT 4o, ChatGPT o1 and Claude Sonnet 3.5 offering the possibility to compare models but also to “criticize” the answer given (GPT 4o by Sonnet 3.5 and vice versa).

Title: Websim
Description: Websim (https://websim.ai) creates applications from natural language instructions. Several language models available (Gemini 2.0, Claude, DeepSeek R1…). Export of generated code, URL sharing with possible comments. Project gallery. 15 credits (some models do not consume credits) and 100 free images per day.

Title: convergence.ai Proxy
Description: convergence.ai Proxy (https://convergence.ai/) is a wizard that automates tasks on the web based on an instruction. Once the addresses to visit and the actions to be performed are defined, Proxy performs the task step by step with real-time browsing.Automation possible.Beta version. 5 sessions per day and free automation.

Title: Janus Pro
Description: Janus Pro (description: https://huggingface.co/deepseek-ai/Janus-Pro-7B) is a DeepSeek image model. Multimodal. Efficient in image analysis, more random in generation (e.g. text and generation of people in complicated groups). Instructions in English are preferred. Tests possible from this space Hugging Face: https://huggingface.co/spaces/deepseek-ai/Janus-Pro-7B Open source and without account.

Title: AI Flowchart generator
Description: AI Flowchart generator (https://vdraw.ai/ai-flowchart-generator) generates flowcharts or flowcharts from an instruction. Possible editing text, shapes, colors. Export png or svg with or without background. No account and seems unlimited.

Title: Qwen Chat
Description: Qwen Chat (https://chat.qwenlm.ai/) is the chatbot dedicated to Qwen models developed by Alibaba. It provides access to the latest language model Qwen 2.5 Max (description: https://qwenlm.github.io/blog/qwen2.5-max/) and offers: document analysis, “artifacts” with code generation and visualization, image generation and internet search (video generation announced). Export json and txt, share url. Free and unlimited.

Title: Fuzz de Riffusion
Description: Fuzz by Riffusion (https://classic.riffusion.com/) is a model for generating music tracks, lyrics and music. Generation from an instruction or pasted text. Share by url or playlist, export m4a.

Title: Tulu 3
Description: Tülu 3 405B (https://playground.allenai.org) is a language model of the American non-profit research institute AI2 (https://allenai.org). Fully open-source (data, code, and documentation: https://allenai.org/blog/tulu-3-405B). Advertised as rivaling Deepseek and GPT 4.

Title: My thinking cap
Description: My thinking cap (https://mythinkingcap.ai/) offers specialized chatbots (the “experts”) for children aged 5 to 12 on various themes: generation of stories, recipes or songs, help with mathematics, languages, code, environment, animals, etc. as well as an image generator and another for teachers to generate session plans. Based on ChatGPT and Flux?With a free account: unlimited conversation and image generation, text generation with monthly limit (after testing about twenty generations, 65% of the quota reached).

Title: 10zebra
Description: 10zebra (https://10zebra.app/) supports the production of a short film from photos or video clips, from storyboarding to “text to video”, “image to video” or “video to video” generation or by applying a Ken Burns effect to photos.Collaborative via the possibility of remixing or collective creation. MP4 or archive export.

Title: Text to CAD
Description: Text to CAD (https://text-to-cad.zoo.dev) generates 3D models from an instruction. 7 export formats available. Some difficulties noticed but quite powerful. French accepted. Free and unlimited alpha version.

Title: Replit
Description: Replit (https://replit.com) generates the files for an application described by an instruction. One agent, queries, improves, or corrects as the application is created, while another accompanies in conversational mode. An application that can be directly tested in the interface.

Title: Teachology
Description: Teachology (https://www.teachology.ai) accompanies the generation of sessions based on instructions: pedagogical choices, division, glossary, instructions, skills, quizzes, presentation plan and fine analysis of documents. Interface in English but FR in the generations if specified on the 1st screen. Document test from UNESCO guidelines. 15 Free Actions per day.

Title: Tools de HuggingChat
Description: HuggingChat’s Tools (https://huggingface.co/chat/tools) allow you to add functionality to the available Qwen and Llama LLMs.

Title: A0
Description: A0 (https://a0.dev) builds applications from instructions. Uses the react library and can connect on-demand plug-ins as well as API keys to connect generative AIs. Reviews and corrects auto-generated code.Once the build is complete, A0 compiles the different elements and the ability to share privately or publicly and export the code on Github.After 3 days of trial, 1 app per month and 10 instructions per hour free. Test for a story-generating app in which you are the hero: generate a home screen with choice, connect to the Mistral API (see: https://console.mistral.ai/api-keys/), generate images and add a voice module for screen playback.

Title: Chatty
Description: Chatty (https://chatty.wastu.net/ by B. Wastu: https://github.com/bgwastu) accompanies the improvement of a text with suggestions for spelling/grammar correction and advice on style or rewording. The text can be corrected and then proposed again.

Title: AutoResearch
Description: AutoResearch (https://autoresearch.pro) generates pptx presentations from a specified statement and/or URLs (see in profile).

Title: AI Diagram Generator
Description: AI Diagram Generator (https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/ai-diagram-generator/ngopmehdeepldffjaccolpdkcmiggijb) is a Chrome extension that offers the generation of visualizations from an instruction in a browser tab.

Title: Zonos
Description: Zonos (description: https://www.zyphra.com/post/beta-release-of-zonos-v0-1#zonos_2, test space: https://playground.zyphra.com/audio) voiced a pasted text.

Title: Xtract
Description: Xtract (https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/xtract-extract-text-analy/gffpgogeokibdieebkhajmpoclhedanm by Devyansh Yadav) is a Chrome extension that, based on a screenshot, analyzes its content from pre-configured instructions or a chatbot. 7 languages available.

Title: Lovable
Description: Lovable (https://lovable.dev/) generates, from instructions, pages of code to create a web application. Gallery of templates and remixes of existing projects possible. Publishing and sharing on Lovable’s servers proposed.

Title: Animated drawings
Description: Meta’s Animated Drawing (https://sketch.metademolab.com/) animates drawings. Editable masking with pencil and eraser, placement of morphological markers. 32 animation templates offered. Mp4 export.Requires a frontal character with arms and legs detached from the body.No accounts and unlimited.

Title: English Practice
Description: English practice (https://englishpractice.io) translates short passages into English from 16 languages (50 characters maximum), offers a “phonetic” and an oral version, and then records and analyzes your English pronunciation.

Title: Perplexity Deep Research
Description: With Deep Research – or “Pro Research” depending on the version – (https://www.perplexity.ai/), Perplexity adds its own language model with “reasoning” to its interface after Deepseek and O3 mini.

Title: Mind Map Wizard
Description: Mind Map Wizard (https://mindmapwizard.com) generates mind maps from a statement (150 character limit).Editing in text format, url sharing and pdf, svg and markdown export. History available.No account, unlimited, and open-source (Github: https://github.com/linus-sch/Mind-Map-Wizard).Test: https://mindmapwizard.com/view.html?id=1739916358153

Title: Meshy
Description: Meshy (https://www.meshy.ai/) generates 3D models from an instruction or an image, with or without textures. Numerous editing options, several dozen possible animations. Export in 6 formats.

Title: Litmaps
Description: Litmaps (https://www.litmaps.com) is a search engine specialized in scientific literature from Google scholar, Semantic Scholar or its own “Litmaps”.

Title: Wuko
Description: Wuko (https://wuko.ai) summarizes content from a URL sent by email to read@wuko.ai (tests on web page, online pdf or YouTube video).

Title: Open Deep Research
Description: Open Deep Research (description: https://huggingface.co/blog/open-deep-research and demo space: https://huggingface.co/spaces/m-ric/open_Deep-Research ) is the ” reasoning ” research agent developed by Hugging Face… in 24 hours after the publication of OpenAI’s Deep research.

Title: Uniscribe
Description: Uniscribe (https://www.uniscribe.co) transcribes audio, video (mp3, mp4, mpeg, mpga, m4a, wav, and webm) or YouTube documents to produce a summary, important points, and a mind map. Chatbot coming soon, on waiting list.Export url and txt, srt, vtt in free version. 2 hours of free transcription per month and 5 documents per day. Testing since: – Extraclasse, let’s talk practices n°38: https://extraclasse.reseau-canope.fr/ere-intelligence-artificielle-parlons-pratiques-38 – Artificial intelligence in 90 s.: https://www.YouTube. com/watch?v=1Rsj8mfQEeI

Title: SciPub +
Description: SciPub + (https://scipubplus.com/) supports scientific writing projects with specialized agents: from research on the subject to literature review, including method, introduction, data visualization or abstract. Based on GPT 4o.

Title: Unstuck
Description: Unstuck (https://unstuckstudy.com/) allows dialogue with documents (presentation, pdf, text), YouTube videos or recordings (live or audio files).

Title: 3615 LeChat
Description: 3615 LeChat (https://3615-lechat.wildcode-solutions.com/) offers language model Mistral in an interface inspired by… Minitel! Font, color, speed… everything is present for a return to the 1980s.Developed, with a lot of humor, by Jean-Louis Feuvrier Lewendoski and spotted by the indefatigable scout Gérald Tirot via this article from Clubic.No accounts and unlimited.

Title: Kimi
Description: Kimi K1.5 (https://kimi.ai/) is a new language model “with reasoning”. Connected to the internet, it seems to compete with equivalent models (see publication on Github) by consulting a large number of sources – up to 98 sources according to the tests carried out.The chatbot’s interface is in Chinese (translatable by the browser – remember to delete the translation before generation), the answers are generated in French with an instruction in French. Application and extensions available. “Kimi +” agents are offered. Test below with the presentation generator.

Title: Director of Hailuoai
Description: Director (https://hailuoai.video) is Hailuoai’s latest video generation model: it allows adding camera movements in the generated video. 18 movements available, 9 as a set and 9 to be inserted into the instruction.“Image to video” and “text to video”.100 free credits (3 videos) per day.

Title: Poe’s App Creator
Description: Poe offers App Creator (https://poe.com/App-Creator): an application builder based on textual instructions and can include an LLM in its operation (in the tests: Claude Sonnet 3.7).A category in the gallery is dedicated to applications: https://poe.com/explore?category=Apps.Apps can be published privately or publicly.Uses “Poe points” (3000 awarded every 4 hours in the free version), variable point consumption according to the instructions (between 40 and 900 during the tests).

Title: Imagen 3
Description: Imagen 3, Google’s image generation model, is now available in Europe and integrated with Gemini (https://gemini.google.com/). Works with Gemini 2.0 Flash.Managed conversational mode: Gemini takes the previous instruction and integrates the additions as the conversation progresses (no image retention, new generation).Square format (2048×2048), text sometimes rendered randomly.Unlimited and included in free accounts.

Title: Critique browser
Description: Critique browser (https://critiquebrowser.app/) is a Chrome extension that allows you to check information on social sites or networks. Accessible from the right button and/or integrated into the browser via a chatbot. Specify “Generates in English”. Unlimited in “manual” mode, automatic mode in paid version. Sources for testing: https://www.humanite.fr/mot-cle/les-theories-du-complot-les-plus-farfelues and tweet https://x.com/ComplotsFaciles/status/950376531846627328

Title: Gentube
Description: Gentube (https://www.gentube.app) generates images from an instruction or remixes existing images in its gallery. The base model appears to be Flux (unspecified).

Title: Aria from Opera
Description: Aria is a chatbot integrated into the Opera (https://www.opera.com/fr) browser and based on ChatGPT 4o, Gemini 1.5 and Imagen 3.

Title: Type Think
Description: Type Think (https://typethinkai.com) is a chatbot that allows simultaneous querying of several language models (18 in the free version), with web search, image generation and code interpretation. Voice possible if only one model selected.10 free interactions per day.

Title: Aya
Description: Aya from “Cohere For AI” (https://cohere.com/research/aya): 3 language models and 2 image analysis models from a research project with the main objective of increasing the number of languages covered by LLMs (101 languages in the database).

Title: Askvids
Description: Askvids (https://www.askvids.com) summarizes YouTube videos in three formats or via an instruction. 17 languages available. Sharing via URL.

Title: DiffRhythm
Description: DiffRhythm (description: https://aslp-lab.github.io/DiffRhythm.github.io/ and test: https://huggingface.co/spaces/ASLP-lab/DiffRhythm) generates music tracks with lyrics from the timed lyrics and a music snippet.Tool for generating lyrics in CN or EN, instructions accepted in FR.Export ogg, mp3 or wav.Open source and unlimited.

Title: Redmenta
Description: Redmenta (https://redmenta.com/fr) creates activity sheets from specialized chatbots (more than 150 available) by discipline, evaluation, methods, administrative help… French supported (some translation errors in the interface).Once the chatbot has been chosen (e.g. profile of a historical figure, organization of a school trip, etc.) and after a conversation to define the plan, the activity is generated and editable. It can be shared to be carried out online.Groups and evaluation possible.

Title: Hedra’s Character 3
Description: Character 3 (https://www.hedra.com) is Hedra’s new video generation model (tested in June 2024): from an instruction describing a scene with a character, the definition of a text with voice and a reference image, an image and voice video is generated.60 voices in 8 languages / accents (FR not available during the tests), recording possible.Images (Flux, Recraft, Imagen, Sana, and Ideogram models) can be generated directly in the interface.400 free credits per month (3-4 videos).

Title: Readdy
Description: Readdy (https://readdy.ai) generates web pages from a text instruction that can be augmented with reference images and a color palette. Desktop or mobile formats. The first generation can evolve via a chatbot conversation.Html, Vue, React and UniApp offered. Exporting the codesheet and sharing URLs.2 simultaneous free projects.

Title: Space de Reka
Description: Reka (presented here a year ago) offers “Space” (https://space.reka.ai), whiteboard-type spaces using all the generation features of its models: reasoning, text and image generation, document and video analysis.

Title: Conversational AI
Description: Conversational AI from Eleven Labs (https://elevenlabs.io/app/conversational-ai) creates specialized audio chatbots from instructions and a knowledge base. Models for Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT, and 30 languages available.

Title: Gemini 2.0 Flash Experimental
Description: Gemini 2.0 Flash Experimental is a beta version model available on Google’s “Ai Studio” (https://aistudio.google.com/): multimodal, it accepts several pdf files, images, videos and audios as input.In generation, it manages text and image simultaneously and is able to modify the generated images.The instructions can be edited, the texts can be exported in markdown and the images in jpg.Free and unlimited.

Title: Hypernatural
Description: Hypernatural (https://hypernatural.ai/) generates videos with still images and voice from an idea or text. Choice of voice, style, and format.Fine editing available before validation. URL or mp4 export.100 free credits per month (2-3 videos of 1 min).

Title: Fabric
Description: Fabric (https://fabric.so) brings together all types of documents, AI or written notes, screenshots and sites saved in one place.It allows: automatic or manual labels, summaries and conversations via a chatbot, expert search in documents, filing in folders, notes on sites and daily summarization.Desktop, smartphone and browser extensions.

Title: Kwizie
Description: Kwizie (https://www.kwizie.ai) generates a quiz from a YouTube, vimeo or recorded audio video (paid version documents).Choice of number of questions, editing after generation, percentage and certificate of completion, sharing by url / qr code. Multiple export.Interface in EN, FR proposed for generation.3 free quizzes then 1 per week.

Title: BeaGo
Description: BeaGo (https://www.beago.ai/) is an AI chatbot with search functions connected to the internet, the generated answers include recent sources and images.Offers questions and related topics grouped into a single feed. Unspecified LLM, web app, IOS and Android.Unlimited and without an account, with accounts: history.

Title: Img-FX
Description: Img-FX (https://img-fx.com) generates images from Google’s Imagen 3 model.Two other tools are offered: generating statements from an image and erasing backgrounds.Square format, jpg export, without parameterization.Free, without an account and unlimited. History with accounts.

Title: Gemini Gems
Description: Gemini Gems (https://gemini.google.com/gems/view) are custom agents, and can now be created via a free account.

Title: Imagine explainers
Description: Imagine explainers (https://imagineexplainers.com) generates image, text and voice videos from an instruction with internet search and possible images, or from a document (short pdf, doc, image).

Title: Reve
Description: Reve.art (https://preview.reve.art/): a new image generation model that has been “hiding” for a few days at the top of many rankings under the name “Halfmoon” (here on Artificial Analysis for example).

Title: Wan 2.1
Description: Wan 2.1 is a open-source video generation template from Alibaba (documentation: https://github.com/Wan-Video/Wan2.1, demo: https://huggingface.co/spaces/Wan-AI/Wan2.1, and dedicated website: https://wan.video/).

Title: OpenAI FM
Description: OpenAI FM (https://www.openai.fm/ and documentation: https://platform.openai.com/docs/guides/audio) is the demo space for OpenAI’s new voice generation models, based on GPT 4o.

Title: Docs
Description: Docs (https://docs.numerique.gouv.fr) is a collaborative word processor with generative AI features: generating text from a text that acts as an instruction, rephrasing, summarizing, correcting, translating, enhancing, and adding emojis. Unidentified LLM (not logged in, database probably dated 2023, maybe LLama?).

Title: Creatr
Description: Creatr (https://getcreatr.com) generates web pages and “no code” applications from instructions with verification of the code generated in Next.js and Tailwind CSS and possible automatic correction.Creation of applications integrating ChatGPT (Claude, Deepseek and Grok announced), integration with a Supabase database.

Title: Ezygraph
Description: Ezygraph (https://www.ezygraph.com) generates infographics from a URL, article, or instruction.

Title: Monica’s Tools
Description: Monica’s Toolkit (https://monica.im/tools) – the extension of which has already been described here – brings together a series of generative AI tools dedicated to text, documents, images, voice and video. List in the screenshots below.

Title: Director
Description: T2v-01 Director (https://hailuoai.video), a new video generation model from Haiuoai, allows the choice of camera movements in the video that will be generated.18 possible moves, up to 3 comboable moves in the same video.Image to video and text to video.

Title: Deepsite
Description: Deepsite (https://huggingface.co/spaces/enzostvs/deepsite) generates a single page of code from an instruction to create applications or web pages.The code is interpreted live and the result is visible. Interactions for correction or interpretation are possible.Based on the Deepseek V3 model, the code can be copied and pasted or hosted on a Hugging Face space.Free, open-source and unlimited.

Title: Infographics
Description: Infographics (https://infographics.so/) generates simple infographics from an instruction. 8 templates offered with 3 style variations. Create styles and edit all generated elements.

Title: Masterymate
Description: Masterymate (https://masterymate.ai/) supports the generation of pedagogical sequences based on “Project-Based Learning ” (cf Edubref IFE: https://eduveille.hypotheses.org/files/2019/07/Edubref-octobre-2019.pdf) based on three steps: – the framework,– activities,– evaluation and avenues for further reflection.

Title: Athena Edu
Description: Athena Edu (https://athenaedu.ai/) supports the creation of educational content: generation of a lesson plan, querying of documents or videos, quizzes, emails, letters, etc. Content that can be edited and shared via a URL.

Title: Manus
Description: Manus (https://manus.im) automates the complex tasks given to it via an instruction. By breaking them down and using active web browsing where appropriate. Manus will solve these tasks live and step by step. The complex task can be given in stages with Manus proposal and validation needed to continue. Automated web browsing, website or application creation, data search, the possibilities are numerous.

Title: Copilot search
Description: Copilot search (https://www.bing.com/copilotsearch) is Microsoft’s new AI search engine: it provides detailed answers based on many online sources and by illustrating its answer with a video (relevant during the various tests).

Title: Llama 4
Description: Llama 4 (presentation on https://www.llama.com) is Meta’s new language model available in two versions, Scout (demo: <a href="https://huggingface.co/spaces/openfree/Llama-4-Scout-17B-Research”>https://huggingface.co/spaces/openfree/Llama-4-Scout-17B-Research) and Maverick (demo: <a href="https://huggingface.co/spaces/openfree/Llama-4-Maverick-17B-Research”>https://huggingface.co/spaces/openfree/Llama-4-Maverick-17B-Research). They have 17 billion parameters and accept up to 10 million tokens.A third version, Behemoth, is in preparation.

Title: Chatbac
Description: Chatbac (https://chatbac.fr) proposes to converse with authors in the French baccalaureate program: Rimbaud, Ponge, Rabelais, La Bruyère, O. de Gouge, Abbé Prévost, Balzac, Colette, Corneille, Musset and N. Sarraute.Prompt phrases help to start the conversation centered on the work on the program.

Title: Rork
Description: Rork (https://rork.app) generates web and mobile applications (iOS and Android) from instructions. Generate in React. Spot errors and suggest corrections.Preview in all 3 formats.

Title: Formulabot
Description: Formulabot (formulabot.com) analyzes data files and supports the formulation of Excel or Google sheet formulas.

Title: Hidream
Description: Hidream (Templates & Documentation: https://huggingface.co/collections/HiDream-ai/hidream-i1-67f3e90dd509fed088a158b3) is a open-source image generation template available in three versions: dev, full, and fast.High fidelity to build instructions during testing. Text managed over one or a few words.Available on Huggingface spaces (without accounts):– Dev: https://huggingface.co/spaces/HiDream-ai/HiDream-I1-Dev and https://huggingface.co/spaces/blanchon/HiDream-ai-dev– Full: https://huggingface.co/spaces/blanchon/HiDream-ai-full and https://huggingface.co/spaces/FiditeNemini/HiDream-ai-full– fast: https://huggingface.co/spaces/blanchon/HiDream-ai-fast and https://huggingface.co/spaces/TechnoByte/HiDream-I1-FastDev model integrated with Recraft tested in this article: https://www.uneiaparjour.fr/recraft-2

Title: Firebase studio
Description: Google’s Firebase Studio (https://studio.firebase.google.com/) builds “no-code” apps from instructions with Gemini. The code is editable and the result is directly visible and testable.

Title: RelatedAI
Description: RelatedAI (https://relatedai.chat) is a text chatbot with conversation history that integrates 10 language models: Gemini 2 Flash, GPT 3.5, 4o mini and 4o, Command R and R+, Claude 3 Haiku and 3.5 Sonnet, Mistral 7B and 8x7B.

Title: Plexbot de Perplexity
Description: Plexbot (t.me/askplexbot) is Perplexity’s Telegram chatbot

Title: Sider
Description: Sider (https://sider.ai) brings together multiple generation tools: chatbot, in-depth research and research with access to scientific literature (“Wisebase” tool), image generation with editing tools, video summaries YouTube, document analysis, etc.

Title: Younet
Description: Younet (https://younet.ai) creates chatbots from a questionnaire filled in step by the user.

Title: Veo 2
Description: Veo 2, Google’s video generation template, is available in the Google ai Studio (https://aistudio.google.com/generate-video).

Title: Atoms – ex MGX
Description: Atoms (edit 01/26: ex MGX https://mgx.dev https://atoms.dev/) generates applications, presentations and websites from instructions. Specialized “agents” are deployed in teams according to the tasks – project manager, developer, product manager, architect and data analyst – to generate pages of code in React, JavaScript and Tailwind CSS. Agents can be queried and generated in parallel.

Title: goPDF
Description: goPDF (https://gopdf.pro) offers dialogue with uploaded or online PDF files and document generation in a word processing interface and from templates. Suggested questions are available for pdfs.OCR, HTML/CSS code editing, and screenshot tools also offered.200 free tokens per month (10 for a pdf up to 35 MB, 1 for a document).

Title: Research Bunny
Description: Research Bunny (https://www.researchbunny.com) is a search engine for scientific articles. Searches are carried out via 25 categories and keywords with advanced search possible.

Title: Bitnet B 1.58
Description: Bitnet B 1.58 (Documentation: https://huggingface.co/microsoft/bitnet-b1.58-2B-4T and chatbot on Huggingface: <a href="https://huggingface.co/spaces/suayptalha/Chat-with-Bitnet-b1.58-2B-4T”>https://huggingface.co/spaces/suayptalha/Chat-with-Bitnet-b1.58-2B-4T) is a Microsoft language model open-source that works with 1 bit per parameter (compared to 16 or 32 for other equivalent models).By this reduction:

Title: Magi
Description: Magi (https://sand.ai/magi) generates videos from an image.The extension of the generated videos is possible by keeping the elements present in the initial image and adding to the first generated video in the manner of an edited movie.

Title: Ez1
Description: Ez1 (https://ez1.dev) generates web applications from an instruction (code in HTML, json, vite and react). Improved instructions and image import.Export the generated files or to Github and Netlify for upload.In free version and without accounts, 2 Gemini models and 8 Mistral models, unlimited generations. Other models in paid versions.

Title: Teach me anything
Description: Teach me anything (https://tma.live) generates an explainer video from an instruction. A video generated as an animated and commented presentation with text, illustrations, and voice (only one female voice available even if specified in the instruction).

Title: Flowith
Description: Flowith (https://flowith.io) brings together several conversational tools on an online “infiini” board: nearly 30 language or image models, an “oracle” mode that brings together agents specialized in “reasoning” (advanced search, code generation, etc.) and “personal knowledge bases grouping documents and URLs.

Title: Yourware
Description: Yourware (https://www.yourware.so) builds applications from an instruction and then a conversation. Code in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.Generation model not specified. Deepseek?The “boost” button generates an “improved” design of the app. The “Select” button allows action on specific elements of the app.Responsive apps and dark mode.Gallery with the possibility of remixing.Online publishing on Yourware. Public or private sharing with access code.

Title: Panquiz
Description: Panquiz (https://www.panquiz.com – website in Italian, application in English once connected via the “Accedi” button) generates online quizzes that can be broadcast live.

Title: Big read
Description: Big read (https://app.bigread.ai) aims to support the reading progress of young English-speaking people. In its three entries – discovering a subject, reading and writing with AI – the first “Learn about” can be used in French by adding “Generate in French” in the instruction.

Title: Toy Tales
Description: Toy Tales (https://www.toytal.es) generates children’s stories from a picture (as the title suggests, toy picture but works with any picture) and an optional instruction (the notes). Choice of fonts, style, colors, tone and length (maximum 4 double pages).French ok if specified in the notes.Share by url.2 free stories per month. Tests (from images generated on reve.art):

Title: Hunyuan 3D
Description: Hunyuan 3D (https://3d.hunyuan.tencent.com. Open source, documentation: https://huggingface.co/tencent/Hunyuan3D-2) generates textured 3D models from an instruction or image.

Title: Little Language Lessons
Description: With Little Language Lessons (https://labs.google/lll/fr), Google offers three tools, based on Gemini, to support language learning:

Title: Seedream
Description: Seedream, ByteDance’s new image generation model, is available on Dreamina (featured here: https://www.uneiaparjour.fr/dreamina).

Title: Studyraid
Description: Studyraid (https://app.studyraid.com/fr), created by Eldoranext , generates courses from a given topic. The courses are organized into chapters and sub-chapters. Each chapter is accompanied by flashcards, exercises, and a final test.

Title: Amymind
Description: Amymind (https://amymind.com) generates mind maps from a topic that can be accompanied by an instruction. A chatbot allows you to explore other ideas or develop certain points on the map.A menu available on each element allows editing.

Title: IC-Edit
Description: IC-Edit (documentation: https://river-zhang.github.io/ICEdit-gh-pages and demo: https://huggingface.co/spaces/RiverZ/ICEdit) generates changes in an image from an instruction, while remaining faithful to the original image. Three settings are available: seed, guidance, and inference.Very good results on objects and people, less effective on landscapes.Open source, free and unlimited.

Title: Tasky
Description: Tasky by Scoutnow (https://scoutnow.ai choose “Start with AI”) is a chatbot that specializes in complex tasks.Based on an instruction, Tasky will ask questions to deepen his understanding of the subject. After exposing the steps of the problem posed, the answer and related documents are generated based on ChatGPT O1 and Claude Sonnet 3.7. Iteration is then possible to refine the generations.Share by URL and export the generated files.Unlimited beta version (300 credits per month once the final version is released).Tests:

Title: Superexpert
Description: Superexpert (https://superexpert.ai, demo space: https://demo.superexpert.ai and download: https://github.com/Superexpert/superexpert-ai) allows the creation of custom chatbots. Open source, it can be deployed locally on a computer, with the APIs of the language models or a model installed. Document databases or RAGs can be added. A documentation/tutorials page is available for installation: https://superexpert.ai/docs/

Title: Preceden
Description: Preceden (https://www.preceden.com) generates timelines in two versions, frieze and text, from an instruction. Intercative friezes with information bubbles. Manual creation possible.

Title: Subshort
Description: Subshort (https://www.subshort.co/fr) generates video quizzes in the same way as those visible on social networks. Generation from keywords, pasted text or pdf. 30 themes, 48 voices, 6 types of quizzes, fine tuning, portrait or landscape format.Beta version, 50 free credits per month (3 to 4 videos without export with playback in the interface or 1 exported video).

Title: Leo de Brave
Description: Leo (https://brave.com/leo/) is the Brave browser’s AI assistant integrated into its search engine and available in a side pane in the form of a chatbot that can query the page visited.Several language models are offered (Mixtral 8x7B, Claude Haiku – 3.7 sonnet in premium version -, Llama 3.1 8B, Qwen 14B and Llama 3.2 11B Vision) with the possibility of adding your own models via an API key.Qwen 14B, Llama 3.1 8B, and Mixtral 8x7B are hosted on Brave (https://support.brave.com/hc/en-us/articles/26727364100493-What-are-the-differences-between-Leo-s-AI-Models) servers.Pre-defined instructions are offered in the search engine (response developed via the “Elaborate” button) and in the chatbot.

Title: Moondream
Description: Moondream (https://moondream.ai/c/playground and documentation: https://huggingface.co/vikhyatk/moondream2) reads and detects elements of an image (Visual Language Model).

Title: Graphy
Description: Graphy (https://graphy.app) produces visualizations from excel, google sheet, csv or pasted data files.

Title: Qaiz
Description: Qaiz (https://qaiz.app/) generates online quizzes from an instruction, multiple choice, or “opinion.”

Title: GreenPT
Description: Edit: archived following the transition to an exclusively paid business model.GreenPT (greenpt.ai) is a chatbot with two language models, multimodal, with possible connection to the web and API, designed with an ethical approach and a sustainable environmental approach:

Title: Komo
Description: Komo (https://komo.ai/) is a search engine connected to a language model with multiple features:

Title: Llama Tutor
Description: Llama Tutor (https://llamatutor.together.ai/ and documentation: https://github.com/Nutlope/llamatutor) is a chatbot based on Llama 3.1 configured to support learning according to a grade level (6 US levels available).The level of language is adapted and learning aids are generated on demand (quizzes, flashcards, questions / answers, help, etc.).Sources cited.Free, no accounts, unlimited, and open-source.

Title: AI Tutor pro
Description: AI Tutor pro (https://www.aitutorpro.ca) is a chatbot that offers two approaches based on questioning from a topic, “Grow” and “Check”:

Title: Teaching Assistant
Description: Teaching Assistant (https://www.assistantdenseignementiapro.ca/) offers three text generation tools to support teachers:

Title: AnimeShorts
Description: AnimeShorts (https://www.animeshorts.ai/) generates mainly webtoon or manga boards, (comics and photo novels possible) from a style and an instruction and after generating the script by a dedicated “agent”.

Title: YouTube summarizer
Description: YouTube summarizer article (<a href="https://gist.ly/youtube-summarizer”>https://gist.ly/YouTube-summarizer) generates a long, structured blog post from a YouTube video.Export by copy/paste.

Title: Lenny learning
Description: Lenny learning (https://www.lennylearning.org) generates course sequences of up to 5 sessions from a form: objective, class, duration, type of materials and materials needed (course, presentation, activities, exercise sheets, support texts, evaluation, etc.).A chatbot supports the understanding and adjustment of generations.Depending on the number of sessions and materials, the build time can be long (up to 20 minutes for 3 sessions with 10 supports during testing).In English on US programs, specify “generates in French” and provide details.

Title: ClassX
Description: ClassX (https://classx.org) offers, in its free (and unlimited?) version, 35 text generators for education: lesson plan, different types of quizzes, story generation, sentence generation, etc.

Title: Gemini Deep Research
Description: Gemini Deep Research available in Gemini (https://gemini.google.com) generates answers with “reasoning” from an instruction and/or documents and then, after establishing a division of tasks, offers several generations from Canvas:

Title: Open Knowledge Maps
Description: Open Knowledge Maps (https://openknowledgemaps.org/) generates a map of scientific knowledge based on the corresponding 100 scientific articles published in Open Science.

Title: Together Chat
Description: Together Chat (https://chat.together.ai) is a chatbot that brings together several language models (Deepseek R1 and V3, Qwen 3, Llama Maverick and Scout) and the 3 Flux image models (Schnell, Dev and Pro).

Title: Raphael
Description: Raphael (https://raphael.app/fr) generates images based on the Flux-1 Dev model. Multiple options of sizes, styles, lights, colors, and angles. Prompt negative.

Title: Agents Le The Chat
Description: After “Login” (with Gmail and Drive) and “Libraries” (libraries of documents that can be summoned in a conversation), Mistral AI now offers the agents previously available in “The Platform”, in the free and paid versions of its chatbot Le Le Chat (https://chat.mistral.ai/):

Title: Jungle
Description: Jungle (https://jungleai.com) generates quizzes from documents (7 formats including pdf, text, audio, video, presentation) and YouTube videos. MCQ type questions, true or false, use cases.

Title: Build apps with Gemini
Description: Build apps with Gemini (https://aistudio.google.com/apps) is an app builder based on Gemini 2.5.

Title: Unmute
Description: Kyutai’s Unmute (https://unmute.sh/), based on Gemma 3 and Moshi, is an audio chatbot with very low latency of very smooth conversations. The voices include many variations, pauses, and “emotions.”

Title: Bagel
Description: Bagel (demo: https://demo.bagel-ai.org/ and documentation: https://github.com/ByteDance-Seed/Bagel) is a multimodal model open-source ByteDance including text, image and reasoning.

Title: Oceandoc
Description: Oceandoc (https://oceandoc.com/) generates presentations from an instruction or document.

Title: Wondera
Description: Wondera (https://www.wondera.ai) brings together text and music composition tools in a chatbot to create songs in a single instruction or step-by-step by iteration.

Title: AudioX
Description: AudioX (https://huggingface.co/spaces/Zeyue7/AudioX) generates sounds and music from an instruction and can link them to a video.Sounds and 10-second video clip, fine adjustments. A few random generations disappear once the instruction is reformulated.

Title: Bing video creator
Description: Bing video creator (https://www.bing.com/images/create?FORM=Bvcmc1&ctype=video) generates 5-second videos from the Bing iOS or Android app.

Title: Bohrium
Description: Bohrium (https://bohrium.dp.tech) is an advanced search engine with a database of 160 million scientific texts.

Title: Skymel’s Aria
Description: Aria (<a href="https://skymel.com/ai-assistant.html”>https://skymel.com/ai-assistant.HTML) is a chatbot/agent that combines multiple language models to respond to an instruction (ChatGPT 3.5, 4.1 and image, Claude 3.5 Haiku and 4 sonnet, Gemini 2.5 pro, Sonar Pro).

Title: Ace-step
Description: Ace-Step (https://huggingface.co/spaces/ACE-Step/ACE-Step) is a open-source music generation model (documentation: https://ace-step.github.io/).Generate from lyrics and one of the 10 preset musical styles or a described style. Songs up to 4 min.

Title: Fluig
Description: Fluig (https://www.fluig.cc/) generates mind maps and several other types of graphical representations (table, timeline, diagram…) from an instruction given in a chatbot.

Title: ChatEdu
Description: ChatEdu (https://chatedu.io) accompanies the learning from downloaded files: querying via a chatbot, guide to help with comprehension, quiz and video (video generation did not work during the tests).

Title: Ainee
Description: Ainee (https://www.ainee.com) supports the understanding of documents, individual, in a library or grouped into folders in a knowledge base, via a chatbot, categorization and automated summaries (summary, transcription, outline and mind map).

Title: IMGto3D
Description: IMGto3D (https://www.imgto3d.ai/fr) generates 3D objects from an image in png or jpg format up to 1MB.

Title: Chronicle
Description: Chronicle (chroniclehq.com) generates presentation templates from pasted text, an instruction, or a url.

Title: Instance
Description: Instance (https://instance.so/) builds a website or application from statements.Once a first version has been generated, it is possible to act on only one element (select button at the top right of the preview window).Generates in React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS.

Title: RoboTeach
Description: RoboTeach (https://roboteach.us) generates a course from a given topic. The course is offered with the possibility of editing, its audio recording is then generated (with French voice) and then an editable quiz. Levels of American programs.

Title: Yupp
Description: Yupp (https://yupp.ai/) compares the responses provided by two language or image models, random or chosen by Yupp.

Title: Stitch
Description: Stitch (https://stitch.withgoogle.com/) generates design and HTML and css code for mobile and web applications from instruction and interactions.

Title: Minimax M1
Description: Minimax M1 (available on https://chat.minimax.io/) is a language model with “large-scale” reasoning.

Title: Teachany
Description: Teachany (https://www.teachany.com) brings together generation tools for teaching: lesson plan, quizzes, worksheets, evaluation grids, coloring, mind maps, etc.

Title: Tila
Description: Tila (https://tila.ai/) brings together all possible generations in a single tool in the form of an infinite table: text, image, voice, video, code, graphics, agents, etc. Several language or image models are proposed, to be activated manually or chosen by the tool according to the instruction.

Title: Kyutai STT
Description: Kyutai STT (https://kyutai.org/next/stt) is Kyutai’s “speech to text” model, available in two versions open-source:

Title: ComputerX
Description: ComputerX (https://computerx.ai) generates websites or applications from an instruction (HTML, css, and js). After a work plan is developed, the files are generated. Analyzes the code and corrects any errors found.

Title: Minimax audio
Description: Minimax audio (https://www.minimax.io/audio): “text to speech” and music generation grouped together in the same tool.

Title: Qwen webdev
Description: Qwen webdev (https://chat.qwen.ai/) is a web development agent based on the 3-235B language model Qwen Qwen Chat integrated web development.

Title: Pippit
Description: Pippit (https://pippit.capcut.com/) from CapCut, offers tools for generating video and images: video from an instruction, a document or a URL, image editing tools and video avatar from a text.

Title: Lovable tales
Description: Lovable tales (lovabletales.ai) generates stories from choices made in a chatbot: the theme is proposed by the user and then the directions of the story are chosen via pre-generation proposals.

Title: Sparc3D
Description: Sparc3D (available via https://hitem3d.ai/, documentation: https://lizhihao6.github.io/Sparc3D) is a model for generating 3D images from an image. Export GLB, OBJ & STL.

Title: Claude’s Artifacts
Description: Artifacts (available during claude.ai builds or directly through https://claude.ai/artifacts) previously integrated into the Claude interface via Canva (see Artifacts in Claude 3.5 Sonnet) have been vastly improved with Claude Sonnet 4 and now have their own space.

Title: Skywork
Description: Skywork (https://skywork.ai/) brings together multiple agents, autonomous or directed, to generate documents, presentations, spreadsheets, web pages, and podcasts.

Title: MMaudio
Description: MMaudio (https://mmaudio.net/) sounds short videos in a few seconds, from the loaded file or its url, accompanied by an instruction (negative instruction possible).

Title: AiQuizGen
Description: AiQuizGen (https://aiquizgen.com/) generates several quiz formats (multiple choice, true or false, fill-in-the-blank text, and short answers) from several possible sources (instruction, text, pdf, another quiz text format).

Title: Songscription
Description: Songscription (https://songscription.ai) generates the transcribed score of a piece of music from a loaded song (mp3, wav, mp4, m4a, midi formats) or a video YouTube.

Title: Mew design
Description: Mew design (https://mew.design) generates graphic communication materials from instructions: posters, visuals, social networks and business cards.

Title: ScreenHelp
Description: ScreenHelp (https://screenhelp.ai/) reads web pages (screenshot) and performs actions based on user-defined instructions (description, questions, summary, etc.).

Title: Luzia
Description: Luzia (https://www.luzia.com) brings together several generative AI features in one application (iOS, Android and WhatsApp):

Title: Hera
Description: Hera (https://hera.video) generates motion graphics from an instruction: animated text or images, graphics, timelines, and so on.

Title: ChatEurope
Description: ChatEurope (https://chateurope.eu) is a news platform to “help you better understand Europe, how it works, its decisions and their impact on your daily life”. ChatEurope offers verified and sourced information (the sources are those hosted on the platform).

Title: Hatch
Description: Hatch (https://hatchcanvas.com) brings together several generative AIs and specialized agents via a chatbot and an infinite whiteboard: text, image, computer graphics, website, code, applications, etc.

Title: Stepfun
Description: Stepfun (https://stepfun.ai/) is a text and image generation chatbot that offers several templates and an agent:

Title: Gemma 3n
Description: Gemma 3n (to be tested in Google ai studio or on Hugging Face spaces): two “lightweight” open-source language models designed to be deployed on personal devices (smartphones, tablets, computers). Multimodal models.Once installed on a device (requires recent devices and technical skills), they can then work without an internet connection.

Title: ThinkSound
Description: ThinkSound (demo: https://huggingface.co/spaces/FunAudioLLM/ThinkSound and documentation: https://github.com/FunAudioLLM/ThinkSound) generates the soundtrack of videos by synchronizing and adding it directly to the original file, with or without instructions.

Title: Dende
Description: Dende (https://dende.ai/) generates quizzes and flashcards from a pdf, doc, txt or ppt document. Questions are generated by chapters or topics.

Title: YouTube to doc
Description: YouTube to doc (https://y2doc.com) generates writings from YouTube videos: blog posts, summaries, conversations, emails, etc.

Title: Ai story generator
Description: Ai story generator (https://www.aistorygenerator.shop) generates stories from an instruction.

Title: Kimi K2
Description: Kimi K2 (demo: https://www.kimi.com/ and documentation: <a href="https://github.com/MoonshotAI/Kimi-K2″>https://github.com/MoonshotAI/Kimi-K2) is a language model open-source of the Chinese company Moonshot.

Title: Clemence
Description: Clemence (https://clemence.cc) combines text generative AI and search engine to provide a detailed, sourced response to an instruction.

Title: Glasp
Description: Glasp (https://glasp.co/) supports internet browsing with several tools:

Title: MusicGPT
Description: MusicGPT (https://musicgpt.com) generates musical tracks, instrumental or with lyrics (imported or generated), from instructions.

Title: Videoinu
Description: Videoinu (https://videoinu.com) generates videos with music, voice, and subtitles, from an instruction and created characters.

Title: Statpecker
Description: Statpecker (https://app.statpecker.com/) generates infographics from a topic and/or a data file in csv.

Title: Nim
Description: Nim (https://nim.video/) combines image, video and story generation with several popular templates in one tool.

Title: Runner H
Description: Hcompany’s Runner H (https://runner.hcompany.ai/) automates given tasks via an instruction by browsing the web if necessary.

Title: Gladia
Description: Gladia (https://www.gladia.io/) transcribes videos or audios into text.

Title: Fast3D
Description: Fast3D (https://fast3d.io/) generates 3D images from an instruction or image.

Title: Lumo
Description: Proton’s Lumo (https://lumo.proton.me/) is a secure, European-hosted text chatbot with zero-access encryption, no data sharing or retention.

Title: Mirage
Description: Mirage (https://mirage.decart.ai) transforms a video stream – a real-time shared camera or screen, or a downloaded file – into a new visual universe by applying motion-tracking filters to people and settings.

Title: Loveart
Description: Loveart (https://www.lovart.ai/) generates images and videos from a chatbot and whiteboard.

Title: Webwave
Description: Webwave (https://webwave.me/) generates multi-page websites based on an instruction and aesthetic choices.

Title: Tldraw Computer
Description: Tldraw Computer (https://computer.tldraw.com) automates tasks organized by logical blocks on a whiteboard.

Title: GLM 4.5
