Title: National Gallery Mixtape
Description: National Gallery Mixtape (https://artsandculture.google.com/experiment/national-gallery-mixtape/iwHPaSXS-zrryg?hl=fr) is a joint project of the National Gallery of London and Google Arts and Culture.

Title: Chatterbox
Description: Chatterbox (documentation: https://github.com/resemble-ai/chatterbox and demonstration: https://huggingface.co/spaces/ResembleAI/Chatterbox-Multilingual-TTS) is a “text to speech” model open-source available in 23 languages for its Multilingual version. Two other versions are offered only in English, TTS and Turbo with the possible addition of noises (laughter, sniffling, clucking etc.) in the generation.

Title: Google AI Edge Gallery
Description: Google AI Edge Gallery (Github: https://github.com/google-ai-edge/gallery, direct IOS and Android Appstore links via the Play Store) is an experimental mobile app from Google based on the Gemma models.

Title: MindVideo
Description: MindVideo (https://www.mindvideo.ai) has 40 image generation templates and 30 video generation templates, including the most popular (including Flux unlimited and Sora 2 available for free).

Title: HY Motion 1.0
Description: HY Motion 1.0 (documentation: HY Motion 1.0 is a model dedicated to the generation of 3D animations of characters – human exclusively – produced by Tencent.

Title: Qwen Image Layered
Description: Qwen Image Layered (documentation: <a href="https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen-Image-Layered?spm=a2ty_o06.30285417.0.0.3ef2c921BiEZgfet”>https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen-Image-Layered?spm=a2ty_o06.30285417.0.0.3ef2c921BiEZgfet demo: <a href="https://huggingface.co/spaces/Qwen/Qwen-Image-Layered”>https://huggingface.co/spaces/Qwen/Qwen-Image-Layered) generates the different “layers” or slaps of a supplied image by separating them into separate files (backgrounds, objects, characters, etc.).

Title: Samaira
Description: Samaira (https://www.samaira.ai/) is a chatbot with 5 open-source language models (Kimi K2 and K2 Thinking, GPT-OSS 120B, DeepSeek V3.2, Minimax M2) and an image generation model (Flux.1 Pro – not working in tests).

Title: Keepmind
Description: Keepmind (https://keepmind.ai/) generates flashcards, quizzes and mind maps from an instruction, a url, an image or a document.

Title: Neo
Description: Neo (neobrowser.ai) is a browser offered by Norton with built-in security options (norton webshield, ad blocker, no retained data) and integrated AI features:

Title: Accessdoc
Description: Accessdoc (https://accessdoc.fr/) offers, in a word processor-type interface, a set of tools to make a document accessible or check its accessibility.

Title: Sketchflow
Description: Sketchflow (https://www.sketchflow.ai/) generates web pages or applications from an instruction.

Title: Diagrimo
Description: Diagrimo (https://www.tenorshare.ai/fr/online-diagrimo) generates visualizations/infographics from a text.

Title: QR Code Art Generator
Description: QR Code Art Generator (https://huggingface.co/spaces/Oysiyl/AI-QR-code-generator) generates “artistic” and photorealistic QR codes from an instruction.

Title: Scribe V2
Description: Eleven Labs’ Scribe v2 (https://elevenlabs.io/speech-to-text) is a voice-to-text transcription model with two versions: v2 real time for on-the-fly transcriptions and v2 for transcriptions from an audio or video file.

Title: Clipfinder
Description: Clipfinder (https://www.clipfinder.org) generates “standalone” clips from a YouTube video (from other platforms advertised) based on transcription and Gemini 3 flashes.

Title: Harpa
Description: Harpa (https://harpa.ai/) offers in an extension a range of tools available directly in the pages visited.

Title: Image editor
Description: Image editor (https://imageeditor.online/) is an image generator with 10 templates that specializes in editing images from a source image and an instruction.

Title: Landing page
Description: Landing Page (https://landing-page.io/) generates a HTML page from a statement with possible iterations (without memory of the conversation, so you have to chain change requests before generating other pages in the project).

Title: Teacher Tools
Description: Teacher Tools (https://tchr.tools/) offers 5 tools to generate documents for the teacher:

Title: Supertonic
Description: Supertonic (documentation: https://huggingface.co/Supertone/supertonic-2 and demo: https://huggingface.co/spaces/Supertone/supertonic-2) is a “text-to-voice” model that can be installed and run locally on your computer via a browser (documented installation).

Title: GLM Image
Description: GLM Image (documentation: <a href="https://huggingface.co/zai-org/GLM-Image”>https://huggingface.co/zai-org/GLM-Image and demonstration: <a href="https://huggingface.co/spaces/multimodalart/GLM-Image”>https://huggingface.co/spaces/multimodalart/GLM-Image) is a open-source image generation model produced by z.ai, publisher of the language model GLM and Vidu. Based on 9 billion parameters.

Title: Ticketfy
Description: Ticketfy (https://ticketify.io) supports project management by generating linked tickets from an instruction.

Title: ChartGen
Description: ChartGen (https://chartgen.ai) analyzes data files and produces visualizations in the form of graphs.

Title: TranslateGemma
Description: TranslateGemma (documentation: https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/technology/developers-tools/translategemma/ and 27B https://huggingface.co/spaces/hysts/translategemma-27b-it or 4B: https://huggingface.co/spaces/fantos/translate-gemma) is a translation template available in three sizes (4, 12, and 27B) produced by Google.

Title: Flux 2 Klein
Description: Flux 2 Klein is an open-source lightweight model of Black forest LAbs from the same family as Flux 2 or Flux pro.

Title: Z-image
Description: Z-image (documentation: https://github.com/Tongyi-MAI/Z-Image and Turbo version demonstration: https://huggingface.co/spaces/Tongyi-MAI/Z-Image-Turbo) is a lightweight (6 million parameters) and fast image generation model.

Title: Rapidnative
Description: Rapidnative (https://www.rapidnative.com) generates mobile apps from an instruction.

Title: Anam
Description: Anam (https://anam.ai) creates chatbots based on video avatars from an instruction.

Title: Cybercut
Description: Cybercut (https://cybercut.ai/) is an AI-assisted video editing app.

Title: Mindmaclasse
Description: Mindmaclasse (https://apps4edu.fr/mindmaclasse/) generates mind maps from an instruction or a document as well as exercises for revision (quizzes, fill-in-the-blank texts and flashcards with txt export of the results).An instruction generator to generate a mind map in other tools is included.LLM: Mistral-Small-3.2, hosted in France.

Title: Leadde
Description: Leadde (https://leadde.ai) generates an explainer video with avatar and voice from a document or presentation.

Title: Prism
Description: OpenAI’s Prism (presentation: <a href="https://openai.com/fr-FR/prism/”>https://openai.com/fr-FR/prism/ and application: https://prism.openai.com/) is a LaTex editor coupled with a chatbot based on ChatGPT 5.2. (LaTex is a language and system for composing documents, see Wikipedia article).

Title: LLM Council
Description: LLM Council (documentation: https://github.com/machine-theory/lm-council?tab=readme-ov-file, demonstration: https://huggingface.co/spaces/burtenshaw/karpathy-llm-council and video presentation of related research: <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hI0XCE27QqE”>https://www.YouTube. com/watch?v=hI0XCE27QqE is a “democratic” space that synthesizes the responses to a query from several language models into one.

Title: Chef by Convex
Description: Chef by Convex (documentation: https://github.com/get-convex/chef and application: https://chef.convex.dev/) builds applications with databases from an instruction.

Title: Vibe paint
Description: Vibe paint (https://vibepaint-ai-795372324720.us-west1.run.app/) transforms a drawing made directly in the interface from a predefined style.

Title: Foldback Design
Description: Replit Design (https://replit.com/products/design) generates website or application designs from an instruction.

Title: Dokie
Description: Dokie (https://dokie.ai/) generates presentations from an instruction or document, a URL, or a YouTube video.

Title: Otio
Description: Otio (https://otio.ai/) is a chatbot focused on document analysis and web search based on 40 language models available.

Title: Hugging Chat
Description: Hugging Chat (https://huggingface.co/chat/) closed in 2025 (see the HuggingChat Assistants and HuggingChat Tools archives for the previous version) is accessible again in a new version and a simplified interface. Only the chatbot function has been retained, increased by the possibility of connecting MCP servers (expert use).

Title: Voxtral
Description: Voxtral (documentation: https://mistral.ai/fr/news/voxtral-transcribe-2 and demo: in Mistral AI studio or for direct transcription voxtral mini realtime – out of order during testing) is the audio transcription model of Mistral.

Title: André
Description: André (https://andre.vote/) is a chatbot specialized in electoral analysis in France and fed on 4 open data sources covering the period 1999 / 2024.

Title: Parliant
Description: Parliant (https://www.parliant.ai) is a survey and polling application where generative AI can produce the text of open-ended questions based on a given topic.

Title: Weavy
Description: Weavy (https://www.weavy.ai/) brings together several dozen “combinable” image and video generation templates on an infinite array.From an image generated with one model, a video can be generated with another or serve as the basis for a third generation.Each generation can thus be connected to another by drawn wires.

Title: Sesame
Description: Sesame (https://www.sesame.com/) is an oral conversation model currently in research version, based on the open-source csm model (https://github.com/SesameAILabs/csm).Current research is documented: https://www.sesame.com/research/crossing_the_uncanny_valley_of_voice. Two voices are available for testing: https://app.sesame.com/ before the launch of a dedicated application (waiting list for access to the beta version).

Title: Kugel Audio
Description: Kugel Audio (documentation: https://github.com/Saganaki22/ComfyUI-KugelAudio and demonstration: https://huggingface.co/spaces/multimodalart/kugelaudio) is a text-to-speech (text-to-voice) model with 24 European voices.

Title: Rabbit Hole
Description: Rabbit Hole (https://www.rabbithole.chat/) is a visual search engine that organizes the generated answers in the form of an infinite mind map.

Title: Veeso
Description: Veeso (https://veeso.ai/) generates communication content (posters, flyers, infographics, etc.) from a detailed instruction.

Title: Eler
Description: Eler (https://www.eler.ai/) transforms 3D images into realistic photos.

Title: Muses
Description: Muses (https://muses.my/) is a word processor combined with a chatbot and a library of documents, URLs, and images.

Title: Inkr
Description: Inkr (https://inkr.app/) transcribes audio from audio or video files, a URL, or a live recording.

Title: VoooAI
Description: VoooAI (https://voooai.com/) generates images, videos, and music from a workflow: one instruction generates content that becomes the source of another instruction, and so on.

Title: Doodle Duel
Description: Doodle Duel (https://doodleduel.ai/) is a drawing game where you have to draw the given word or phrase as quickly as possible. The AI judges whether the drawing sufficiently represents what was requested or not.

Title: Slides orator
Description: Slides orator (https://www.slidesorator.com/) generates an explainer video with an audio 3D avatar from a pdf.

Title: Teachermatics
Description: Teachermatics (https://teachermatic.com/) brings together a set of generators dedicated to teaching (more than 80: lesson plans, quizzes, flashcards, questions, etc.).

Title: Figy
Description: Figy (https://figy.ai) generates flashcards from a document.Three types of cards are offered: questions / answers, fill-in-the-blank text and multiple choice.

Title: Deep Scholar
Description: Deep scholar (https://deep-scholar.vercel.app, based on Lotus, open-source: https://github.com/lotus-data/lotus) is a semantic search engine coupled with a language model and focused on the search for sicntific articles (Arxiv and PubMed in particular).Lotus was made by a team of researchers from Stanford and Berkeley Universities (https://lotus-data.github.io/#team).

Title: Gemini Music (Lyria 3)
Description: Lyria 3 is the music generation model built into Gemini (description: https://deepmind.google/models/lyria/ and direct access: https://gemini.google.com/music).

Title: Findtube
Description: Findtube (https://findtube.ai/) is a search engine that specializes in YouTube videos and learning modules that build on these same videos.

Title: Litgrades
Description: Litgrades (https://litgrades.com/) generates flashcards, teacher worksheets, and review sheets from an instruction and related topics.

Title: Runable
Description: Runable (https://runable.com) brings together several recent templates and agents in a single application to generate different types of text, image, video, and voice content.

Title: Flow + Nano Banana 2
Description: Flow (https://labs.google/fx/fr/tools/flow/) generates sound videos from a text instruction that can be augmented with images.

Title: Anuma
Description: Anuma (https://www.anuma.ai/) is a text and image chatbot that integrates several models in two modes: private and public.

Title: Variant
Description: Variant (https://variant.com/) generates site or application designs from an instruction.

Title: Mercury 2
Description: Mercury 2 (description https://www.inceptionlabs.ai/blog/introducing-mercury-2 : and demo: https://chat.inceptionlabs.ai/) is the first model for text generation based on delivery, as are image or video generation.

Title: Monodesk
Description: Monodesk (https://www.monodesk.com/) offers three project management tools linked in a single interface: calendar, Kanban board and contact/customer database. These three tools can be automated via a chatbot.

Title: Arcanon
Description: Arcanon (https://arcanon-ai.vercel.app/) summons the thoughts of Descartes, Artistote, Machiaviel and Han Fei around a proposed subject.

Title: Komos
Description: Komos (https://www.komos.ai/) is a set of agents that allow you to automate tasks on the web.

Title: Axell
Description: Axell (https://www.axellai.com/) brings together several language and image/video generation models in an infinite array interface.Each generation since a chatbot integrated into the board or object present can be linked to one or more others as the basis of a new generation.

Title: Formhug
Description: Formhug (https://formhug.ai/) offers the creation of forms, quizzes without or with the help of the generative AI.

Title: Flames
Description: Flames (https://flames.blue/) builds applications from an instruction.

Title: Ai pdf reader
Description: Ai pdf reader (https://aipdfreader.net/fr) summarizes pdf documents and allows them to be queried via a chatbot.

Title: Pandada
Description: Pandada (https://pandada.ai/) is a chatbot that specializes in data analysis and complex searches.

Title: Trivia Pixel
Description: Trivia Pixel (https://www.triviapixel.com/) generates quizzes based on a given theme, to be completed solo or in competition mode.

Title: Cloudfare Build
Description: Cloudfare Build (Docuentation: https://github.com/cloudflare/vibesdk and Demo: https://build.cloudflare.dev/) builds applications from preconfigured (and econfigurable) instructions and agents.

Title: Intangible
Description: Intangible (https://studio.intangible.ai) generates 3D scenes from an image.

Title: Medo
Description: Medo (https://medo.dev) builds applications from a statementTwo build modes, “fast” and “Deep Build”, extensions and designs are offered.

Title: Creen
Description: Creen (https://www.creen.ai) generates images and videos from an instruction or images. Three models for image generation (Creen / seedream / Z-image) and 4 for video generation (Creen / seedance / Hailuo / Wan).

Title: Gistilo
Description: Gistilo (https://gistilo.com) summarizes videos YouTube.

Title: Knowlify
Description: Knowlify (https://www.knowlify.com – choose “Platform”) manages explainer videos from an instruction and a chosen voice.

Title: Creatus Music
Description: Crztus Music (https://music.creatus.ai) generates music tracks from a genre with an instruction or imported lyrics.

Title: Clico
Description: Clico (https://tryclico.com/) is a browser extension (Chrome, Edge, Brave, Arc, and all Chromium-based browsers) that integrates the features of a chatbot directly into the pages visited:

Title: Cartesia Sonic
Description: Cartesia Sonic (https://cartesia.ai/sonic) is a “Text-to-Voice” application deployed with two versions: a text generation version and a searchable audio chatbot version.

Title: Wacka
Description: Wacka (https://whacka.app) generates online mobile applications from an instruction and a chatbot.

Title: Make it
Description: Make it (https://make-it.ai) transforms ideas for technical objects to make yourself into a documented project, from the list of materials to the step-by-step tutorial.The objects can be based on Arduino, Raspberry, ESP and be battery-powered, solar or mains.

Title: Commabot
Description: Commabot (https://commabot.com/) parses csv files from instructions.

Title: Thinkingline
Description: Thinkingline (https://www.thinkingline.com/) generates educational videos and vector images from an instruction in animated sketchnote mode with oral presentation.

Title: Tosea
Description: Tosea (https://tosea.ai/) generates presentations from a pdf document (orientation to scientific articles and academic documents) and an integrated chatbot.

Title: Video notes
Description: Video Notes (https://www.video-notes.co/) offers YouTube video analysis with transcript, detailed summary, analysis, chatbot, and notes.

Title: Public ai
Description: Public Ai (Chatbot: https://chat.publicai.co, project website: https://publicai.co/ and documentation: https://github.com/forpublicai) is an open-source chatbot based on the Apertus language model and SEA-LION V4.

Title: Thaura
Description: Thaura (https://thaura.ai/), “revolution” in Arabic, is an ethical, frugal, committed… and very complete chatbot.

Title: Omma
Description: Omma (https://omma.build/) generates applications and web pages from instructions with a specialization in 3D models.Great respect and understanding of instructions, generations already very successful in a single iteration.

Title: BookletAI
Description: BookletAI (https://bookletai.org) generates “booklets” in the form of HTML pages that turn or pdfs that can be shared and presented online based on a topic and reading time.

Title: Coherent transcribed
Description: Cohere Transcribe (documentation: https://huggingface.co/CohereLabs/cohere-transcribe-03-2026 and demonstration: https://huggingface.co/spaces/CohereLabs/cohere-transcribe-03-2026) transcribes recorded or imported audios.

Title: Molmo web
Description: Molmo Web (Documentation: https://allenai.org/blog/molmoweb and demonstration: https://molmoweb.allen.ai/) is a web agent that automates an internet search ordered by an instruction given in a chatbot.

Title: Seedance 2
Description: Seedance 2 (available in Capcut and in Dreamina) is the latest version of ByteDance’s video generation model.

Title: Pixpark
Description: Pixpark (https://pixpark.ai/) generates images from a reference statement or image.

Title: Scholar Labs
Description: Scholar Labs (https://scholar.google.fr/) is an experimental natural language search engine integrated with Google Scholar, accessible from the menu bar.

Title: Zawa
Description: Zawa (formerly X-design – https://zawa.ai/) is a chatbot combined with a whiteboard specialized in the generation of visual content, image or video or HTML page.

Title: Gemma 4
Description: Gemma 4 (description: https://huggingface.co/blog/gemma4) is the latest open-source model from Google.It is available on Hugging Face, in the Google AI Studio (https://aistudio.google.com/) and in the Google AI Edge Gallery in mobile version.

Title: Voice Generator
Description: Voice Generator (https://voice-generator.com/) transforms texts into voices from written or pasted text, pdf or epub.

Title: Adam
Description: Adam (https://adam.new/ and documentation: https://github.com/Adam-CAD/CADAM) is a model that, coupled with a language model, transforms a natural language query into a 3D object.

Title: Google Vids – Veo 3.1
Description: Google Vids (https://docs.google.com/videos) integrates Veo 3.1, the latest version of Google’s video generator, Gemini Music (Lyria 3) for auto-generated soundtracks, Nano Banana Pro for still images, and Text to speech voices for voiceovers in a video editing tool.

Title: Blueprint
Description: Blueprint (https://www.blueprint.am/) generates detailed prototypes from an instruction and a chatbot.

Title: World Monitor
Description: World Monitor (https://www.worldmonitor.app/ and documentation: https://www.worldmonitor.app/docs/documentation, github: https://github.com/koala73/worldmonitor) is a real-time dashboard that brings together global geopolitical and economic information flows, fully configurable and with many AI features (summaries, translation, mapping, analysis…).

Title: Muse Spark
Description: Muse Spark (description: https://ai.meta.com/blog/introducing-muse-spark-msl/) is Meta’s proprietary model available in apps and in meta.ai.

Title: Wiki Timeline
Description: Wiki Timeline (https://wiki-timeline.com) generates timelines from one or more Wikipedia articles (added via search or url).

Title: Maskerade
Description: Maskerade (https://maskerade.ai/) generates reports in response to an instruction via the actions of multiple personas.

Title: LearnClash
Description: LearnClash (https://learnclash.com) offers quizzes to be solved individually or in duel, or generated from a given topic.

Title: Pascal Editor
Description: Pascal Editor (application: https://editor.pascal.app/ and documentation: https://github.com/pascalorg/editor) generates, from instructions in a chatbot, 2D and 3D architectural plans with realistic rendering possible.

Title: Holotab
Description: Holotab (https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/holotab/hlaoiikljjgcjdhkakedfngifaopbcop) is a Chrome extension launched by HCompany (a French company already seen here with Runner H) and which offers an autonomous agent capable of browsing the web from instructions.

Title: Rosebud
Description: Rosebud (https://rosebud.ai/) generates games from instructions.

Title: Google Flow Music
Description: Flow Music (https://www.flowmusic.app) is Google’s latest generative AI app after the acquisition of Producer (seen here now archived), which generates music with or without lyrics and music videos.

Title: Smol LM 3
Description: Smol LM 3 (documentation: https://huggingface.co/HuggingFaceTB/SmolLM3-3B and demonstration: https://huggingface.co/spaces/HuggingFaceTB/SmolLM3-3B-WebGPU) is a very lightweight language model (3 B parameters), produced by Huggingface.

Title: Dailyscope
Description: Every day, Dailyscope (https://www.dailyscope.ai) analyses international press sources (not French sources) to bring out the main themes and allow comparison between the different treatments of the same subject.

Title: Gemini 3.1 TTS Preview
Description: Gemini 3.1 TTS Preview (demo on Google Ai studio https://aistudio.google.com/generate-speech?model=gemini-3.1-flash-tts-preview) is Google’s latest text-to-voice model.

Title: NBot
Description: NBot (https://nbot.ai/) generates an automated monitoring from an instruction and the answer to questions that allow it to be refined.

Title: ChatGPT images 2.0
Description: ChatGPT Images 2.0 (https://chatgpt.com/) is the latest image generation model from ChatGPT.

Title: Podcasty
Description: Podcasty (https://podcasty.fm/) generates podcast episodes from online articles.

Title: Reka
Description: Reka (https://reka.ai/ and models: https://huggingface.co/RekaAI) offers several multimodal models for image and video analysis, text and voice.Two first versions were offered here: Reka and Reka’s Space.

Title: Arky
Description: Arky (https://arky.so/) is an infinite whiteboard-style visual workspace combined with a chatbot to structure a project or ideas.

Title: 12ui
Description: 12ui (https://12ui.com/) generates web interfaces (HTML/CSS) from a drawing or a diagram with shapes or texts made directly in the interface and/or from a textual instruction.

Title: Happyhorse
Description: Happyhorse (https://www.happyhorse.com) is Alibaba’s latest video generation model.

Title: Echo 2
Description: Echo 2 (https://spaitial.ai) generates realistic or imaginary 3D and 360° worlds in which you can move around, from an image imported or generated directly in the application.

Title: FireRed Image-Edit
Description: FireRed Image-Edit (Documentation: https://github.com/FireRedTeam/FireRed-Image-Edit and Demo: https://huggingface.co/spaces/prithivMLmods/FireRed-Image-Edit-1.0-Fast) transforms an image from an instruction.

Title: Stanzio
Description: Stanzio (https://stanzio.fly.dev/) generates presentations from interactions in a chatbot.

Title: Tinfoil Chat
Description: Tinfoil Chat (https://chat.tinfoil.sh/) is a chatbot advertised as secure thanks to end-to-end data encryption, with each conversation having its own unique key.

Title: Soonlab
Description: Soonlab (https://www.soonlab.ai/) generates video games from instructions.

Title: Honen
Description: Honen (https://honen.com/) generates courses from an instruction and/or a supporting document.

Title: Replit slides
Description: Replit slides (https://replit.com/slides) is a Replit agent dedicated to generating presentations.

Title: Knowly
Description: Knowly (https://goknowly.ai/) transforms saved content or a directly entered topic into a learning path: articles, PDFs, videos and web pages are automatically organized into themes in a library and/or organized into “flows”.

Title: Presenton
Description: Presenton (https://presenton.ai/ — documentation: https://github.com/presenton/presenton) generates presentations from an imported statement or document.

Title: Pomelli
Description: Pomelli (https://labs.google.com/u/0/pomelli/) is an experimental tool from Google Labs specialized in the creation of communication campaigns from a website.

Title: Friday
Description: Edit 08/26: now only to install and with third-party API, archived.Friday (https://hellofriday.ai for the version to be installed and online application: https://app.hellofriday.ai. Documentation: https://github.com/friday-platform/friday-studio) builds instructions in a chatbot and then executes automations by setting up AI agents that can launch regularly.

Title: Open Maic
Description: Open Maic (https://openmaic.io/, documentation: https://github.com/THU-MAIC/OpenMAIC, online demo https://open.maic.chat/) generates interactive courses from an imported topic description or PDF, orchestrating multiple AI agents.

Title: SciFig
Description: SciFig (https://scifig.ai/) generates scientific figures and computer graphics from an instruction, a drawing or a PDF or photo.

Title: Linto Studio
Description: LinTO Studio (https://studio.linto.ai/ and documentation: https://github.com/linto-ai) transcribes and generates subtitles from audio or video files.

Title: Tokemon
Description: Tokemon (https://tokemonlabs.com/ and documentation: https://github.com/leejustin/tokemon) presents 30 AI language models in the form of a Pokédex (see on Wikipedia) with stat sheets, types, evolution chains and simulated battles.The whole thing is based on the codes of the Pokemon game, Tokemon is a bit like a Compar:IA Pokemon in pixel art.

Title: Brik
Description: Brik (https://brik.space/) generates interactive mini-applications, between mini-game and motion design, from an instruction.

Title: CompaRAG
Description: CompaRAG (https://comparag.vercel.app/, description: https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/au-coeur-du-premier-comparateur-doutils-rag-fran%C3%A7ais-la-sarazin-phd-rhdje/ and documentation: https://github.com/ArthurSrz/CompaRAG/) compares RAG tools blindly from instructions and documents submitted by the user.RAG, for “retrieval-augmented generation,” makes it possible to improve the quality of an answer by adding additional resources, see Wikipedia.

Title: Hum2song
Description: Hum2Song (https://www.carlostoxtli.com/hum2song/, documentation: https://github.com/toxtli/hum2song) generates a musical accompaniment from a hummed or sung melody.

Title: Nodalist
Description: Nodalist AI (https://nodalist.ai/) builds a thinking-based map around a given topic where each idea becomes a node and multiple language models can debate in real-time about a topic on the map.

Title: Saveto
Description: Saveto AI (https://saveto.ai/) brings together several tools to transcribe, summarize, transform videos, audio files and documents but also generate podcasts, infographics or flashcards.

Title: SlideScript
Description: SlideScript (https://www.slidescript.live/) generates the notes of a presentation from a pdf or ppt file.

Title: Pixal3D
Description: Pixal3D (four servers available: https://huggingface.co/spaces/TencentARC/Pixal3D-Server and documentation: https://github.com/TencentARC/Pixal3D) generates a high-quality 3D model from an imported image.

Title: Mixboard
Description: Mixboard (https://labs.google.com/mixboard/) generates visual design boards from an instruction, on a whiteboard fed as it interacts with AI.

Title: Vibeknow
Description: Vibeknow (https://vibeknow.ai/) converts documents and web pages into videos with narration and background music.

Title: Dim0
Description: Dim0 (https://app.dim0.net and documentation: https://github.com/vcmf/dim0) is an infinite table, organized as a mind map, that can be filled with documents, notes, code, or diagrams, with an integrated AI agent.

Title: Our stories
Description: Our Stories (https://readourstories.org/) generates children’s stories from an instruction.

Title: CartoMind
Description: CartoMind (https://cartomind.ai/) generates infographics from an instruction, a pasted text or an imported document (md, pdf, txt, doc).

Title: Stable Audio 3
Description: Stable Audio 3 (https://huggingface.co/collections/stabilityai/stable-audio-3) is the new version of the music generation model of the Stable Audio family already seen here. Open source for 3 of its 4 variants, generates instrumental music tracks and sound effects from an instruction, with sounds/music that can be added as cues.

Title: Ecosia
Description: Ecosia (https://www.ecosia.org) is a non-profit search engine, based on Bing, Google and Qwant, whose profits from advertising finance reforestation and renewable energy projects.Integrates two AI features: generated summaries (AI Overviews) and a conversational mode (AI Chat).

Title: MindChat World
Description: MindChat World (https://mindchat.world/fr/) allows you to converse in writing with simulated historical figures in a chatbot: writers, philosophers and scientists.

Title: MeshGPT
Description: MeshGPT (https://meshgpt.io/) generates 3D models from a text instruction or an image.

Title: Explainpaper
Description: Explainpaper (https://www.explainpaper.com/) explains the difficult passages of a pdf file.Research oriented but works with any pdf.

Title: HappySeeds
Description: HappySeeds (https://happyseeds.ai) generates web applications from an instruction.

Title: DocsToAudio
Description: DocsToAudio (https://docstoaudio.online/) converts pdf, epub, docx and txt files to MP3 or M4B audio with 300 AI voices in 50 languages available (13 French-speaking).

Title: WorkInProcess
Description: WorkInProcess (https://workinprocess.app/) is an online image editing studio whose AI models run entirely in the browser, without sending files to a server.

Title: Overline
Description: Overline (https://overline.live/) is a Chrome extension that adds real-time subtitles and live overlay translation on any video in the browser, without a subtitle file and without switching tabs.

Title: MAI Playground
Description: MAI Playground (https://playground.microsoft.ai/) provides access to Microsoft’s AI models: image generation, audio transcription, text-to-speech, and multimodal conversation.

Title: PDF to Lesson
Description: PDF to Lesson (https://www.pdftolesson.com/ — documentation: https://github.com/Nutlope/pdf-to-interactive-lesson) transforms a PDF document into an interactive course structured in modules.

Title: Arena
Description: Arena (https://arena.ai/) is the commercial version of Chatbot Arena, relaunched in January 2026 under a new name and URL, with expanded functionality. The site can also be accessed on HuggingFace (https://huggingface.co/lmarena-ai).

Title: Is it Fake?
Description: Is it Fake? (https://isitfake.app/) checks the credibility of news articles via their URL.

Title: InfoBlog
Description: InfoBlog (https://useinfoblog.com/) transforms instructions and/or documents into editable presentations, carousels, or infographics.

Title: Open Paper
Description: Open Paper (application: https://openpaper.ai/ and documentation: https://github.com/khoj-ai/openpaper) allows you to read, annotate and query academic research articles.

Title: ChordGen
Description: ChordGen (https://www.chordgen.org/) generates chord progressions from an instruction describing a musical mood or genre and a chord count.

Title: Lium
Description: Lium (https://www.lium.ai/) connects complex data sources (databases, files, APIs, etc.) and responds in natural language with AI-generated analyses, scripts or tools.

Title: Inkfox AI
Description: Inkfox AI (https://inkfox.app/) generates images and videos by instruction, with no registration needed.

Title: PDFFly PDF summarizer
Description: PDFFly (https://pdffly.com/pdf-summarizer) generates a structured summary from an imported PDF and allows the document to be queried via a chatbot.

Title: Happycapy
Description: Happycapy (https://happycapy.ai/) is a chatbot with AI agents to perform tasks in the browser for the user.

Title: ManualFig
Description: ManualFig (https://manualfig.ai/) transforms a photo into assembly instructions, operating instructions or operating diagrams based on an image and an instruction.

Title: Drafted
Description: Drafted (https://www.drafted.ai/) generates house plans from a list of rooms, a land shape, and a style.

Title: Clarify AI
Description: Clarify AI (https://www.clarify-ai.com/) breaks down a problem into a tree of hierarchical sub-questions, with web search and structured text export.

Title: Swishy
Description: Swishy (https://www.swishy.ai/) generates motion design animations (typographies or animated objects) from a natural language instruction.

Title: Veritas Source
Description: Veritas Source (https://veritas-source.com/) analyzes a URL, text, or image to assess its source: political bias, ownership, funding, editorial history, and signs of AI generation.

Title: Socrati
Description: Socrati (https://socrati.app/) transforms an instruction, topic, PDF, YouTube video, or photo into an interactive course with lessons, quizzes, flashcards (and paid audio).

Title: MakeInfographic AI
Description: MakeInfographic AI (https://www.makeinfographic.ai/) generates infographics from an instruction.

Title: Loopa
Description: Loopa (https://www.loopa.im) is an AI agent platform that performs search, creation, analysis, and automation tasks.

Title: JustVibe
Description: JustVibe (https://justvibe.com/) generates interactive web applications from an instruction.

Title: Floor Plan Maker
Description: Floor Plan Maker (https://floorplanmaker.ai/) generates floor plans, changes the style of interiors and facades from an imported photo, and converts 2D plans into exportable 3D models.

Title: ImagiNPrompt
Description: ImagiNPrompt (https://imaginprompt.com/) generates instructions from an imported image or free text and also generates images.

Title: Lolaby
Description: Lolaby (https://huggingface.co/spaces/build-small-hackathon/lolaby and documentation: https://huggingface.co/build-small-hackathon/lolaby-llama-3b) generates personalised lullabies based on an image (drawing or photo), a child’s first name, age and interests.

Title: Mistral OCR 4
Description: Mistral OCR 4 (https://console.mistral.ai/build/document-ai/ocr-playground and documentation: https://docs.mistral.ai/models/model-cards/ocr-4-0) extracts and structures the content of documents.

Title: Music0 AI
Description: Music0 AI (https://music0.org/) generates music tracks and video clips from an instruction.

Title: Pluno
Description: Pluno (https://pluno.ai/browser) is a browser extension that executes tasks directly in web pages from an instruction.

Title: Lumo 2.0
Description: Lumo 2.0 (https://lumo.proton.me/) is the new version of Lumo, Proton’s chatbot that generates text, analyzes and generates images, performs a sourced web search, and maintains a user-controlled memory, all end-to-end encrypted.

Title: Boogu Image
Description: Boogu Image (http://demo-base.boogu.org and documentation: https://github.com/boogu-project/Boogu-Image) generates and edits images from a text instruction, with embedded text rendering in French-English and Chinese.

Title: Acti
Description: Acti (https://openacti.com) transforms the phone’s keyboard into an AI assistant: instruction in natural language, execution of actions in other applications, library of more than 150 integrated tools.

Title: LearnKata
Description: LearnKata (https://learnkata.ai/) transforms an instruction or imported documents into learning materials: summaries, quizzes, flashcards, and mind maps.

Title: Briefed
Description: Briefed (https://briefednewsletter.com/) generates an AI-powered personalized newsletter from an instruction.

Title: Bubul
Description: Bubul (https://bubul.app/) offers seven AI tools for teachers and trainers:

Title: ChecklistFox
Description: ChecklistFox (https://checklistfox.com/) generates custom checklists from an instruction or templates, exportable to PDF.

Title: AI Assistant ÊtrePROF
Description: The AI Assistant ÊtrePROF (https://nouvel.etreprof.fr/preparer-seance-sequence) generates pedagogical sessions and a teacher’s sheet from an instruction written in the form of selected information that describes the session, the level, the discipline and the profile of the class (covers the small section to the final year.)

Title: Muse Image
Description: Muse Image (https://www.meta.ai) generates and modifies images from natural language instructions, merging multiple photos and rendering text readable in the image.

Title: Kyutai Pocket TTS
Description: Kyutai Pocket TTS (https://kyutai.org/tts/ — documentation: https://github.com/kyutai-labs/pocket-tts) is an open-source text-to-speech model.

Title: Image to 3D AI
Description: Image to 3D AI (https://image-to-3d.ai/) generates 3D models from an image or text instruction.

Title: Video Transcription AI
Description: Video Transcription AI (https://videotranscription.ai/) automatically transcribes YouTube, TikTok or Instagram videos, video, audio or text files with summary, chatbot and mind map.

Title: Vidmud AI Photo Editor
Description: Vidmud AI Photo Editor (https://www.vidmud.com/ai-photo-editor-online.html) edits a photo from a textual instruction.

Title: Convly Image-to-Prompt Generator
Description: Convly Image-to-Prompt Generator (https://convly.ai/image-to-prompt/) generates an instruction from an imported image.

Title: Fenzo
Description: Fenzo (https://fenzo.ai/) generates a structured interactive course from an instruction or imported documents.

Title: MemeCam
Description: MemeCam (https://www.memecam.io) generates a meme from a photo imported or taken via the camera.

Title: Moodboard Creator
Description: Moodboard Creator (https://www.moodboardcreator.dev) generates an inspiration board from a short description.

Title: MixTranslate
Description: MixTranslate (https://mixtranslate.com/) sends the same translation instruction to language models in parallel and automatically selects the result that best suits the tone and context.

Title: Aye
Description: Aye (https://okaapps.com/product/6760281977) is a Chromium-based web browser with a built-in AI assistant, capable of analyzing a page and planning and executing actions.

Title: Longscribe
Description: Longscribe (https://longscribe.com) transcribes videos and long recordings (YouTube, Vimeo, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, Twitch, X, Dailymotion, SoundCloud or imported audio/video files).

Title: Deck
Description: Deck (https://www.hellodeck.ai/) is an AI assistant that can be reached by a dedicated email address, capable of automating tasks, following discussion threads and organizing work by projects.

Title: Playyy
Description: Playyy (https://playyy.ai/) generates and edits visuals by instruction on a fully editable whiteboard.

Title: AIStoryHub
Description: AIStoryHub (https://aistoryhub.co/) generates fictional chapters from an instruction.

Title: Google AI Mode
Description: Google’s AI Mode (https://google.com/ai) generates detailed answers from any question, written, voiced, or accompanied by an image or document.

Title: ResearchDeck
Description: ResearchDeck (https://www.currentoriginai.com/researchdeck) generates presentations, structured documents, and interactive research briefings from a topic, URL, or YouTube video.

Title: Google AI Preview
Description: AI Preview (https://www.google.com/) summarizes a response to a search query as a summary displayed at the top of the results, before regular links.

Title: Qwen Image 3.0
Description: Qwen Image 3.0 (https://chat.qwen.ai/), the 3rd generation of Alibaba’s image model, generates and retouches images from an instruction.

Title: Womp
Description: Womp (https://womp.com/) allows you to create, sculpt and generate 3D models directly in the browser.

Title: Fikry
Description: Fikry (https://asktofikry.vercel.app/ and documentation: https://medium.com/@serkan-uslu/meet-fikry-the-ai-that-goes-to-the-wrong-building-with-confidence-9c0ac97f9204) responds to an instruction by simulating “poorly trained” AI reasoning, mixing serious logic and assumed absurd answer.

Title: Script.it
Description: Script.it (https://script.it/) generates automations from a statement with possible scheduled triggers.

Title: MuseGen
Description: MuseGen (https://www.musegen.ai/) generates complete songs from a text instruction or provided lyrics.

Title: LogoCreator
Description: LogoCreator (https://thelogocreator.ai/fr) generates logos from a reference statement, style, colors, or image.

Title: VizText (Text2diagram)
Description: Edit 08/26: name change — Text2diagram is now VizText.

Title: MyColoring.AI
Description: MyColoring.AI (https://mycoloring.ai/) turns a photo or text instruction into a printable coloring page.

Title: MiroThinker
Description: MiroThinker (https://dr.miromind.ai/ — documentation: https://github.com/MiroMindAI/MiroThinker) answers a complex question by conducting a multi-step web search and producing a report with sources.

Title: GPT-Live
Description: GPT-Live (https://openai.com/index/introducing-gpt-live/) is OpenAI’s new voice model that powers ChatGPT Voice, real-time conversations with simultaneous listening and speech.

Title: Frontpage
Description: Frontpage (https://frontpage.host/) generates a website from a natural language description, with progressive editing via a chatbot.

Title: Reve Photographer
Description: Reve Photographer (https://apps.apple.com/fr/app/reve-photographer/id6760796481) captures a photo or loads an image, and then applies the selected template.

Title: T3 Chat
Description: T3 Chat (https://t3.chat/) brings together several language models within a chatbot-like interface. Text and code generation.

Title: Paperfig
Description: Paperfig (https://paperfig.io/) generates scientific diagrams and graphical summaries from a text description, a drawing or a photo.

Title: Vibes
Description: Vibes (https://vibes.ai/) generates images and videos from an instruction.Integrated with the Meta AI app (browse, remix, publish) and accessible from vibes.ai.

Title: TextaVoice
Description: TextaVoice (https://www.textavoice.com/) converts text to an audio file.

Title: Flow + Gemini Omni
Description: Gemini Omni, available in Google Flow (https://labs.google/fx/fr/tools/flow/), generates sound videos from a text and/or image instruction. Images can be generated in the interface to feed instructions.

Title: Looops
Description: Looops (https://looops.ai/) generates a website from an instruction.

Title: Vunote
Description: Vunote (https://vunote.so/) transforms a YouTube video or audio file into structured, time-stamped notes.

Title: LongCat-Video
Description: LongCat-Video (demo: https://huggingface.co/spaces/multimodalart/LongCat-Video and documentation: https://github.com/meituan-longcat/LongCat-Video) generates a 6-second video from a text instruction, or an image with an instruction.

Title: MindDory
Description: MindDory (https://minddory.com/) generates vocabulary maps from lists adapted to its initial level or from words recorded by the user.

Title: HereImg
Description: HereImg (https://hereimg.com/) generates and modifies AI images from an instruction, combining multiple models to choose from.

Title: CoachLingo
Description: CoachLingo (https://www.coachlingo.ai/) lets you practice 30 languages or variations (e.g. US, UK or Australian English) orally and in writing via an AI avatar.

Title: Transpic
Description: Transpic (https://transpic.ai/) translates the text contained in an image while maintaining the original layout.

Title: CastReader
Description: CastReader (https://castreader.com/) reads web pages, PDFs, Kindle books aloud and explains their content with synchronized highlighting.

Title: EduquIA
Description: EduquIA (https://eduquia.fr/) generates ready-to-use teaching materials for teachers, students and families: exercises, revision sheets, visuals and course adaptations.

Title: Learn Leap
Description: Learn Leap (https://learnleap.xyz/) acts as an AI tutor that teaches step-by-step from an imported document.

Title: Voice to Text
Description: Voice to Text (https://voicetotext.pro/) is a Chrome extension that transcribes voice to text using Whisper AI, either directly recorded or from an imported audio file.

Title: Cinematic Slideshow Studio
Description: Cinematic Slideshow Studio (https://cinematicslideshowstudio.com/) generates a video slideshow from imported photos, complete with AI-composed or user-imported narration, music, and effects.

Title: Summarize Video To Text
Description: SummarizeVideoToText (https://summarizevideototext.com/) transcribes and summarizes YouTube, TikTok, or Instagram videos from a URL.

Title: Revised
Description: Revise (https://revise.io/) is an online word processor with built-in AI agent that edits documents directly in the browser.

Title: Proseable
Description: Proseable (https://www.proseable.com/) has students practice a foreign language orally by conversation with an AI, on topics chosen according to their interests.

Title: Wondering
Description: Wondering (https://wondering.app/) transforms an instruction into a structured learning path, broken down into short lessons.

Title: Choicely
Description: Choicely (https://www.choicely.com/) generates native iOS and Android mobile apps via an instruction.

Title: AutoDub
Description: AutoDub (https://autodub.net/) automatically dubs a YouTube video into another language, directly from the player controls.

Title: Moda
Description: Moda (https://moda.app/) generates visuals from instructions: slideshows, social media posts, documents, carousels, animations, websites, diagrams…

Title: EnglishPal
Description: EnglishPal (https://www.englishpal.ai/) has you practice English through conversation with an “AI coach”.

Title: Argos
Description: Argos (https://ia-des.rochane.fr/) makes the user dialogue in a chatbot on a given subject to exercise the construction of reasoning and critical thinking.

Title: HappyShrimp
Description: HappyShrimp (https://www.happyshrimp.ai/) generates a complete song, lyrics, melody, arrangement, and vocals, from an instruction.
